audit.poe: A chaos arrow that bursts and leaves caustic ground that damages enemies standing in it over time; area damage over time that scales with DoT and projectile modifiers.
audit.bob: A bow arrow that explodes in radius 1.5 with 60% chaos conversion and a 100% poison chance. The lasting ground is replaced by poison on everyone hit by the burst, which follows the enemy and scales with poison mods instead of ground DoT.
audit.repair: Leave a ground zone at the burst whose damage is a per-second chaos effect on enemies in it (the ground behaviour exists) rather than relying on poison.

lines: Bow attack: the arrow deals 55-64.4% of base attack damage with 60% physical converted to chaos, and explodes on the first enemy or obstacle hit or at the target point. [wiki]
The burst spreads caustic ground (base duration 2 s; radius +0..6 by gem level). Enemies standing in it take chaos damage over time (8.8 base chaos dps at gem L1, 1927.1 at L20). [wiki]
The ground damage is a debuff DoT, not poison: it is not affected by poison modifiers. Overlapping patches do not stack. [wiki]
Projectile damage modifiers apply to the DoT (projectile_damage_modifiers_apply_to_skill_dot) and to the burst; duration modifiers lengthen the ground. [wiki]
The ground and burst happen even if the projectile misses. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. The wiki states explicitly that caustic ground does not poison, so Bob's 100% poison chance is a stand-in with different stacking and scaling, which supports the repair as written.

audit.poe: (From poedb, current version; no PoB data.) A retaliation skill: it can only be used for 2 s after you block a hit, then slams a giant fist for enormous area damage on a 4 s cooldown.
audit.bob: A free-use mace/axe/staff slam at 150-190% with a stun duration bonus (not part of the original); the block-gated retaliation and its huge payoff are gone, so it is a generic slam spammed at will.
audit.repair: Gate the skill on a 2 s window opened by a successful block (the sim has block events and triggers) with a cooldown, and give it the big retaliation multiplier.

lines: The page titled Crushing Fist read as of 2020-03-12 is the gem Vengeance (SkillGemVengeance, release 1.3.0); PoB 3.9 has Vengeance and no Crushing Fist, which is why the audit found no PoB data. The block-gated Retaliation slam the audit describes is a later rework. [wiki][pob]

A triggered melee AoE counter-attack: 30% chance to trigger when you are hit, strikes all enemies around you (weapon range widens the area), 1.2 s cooldown shared by multiple Vengeance gems, and it cannot be used directly (attack_unusable_if_triggerable). [wiki][pob]

Damage is 170% of base attack damage at level 1 up to 255% at level 20 (PoB effectiveness 1.7 to 2.55), plus 8-12 added physical at level 1 up to 56-85 at level 20; needs a melee weapon equipped (any melee class incl. staves). [wiki][pob]
While dual wielding a random weapon is used per trigger; can hit up to 40 targets since 3.6.0; it cannot trigger while unarmed (1.3.1). [wiki]
The loop is purely reactive: nothing to spend, nothing to aim; the reward is a free area hit whenever the character is hit, rate-limited by the 1.2 s cooldown. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line does not hold for 3.9: it describes the current Crushing Fist (block window, giant fist, 4 s cooldown), but at 2020-03-12 that wiki page is the Vengeance counter-attack. Verdict stays gutted for a different reason (Bob's gem is a spammable slam with an invented stun bonus; the trigger-when-hit loop is absent), and the repair changes from 'block window + big multiplier' to 'fire itself on 30% of hits taken, 1.2 s cooldown, not selectable'. Bob already has a hitTaken trigger event in sim/triggers.ts.
spec.decision: The 3.9 analog is a trigger-only counter-attack, so a rebuilt Anvil Drop could never be a build's chosen main skill. Do we rebuild Anvil Drop as the Vengeance counter-attack (and drop its slam identity and weapon list), or keep a castable slam as Bob's own invention and add Vengeance separately?

audit.poe: Instant lightning that chains between nearby enemies (and in this version also forks to a second enemy on each chain, stronger with more chains remaining), with shock.
audit.bob: Chain behaviour: hits the target, then jumps to the nearest unhit enemy in chainRange (4) with line of sight, 2 chains +1 per 5 levels, 10% shock. Every chain deals the same damage, and there is no secondary fork.
audit.repair: Optional: a damage-per-remaining-chain scaling and a fork flag on the chain behaviour; numeric rather than a loop change.

audit.poe: Reserve mana for flat energy shield plus 30% increased ES recharge rate, so ES builds recover faster.
audit.bob: Reserves 35% mana for flat ES only. The engine does have an esRechargeRate stat (defence.ts) that this aura never sets, so the recharge half is missing.
audit.repair: Add an esRechargeRate inc mod (about 30) to the aura's mods.

lines: Instant aura reserving mana (35 in PoB data), affects you and nearby allies; radius +0 to +19 by L20 [wiki][pob]
Grants 60 (L1) to 217 (L20) additional maximum energy shield [wiki]
Also grants 30% increased energy shield recharge rate at all levels (added 3.0.0, when the ES was reduced from 303 to 217 at L20) [wiki][pob]
spec.check: Holds: 30% increased ES recharge rate is in both the wiki (3.0.0) and PoB; note that Bob's flat ES range 60-500 overshoots the 3.9 top end of 217 and should be reconciled when the recharge mod is added.

audit.poe: A wide barrage of arrows landing in sequence around the target area, giving a bow a cheap area-clear attack.
audit.bob: A delayed (0.5 s) ground burst of radius 3 at the target for one pulse at 180-220%; the sequence of many arrow hits is folded into one pulse.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: The bow shot flies up and lands at the target, then arrows burst out in a ring from there. (Row corrected after checking the 3.9 wiki; see the erratum.)
audit.bob: Just +4 projectiles in a forward fan with less damage; no landing point, no ring.
audit.repair: Fire a payload that lands at the aim point and spawns a ring of projectiles from it.

lines: Support for bow attack skills that fire arrows forward: instead fires a payload arrow into the air that lands at the targeted location. [wiki]
The supported skill's arrows then fire out in a circle from where it lands, applying the skill's effects. [wiki]
4 additional projectiles; supported skills deal 40% (L1) to 26% (L20) less projectile damage; mana multiplier 140%. [wiki][pob]
Cannot support skills that already fire arrows into the air, channelled skills, or minion skills; bows only. [wiki]
Added in 3.9.0. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Bob only adds 4 forward projectiles; the landing point and the ring are the whole function.

audit.poe: Hits penetrate fire resistance.
audit.bob: Penetration fire.

bindShade.name: Bind Shade

audit.poe: Raises a spectre of a defeated monster, so the choice of which monster to copy and its skills define the build.
audit.bob: One or two generic chaos bolt shades (the 'spectre' minion), not tied to any monster or corpse.
audit.repair: Let it pick a monster type from the roster (e.g. the most recent or chosen kill) and copy its attack into the minion.

lines: Raises a defeated monster's corpse as a spectre. The spectre keeps the basic abilities it had in life, as the normal-rarity version of that monster type, minus its own minion-raising skills. [wiki]
Which monster you raise defines the build. Minion supports linked to the gem apply to the spectre's skills (projectile and area supports, for example). [wiki]
Maximum 1 spectre at level 1 and 2 at level 20 (further ones unlock at gem levels 13 and 25 since 3.9.0). Cast time 0.85 s, mana 15 at level 1, 28 at level 20. [wiki][pob]

The gem sets the spectre's level: 31 at level 1, up to 80 at level 20 (76 from 3.10). It adds 150 to 1109 accuracy, 55% more minion movement speed (capped) and +30% to all elemental resistances. It no longer modifies life, energy shield or damage. [wiki][pob]
The corpse is used up by raising it. [memory]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds against the wiki, and its missing list is still right (the monster's own skills come with raise_from_corpse_type). The 1-to-2 count scaling in Bob matches, but a generic chaos-bolt shade that ignores the corpse is still gutted.
spec.decision: The character cannot pick a corpse in an autobattler. Which rule should choose the monster: the most recent kill, the strongest or highest-level kill, or a monster type the player selects in the loadout?

bindShade.accepted: Accepted (the user, 2026-10-09): a spectre keeps only its monster's damage factor, rate, range, speed and life, not its abilities; the corpse is the nearest.

audit.poe: (From poedb, current version; no PoB data.) A dual-wield retaliation: usable for 2 s after a block, it rains blades in front eight times, each with both weapons' damage combined, on a 3 s cooldown.
audit.bob: A free-use self-centred burst that echoes once (repeats:1), usable with one weapon of sword, axe or mace; no block gate, no dual-wield requirement (the engine supports needsDualWield) and no eight-hit barrage.
audit.repair: Gate on a post-block window with a 3 s cooldown, require dual wielding, and land several hits with both weapons.

lines: The page title resolves to the gem that was called Reckoning in 3.9 (renamed later; release 1.3.0). The dual-wield, eight-blade, 3 s cooldown line of the audit is the later gem. [wiki]

A counter-attack that triggers automatically when you block with a shield; it cannot be used directly and only triggers with a shield equipped and either a melee weapon or no weapon (unarmed). [wiki][pob]
Melee area attack hitting enemies in a cone in front of you (range 35); up to 40 targets per attack; cooldown 0.4 s. [wiki][pob]
115% (level 1) to 175% (level 20) of base attack damage, physical, plus (2-56) to (3-85) added attack physical. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line does not hold for 3.9: Reckoning is a block-triggered shield counter-attack in a cone with a 0.4 s cooldown, not a dual-wield eight-hit barrage; Bob's free-use 360-degree burst with an echo has none of the trigger loop. I replaced dual_wield_requirement and multi_hit_sequence in the missing list.
spec.decision: The 3.9 gem is Reckoning (a shield counter-attack triggered whenever the character blocks), not the dual-wield blade barrage Bob's gem is modelled on. Rebase Blade Wind on Reckoning (block-triggered cone, 0.4 s cooldown), or keep the later design as a Bob original outside the 3.9 repair plan?

audit.poe: Channelled flamethrower whose cone widens and lengthens as you hold it, with damage that grows per stage, and a final wave that applies a strong ignite when you stop.
audit.bob: A fire beam (4.5 by 2.4) every 0.2 s at 45% effectiveness. The sustained stream form survives, but the widening with stages, the stage damage and the release ignite are gone and the channelling tag is inert.
audit.repair: Stage counter that grows the beam's length and width and damage while the skill keeps firing, plus a final strong ignite on stop.

lines: Channelled fire spell, cast time 0.2 s, crit 5%, effectiveness 30%: each tick launches a torrent of fire in a cone, repeatedly damaging enemies. [wiki][pob]

Each tick adds a stage up to 8 (10 with a helmet enchant): 25% more hit and ailment damage per stage (up to +200%), cone length +4 to +5 per stage (to +15-19), cone angle +100% per stage (to +300%). [wiki][pob]
Stunned or interrupted: stages fall back to 1. [wiki]
Release launches a final wave across the whole wide, long cone: 500% more hit damage, 500% more ignite damage, and it always ignites. [wiki][pob]
Totems release automatically at max stacks or when the target dies. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. The sustained cone stream survives in Bob; what is missing is the 8-stage growth (damage, length, angle) and the strong final wave with guaranteed ignite, which is where the ignite build comes from.

audit.poe: A trap that explodes in fire and leaves burning ground that keeps damaging enemies who walk through it, with bonus fire damage against burning targets.
audit.bob: A trap that opens a fire ground zone (radius 2, 1.75 s, hit every 0.25 s) with ignite chance; the burning-ground persistence is kept, only the extra added fire damage versus burning enemies is omitted.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Teleport to a nearby enemy, slam, and leave consecrated ground (life regeneration) in an area.
audit.bob: Attack with travel 7 and a half-fire burst r2 150..184%; ground dropped, so the teleport-slam survives but without a lasting effect.
audit.repair: Leave a 'ground' zone granting life regeneration to the player standing in it.

lines: Melee slam (sword, axe, mace, sceptre, staff or unarmed), attack speed -20%, mana 8: 150-184.25% of base attack damage, 50% of physical converted to fire, deals up to 20% more damage to closer targets. [wiki]
When an enemy is near the targeted point you teleport to it from a short distance away before slamming (movement skill; cannot use Multistrike). [wiki]
The slam creates consecrated ground for a 4 s base duration. [wiki]

Consecrated ground: you and allies regenerate an additional 6% of maximum life per second, and hits against enemies on it have 100% increased critical strike chance (energy shield instead with Zealot's Oath). [wiki]
spec.check: Corrected: the audit's life-regeneration ground holds (6% max life/s), but the 3.9 Consecrated Ground page also gives 100% increased crit chance to hits against enemies standing on it, which the audit left out; the ground lasts 4 s here.

audit.poe: A golem that gives you extra physical damage reduction and fights with chaos attacks.
audit.bob: One chaos golem with splash melee; the owner gets +3-4% physical damage reduction (always on).
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Hold to gain stages, release to fire an arrow that leaves spore pods that bloom into thorn arrows; more stages mean more pods and damage. A commitment-for-power chaos/poison bow skill.
audit.bob: A steady three-arrow chaos fan with 60% poison chance (both real) and a cheap per-use cost; there is no stage build-up and no spore pods blooming later, so it is an averaged volley without the ramp or the lingering pods.
audit.repair: Add a stage count that rises while the skill is used on a target and scales the arrow count/damage, and leave pods along the path that fire thorn arrows.

lines: Channelled bow attack: hold to charge up to 5 stages, release fires one piercing arrow. 28-35% of base attack damage, 60% of physical converted to chaos, plus added chaos. [wiki][pob]
Each stage gives 150% more hit and ailment damage. [wiki][pob]
On release the arrow leaves one spore pod per stage along its path (5 pods at 5 stages); each pod blooms into 9 thorn arrows that fly a short way and dissipate, at 50% less damage. [wiki][pob]
Additional projectiles apply only to the primary arrows, and the pods are shared out among them; more arrows than pods creates no extra pods. [wiki]
Arrows pierce all targets. The gem has no poison chance of its own. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: Corrected: verdict moves from drifted to gutted, because both defining halves (stage charge with release, and pods that bloom into thorn arrows) are absent and what remains is a generic chaos bow volley. Also the audit calls Bob's chaos conversion and 60% poison 'real': the gem converts 60% (Bob 100%) and has no poison chance at all in the wiki or PoB.

audit.poe: Teleport-strike with a 2 s cooldown that can be bypassed by spending a Frenzy Charge, plus a movement-speed buff; charges become burst and mobility.
audit.bob: Attack with travel 8, 142..168% damage, 15% chance on hit to gain Fervour and +10% more attack speed per Fervour charge (both real via chargeOn.hit and 'per' charges.fervour). No cooldown, no charge-spend, no move buff; charges only accumulate and are never consumed (sim/charges.ts has no spend).
audit.repair: Give the attack a 2 s cooldown that a Fervour charge can bypass (spend one), and add a short move-speed buff on use.

lines: Melee attack (Strike, Movement, Duration) that teleports to a nearby enemy and attacks it with the weapon; a random monster is picked if none is targeted; single target; cannot be used through walls. Cast time 1.0, attack speed multiplier 120%, 10 mana at every level. [wiki][pob]
Deals 142% (L1) to 168% (L20) of base attack damage. [wiki][pob]
2 s cooldown with one stored use; the cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge. [wiki][pob]
15% chance to gain a Frenzy Charge on hit, and 10% increased attack speed per Frenzy Charge for this skill on top of the usual per-charge bonus. [wiki][pob]
Using it grants a 3 s buff of +20% movement speed (added in 3.7.0). [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds, but I lowered the verdict from gutted to drifted: Bob already has the teleporting strike, the 142-168% band, the 15% charge gain on hit and the per-charge attack speed (the sources list exactly these). What is missing is the cooldown/charge-spend timing and the 3 s movement buff.

audit.poe: Cold nova around the caster that leaves a whirling vortex dealing cold damage over time and chilling; 1.8 s cooldown; can detonate Frostbolt projectiles.
audit.bob: Primary spell: a 'ground' zone (r2.6, 3 s, pulses every 0.5 s) placed on the target within 6 tiles, with +chill effect; real zone pulses in actions.ts/zones. No cooldown, not centred on the caster, no initial nova, no Frostbolt interaction.
audit.repair: Optional: centre the zone on the caster (origin self) and add a small cooldown; the Frostbolt-detonation niche needs a frostbolt-tagged projectile registry (low value).

audit.poe: Flat life gained for each enemy hit by the supported attack; sustain for hit-heavy builds.
audit.bob: lifeOnHit base [3,22] on the skill's profile; combat.ts applyHit adds it per enemy hit (capped at life cap). Works as intended.

audit.poe: Buff: attack speed and life leech at the price of life degeneration; kills refresh the duration and may give a frenzy charge.
audit.bob: Upkeep buff (9 s, cd 9): attackSpeed inc 5..15, leech.life 1.2 on attacks. Degen drawback, kill-refresh and charge-on-kill are all dropped.
audit.repair: Add a buff-linked life drain mod, kill refresh of the buff timer, and chargeOn.kill.fervour inside the buff.

lines: Instant spell buff, 1 s cooldown, mana 7 to 16; buff lasts 7 s (L1) to 10.8 s (L20). [wiki][pob]
Gives (5-15)% increased attack speed and 1.2% of attack physical damage leeched as life. [wiki]
Drawback: you take 4% of maximum life per second (and 4% of max energy shield) as physical damage, reduced by physical damage reduction (armour does not apply) and not a hit. [wiki]
Killing an enemy while the buff is active refreshes the buff duration. [wiki]
25% chance to gain a Frenzy Charge on kill while the buff is active. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit said 'life degeneration' loosely; the wiki fixes it as 4% of max life per second as physical damage (non-hit, reduced by phys reduction), and the frenzy charge is a 25% chance, not guaranteed. Missing list and verdict unchanged, but status is corrected because the numbers the repair needs came from the wiki.

audit.poe: Hits leech life based on damage dealt.
audit.bob: leech.life 2% for attacks (spells are excluded; PoE allows any hit).

audit.poe: More physical damage, no elemental or chaos damage.
audit.bob: Same flags (noElementalDamage/noChaosDamage) consumed in buildProfile; more physical.

audit.poe: A melee strike (half converted to lightning) that also throws projectiles from the struck enemy to hit farther-away targets; a melee skill with ranged reach.
audit.bob: Behaviour is a pure projectile fan (5 bolts, 70 degrees, range 7) from the caster at -25% each; there is no melee hit, and all bolts share a per-use hit list so one target takes a single bolt. It plays as a short-range shotgun-free fan, not a strike with spawned bolts.
audit.repair: Add a hybrid behaviour: a melee hit on the target followed by projectiles launched from the target's position at other enemies.

lines: Melee attack plus a projectile attack in one swing: melee hit is 135-180% of base attack damage, 50% of physical converted to lightning, plus added lightning; any melee weapon. [wiki][pob]

Fires (4-7) additional projectiles (five at L1, more with level) in a roughly 85 degree arc; they fly straight until they strike an enemy. The gem text says the energy is released from the weapon as you strike, so they start at you, not at the struck enemy. [wiki]
Each bolt deals 75% of weapon damage (projectiles deal 25% less) and scales with projectile modifiers, not melee ones. [wiki][pob]
The bolts cannot miss if the melee attack hits a target; bolts that miss are dissipated. [wiki]
No shotgun flag in pob (one hit per enemy per swing). Bolts can chain (Chain Support) but not if they pierce. [pob][wiki]
spec.check: Corrected: the audit says the bolts are thrown from the struck enemy; the 3.9 wiki (and the PoB description) says they leave the weapon in an arc of about 85 degrees, so Bob's fan from the caster has the right origin and shape (70 degrees, close enough). What is missing is the separate melee hit (135-180%), so projectile_from_target is dropped from the missing list. The Frost Blades page confirms the contrast: only Frost Blades spawns its blades behind the struck enemy.

audit.poe: Delayed teleport that deals lightning damage at both origin and destination; warps can be queued.
audit.bob: Plain blink (distance 9, cd 3, cast 0.8). No delay mechanic, no area damage at either end, no queueing.
audit.repair: Blink with a lightning area hit at both endpoints (the delay already roughly exists as cast time).

lines: Spell, area, movement; cast time 0.8 s, mana 9 to 26, effectiveness 60%, base crit 5%. [wiki]
Casting sets the exit point; you can act (attack, cast, move) until the teleport resolves. [wiki]
The teleport happens after a delay equal to the time needed to run that distance at your movement speed (skill effect duration, with 20-39% reduced duration by gem level). [wiki]
An area of lightning damage (1-37 to 19-707) explodes BEFORE you leave, around your old spot, and again AFTER you arrive. [wiki]
3.9.0 change: casting again queues more warps (up to 50); you travel through all of them in order, each delay based on the distance from the previous warp. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds, but the repair note 'the delay already roughly exists as cast time' is wrong: the cast time is 0.8 s separate from the travel delay, which scales with distance and movement speed. The repair needs a real distance-scaled delay (plus the 3.9.0 queue), not a reused cast time. No cooldown at all in 3.9; it is mana-limited.

audit.poe: A trap that fires a ring of lightning projectiles with shock chance and extra critical chance against shocked enemies, so shock feeds crits.
audit.bob: A 9-projectile 360 degree ring with 20% shock chance and scaling shock effect; the crit-chance-versus-shocked-enemies stat (80-118%) that is in the reference data is not on the definition.
audit.repair: Add critChance inc 80-118 with condition targetShocked (the engine already supports it, as Spire Trap shows).

lines: Trap spell: thrown, arms, then fires when an enemy enters its trigger radius, or automatically when its 4 s duration ends (3.2.0); trap duration is not changed by skill-effect-duration modifiers [wiki]
Fires 1 + 8 additional = 9 lightning projectiles in a full circle (projectiles_nova), with a random rotation instead of aiming at the trigger enemy (3.3.0); no pierce or chain by default [wiki]
Lightning hit 18-54 at L1 to 466-1399 at L20, damage effectiveness 135%, base crit 6%, no cooldown (3.3.0); cast speed is irrelevant, trap throwing speed applies [wiki]
20% chance to shock; increased shock effect 0 at L1 rising to +19% at L20 [wiki]
Crit chance against shocked enemies is increased by 80% at L1 up to 118% at L20: the shock-feeds-crit link that defines the gem [wiki]
Mana 8 at L1 to 20 at L20 [pob]
spec.check: Holds: the wiki text and stat_text give 9 projectiles in a circle, 20% shock and 80-118% increased crit chance against shocked enemies, and Bob's ring, 135% effectiveness, 6 crit and shock chance all match; only the crit-vs-shocked stat is missing, as the audit says.

audit.poe: Consumes a corpse (and more corpses for longer duration) to give your minions attack and spell block with life recovery on block.
audit.bob: A rally-policy buff on the character: 25-35% attack and spell block for 8 s; no corpse, no minion buff (minions get block only from minionBlock gear), so the minion-protection role is lost.
audit.repair: Apply the block (and life on block) to live minions and let nearby corpses extend its duration. I am unsure whether the 3.9 effect also covers the player.

lines: Consumes a corpse and up to 4 more around it. Cast time 1.0 s, mana 16 at level 1, 33 at level 20. [wiki][pob]
Base duration is 5 s, plus 1 s for each extra corpse, so 9 s at most (3.8.0). [wiki]
It buffs your minions only: +25 to 35% chance to block attacks and +25 to 34% chance to block spells. [wiki]
Minions recover 11 to 594 life each time they block. [wiki][pob]
Only one offering can be active per player. Casting another cancels the older one. [wiki]
The gem deals no damage. [pob]
There is no cooldown. [pob]
spec.check: The audit was unsure whether the effect also covers the player. The wiki describes minions only, and a note on the Spirit Offering page implies that a Necromancer ascendancy node is what makes offerings affect the player [memory]. I added minion_life_on_block and single_active_offering (the wiki states both). Bob's block numbers match, but the buff goes on the character, needs no corpse and runs a fixed 8 s with an 8 s cooldown. I kept drifted because the timed minion-buff shape and the stat values still match; the missing parts are the recipient and the corpse-driven duration.

audit.poe: Shortens a duration skill's effect for more damage: trade lasting effect for burst (zones, buffs, minions and traps vanish sooner).
audit.bob: skillDuration more (negative) and damage more. skillDuration is read for deployable lifetime, timed minions and the calc sheet's ground pulse count, but the sim's ground zones use b.duration / b.interval without the multiplier, and curses/buffs/ailments use other stats, so the downside barely exists in play while the damage bonus does.
audit.repair: Apply profile.skillDuration to zone pulses in the sim and to buff/hex duration, so the shorter-lasting cost is real.

lines: Supports any skill that has a duration [wiki]
40% (L1) to 49% (L20) less Skill Effect Duration, the counterpart of Increased Duration [wiki]
10% to 19% more Damage (reduced from 20-29 in 2.4.0) [wiki]

It shortens the effects the skill creates (zones, clouds, buffs); ailment durations are not changed by it unless a skill says so, and trap, mine and totem lifetimes are not scaled by skill effect duration [wiki]
spec.check: Holds: -40 to -49% duration and +10 to +19% damage match Bob exactly. Caveat for the repair: in 3.9 ailments and trap/mine/totem lifetimes are not scaled by skill effect duration, so wiring skillDuration into the sim should cover zones, clouds, buffs and curses only.

audit.poe: Channel to release lightning orbs that repeatedly jump toward a target spot; when you stop channelling, all remaining orbs explode for higher damage in a larger area, so you choose when to cash out.
audit.bob: A rapid burst (0.25 s cast time) on the target with half the physical converted to lightning; averaged into repeated hits with no release explosion.
audit.repair: Accumulate orbs while the skill is used on a target and detonate them as a larger burst when the target dies or the skill stops.

lines: Channelled spell, cast time 0.25 s, crit 6%, effectiveness 25%; physical damage, 50% converted to lightning. No longer fires projectiles (3.6.0). [wiki][pob]
Each cast tick makes one orb at a spread-out spot around the target place (buckshot-like; area mods do not widen the spread); enemies can be hit by several orbs. [wiki]
Each orb lasts 1.2 s and jumps every 0.4 s to a new spot near the target place, exploding in a small area after each jump, on its own timer. [wiki][pob]
When you stop channelling, every remaining orb explodes in a larger area for more damage: 75% of skill damage per 0.4 s of duration it still had left. [wiki][pob]
Cast speed raises how fast orbs are made, not the jump rate; duration mods only matter at 0.4 s steps. [wiki]
spec.check: Corrected: the audit's line and verdict (drifted, low) hold, but the missing list changes. There is no stage counter (so channel_ramp is dropped); what builds up is a pool of live orbs, each persisting 1.2 s and jumping every 0.4 s, and the release detonation scales with their remaining time. Bob's repeated bursts at the target are a fair stand-in for the jumping hits.

audit.poe: Cast curse that lowers all elemental resistances of enemies in an area for the duration.
audit.bob: A hex-kind gem that only works when Hexing Strikes sits in the same item as the primary skill; it is not castable (other curses like Tinder Curse are utility casts). The resistance reduction is real (hexTotals res, applied to enemies hit).
audit.repair: Convert it to an active spell with utility.kind curse like the other curses, keeping Hexing Strikes as an alternative route.

lines: Curse (Spell, AoE, Duration), cast time 0.5 s, base duration 9 s (L1) to 10.9 s (L20), radius +0 to +10, mana 16 to 33; deals no damage. [wiki][pob]
Cursed enemies have -20% (L1) to -39% (L20) to all elemental resistances (fire, cold, lightning); resistances can go negative, so it is stronger against highly resistant monsters. [wiki][pob]
Bosses take reduced curse effect (the wiki cites 66% less for Shaper-tier bosses); one curse at a time by default. [wiki]
Can be turned into an aura with Blasphemy Support. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Bob's resistance effect is real (20..35% against the original's 20..39%); the gap is that the hex cannot be cast, only applied through Hexing Strikes.

audit.poe: More melee physical damage; the same more multiplier also boosts bleed and poison from melee hits.
audit.bob: More melee physical damage (melee tag, physical type). Melee-tagged mods never reach ailment damage (DESIGN 6.6), so the bleed/poison half of the PoE gem is absent.
audit.repair: Optional: also give the multiplier to bleed and poison damage.

audit.poe: Charge with the off-hand shield: damage and stun chance grow the further you travel, repeated hits along the path, damage derived from shield stats.
audit.bob: Attack needing a shield with travel 8, melee range 1.5, flat 'more damage' 50 and enemy stun threshold. The port note's 'hits harder the farther it ran' is not implemented (travel is not tied to damage); no shield-derived damage.
audit.repair: Scale the charge's damage and stun with the actual travel distance and add damage from the shield's armour/evasion.

lines: Melee area attack and movement skill that needs a shield and uses the shield's stats (not the weapon); it works with a one-hand weapon, a wand or unarmed. Cannot be supported by Multistrike. [wiki][pob]

Charges at a location or enemy (maximum distance 60 units, movement speed +90% to +109%): enemies in the path are pushed aside, and those it collides with are knocked back and stunned; it repeatedly deals off-hand damage in a small area in front, then a larger area hit at the end. [wiki][pob]
Damage and stun power scale with distance travelled: up to 100% more damage with hits and 75% increased stun threshold reduction at maximum distance. [wiki][pob]
Damage is off-hand: 15-22 (level 1) to 172-258 (level 20) base physical plus 2 to 3 added physical per 15 armour or evasion rating on the shield; off-hand attack time 0.53 s to 0.48 s. [wiki][pob]
End-of-charge radius 8 in 3.9 (doubled in 3.10); mana 10. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB (distance-scaled damage and stun, shield-derived damage, repeated hits along the path). The distance bonus is up to 100% more damage (older prose says 150%) and the 3.10 radius change is not in 3.9.

audit.poe: Melee hits give Fortify; more melee damage.
audit.bob: buffOn.meleeHit.fortify at 100% (the sim rolls it on melee hits; the buff gives 20% less damage taken for 4 s) plus more melee damage.

audit.poe: Minions are wreathed in fire: a burning aura around each deals fire damage based on its life to nearby enemies, and the minions take fire damage themselves; an area-damage minion build.
audit.bob: Only 18% more minion damage. Minions attack with rawHit and have no aura or ground burn; tickAuraBurn is player-only; no self-damage. The port note says as much.
audit.repair: Give timed pulses of fire damage to enemies near each minion (scaled by minion life) and a small self-damage drain on the minion.

lines: Supported minions burn the enemies near them: 15.6 fire damage per second at level 1, up to 1316 at level 20, as a damage-over-time effect. Minions get credit for kills it makes. [wiki]

The value comes from a per-gem-level table (the wiki lists 934 per minute at level 1 up to 78957 at level 20), not from the minion's life. Burning-effect radius is +0 at level 1, up to +5 at level 20. [wiki]
Damage to enemies does not stack between minions. Nearby enemies start burning as soon as the minion is summoned, before it acts. [wiki]
The minions burn themselves too: each takes 40% of its maximum life as fire damage per second, reduced by its fire resistance. Quality lowers the fire damage they take. [wiki][pob]
Summon Skitterbots also deal this damage over time when supported (3.8.0d). [wiki]
The gem gives no extra damage multiplier. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line is half wrong: it says the aura's damage is 'based on its life', but only the self-damage is life-based. The aura's damage comes from a gem-level table (15.6 to 1316 per second), so the repair should scale the pulses by gem level, not by minion life. The 18% 'more' damage in Bob does not exist on the 3.9 gem, so Bob's gem stays gutted.

audit.poe: Summons a group of skeleton warriors that melee enemies and expire after about 20 s.
audit.bob: Summons 3-8 skeletons for 20 s that run at and strike enemies, resummoned by the utility policy when depleted.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Summons short-lived fast flaming skulls that rush enemies and attack rapidly.
audit.bob: Summons 3-8 fast fire spirits for 5 s that rush at enemies with a high attack rate.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: A support-minion golem: it gives your non-golem minions added physical damage and hits harder for each minion near it, so it is a minion-build amplifier.
audit.bob: Adds flat physical damage to the character's own hits through ownerMods; minion damage comes only from the minionDamage multiplier (src/sim/minions.ts), so the added damage never reaches minions and the per-minion bonus is absent.
audit.repair: Add a minion added-damage stat that tickMinions reads, and a per-nearby-minion more-damage on the golem.

lines: Summons one Carrion Golem (maximum 1 golem). Cast time 1.0 s, mana 30 at level 1, 54 at level 20, and a 6 s cooldown. [wiki][pob]
Golems grant 7 to 11 additional physical damage at level 1, up to 27 to 41 at level 20, to non-golem minions. It is a buff for your other minions, not for the character. [wiki][pob]
The golem deals 8% more damage per non-golem minion near it, up to 80%. (3.10 later lowered this to 5% and 50%.) [wiki][pob]
It also gets 30 to 68% increased minion maximum life and up to 10% larger character size. [wiki][pob]
Its attacks are melee strikes, a leaping slam, a series of slashes that speed up and hit harder, and a ground slam sending a wave of bone spikes. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. I only added the 3.9 numbers (8% per minion, cap 80%) and noted that the 5%/50% figures belong to 3.10. Bob's gem still gives the added physical damage to the character, not to the minions.

audit.poe: Mines that detonate in a chain: each mine sets off the next a moment later, and every detonation in the cascade adds more damage; the identity is the sequential detonation bonus.
audit.bob: Just adds the mine type and a flat damage penalty. Mines auto-detonate on their own when an enemy is within 3.5 tiles (arm 0.6 s); there is no cascade, no neighbour triggering, no per-detonation bonus. Description ('set one another off') is not implemented.
audit.repair: When one mine goes off, detonate the other mines of the set in order a fraction of a second apart, each adding a per-detonation more-damage step.

lines: Support for spells and bow/wand attacks (no melee weapons, no channelling): the skill is thrown as a mine and used when the player detonates it. [wiki]
Mine lasts 5 s (3.8.0; it was 16 s). [wiki]
Supported skills deal (35-25)% less damage, 35% at L1 down to 25% at L20. [wiki][pob]
Base mine detonation time is 0.25 s: mines go off in a sequence, 0.25 s apart. [wiki][pob]
Each mine deals 5% more damage for each prior mine in the detonation sequence (so the Nth mine in a cascade has (N-1) x 5% more). [wiki]
In 3.9 the player triggers the sequence by hand; Bob's mines trigger on an enemy coming near, so the first proximity trigger would have to start the cascade. [wiki][memory]
spec.check: Audit PoE line holds against the wiki (sequential detonation with a per-prior-mine bonus; 'a moment later' is 0.25 s and the bonus is 5% more per prior mine). Bob's mines and flat -35..-25% match the penalty but have no sequence or bonus, so drifted stands.

audit.poe: More elemental damage, but the skill cannot inflict elemental ailments.
audit.bob: More elemental damage plus the cannotInflictEle flag; calc/combat.ts blocks ignite, shock, chill and freeze. Bleed and poison unaffected.

audit.poe: A nova that consumes all your charges and deals fire, cold and lightning damage per endurance, frenzy and power charge removed; the trade is spending your charge buffs for a burst.
audit.bob: A nova with fire per Grit, cold per Fervour and lightning per Insight, but the charges are never consumed (no charge-spend path exists in src/sim/charges.ts), so it is a free charge-scaled nova that keeps the buffs.
audit.repair: Add a consume-charges flag on cast that zeroes the held charges after the damage is computed.

lines: Nova spell centred on the caster: cast time 0.75, crit 7%, damage effectiveness 150%, mana 13 to 25; no target cap since 3.9.0. [wiki][pob]

Consumes ALL of the player's charges: lightning damage per Power Charge removed, fire per Endurance Charge removed, cold per Frenzy Charge removed (per charge 5-34 to 93-651 lightning, 35-244 to 52-365 fire, 29-199 to 43-299 cold across levels 1-20). [wiki][pob]
Bonuses from the charges (e.g. crit chance from Power Charges) apply to that cast; the charges are removed once the cast finishes, and charge-gain effects are applied afterwards. [wiki]
It needs charges to deal its damage; deals 35% less damage when triggered. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds (Bob maps Grit to fire, Fervour to cold, Insight to lightning, as in the original). The only gap is that Bob never consumes the charges, so the trade is gone.

audit.poe: Hit an enemy to gain a 4 s buff, stackable to three, during which beams automatically zap several nearby enemies every ~0.4 s (stronger while you move); you pick it for the persistent AoE aura after a strike.
audit.bob: A plain melee strike with 60% lightning conversion and a flat +30% more damage; no buff, no zaps, no area (single-target melee behaviour).
audit.repair: On hit, grant a timed stacking self buff that makes the character fire a lightning pulse at nearby enemies on an interval (rate per stack), and remove the flat more-damage.

lines: Melee strike (most one- and two-handed melee weapons). 107% (level 1) to 160% (level 20) of base attack damage, 60% physical converted to lightning; mana 6. [wiki][pob]
Hitting an enemy gives a 4 s buff; it stacks up to 3 times, each stack with its own timer (the oldest is refreshed at 3). [wiki][pob]
While buffed, beams hit up to 4 (level 1) to 6 (level 20) nearby enemies every 0.4 s, +10% frequency per stack (about 3.25 beams per second at 3 stacks). Beams chain once. [wiki][pob]
Beams are attack damage that count as melee. They deal 60% (level 1) to 54% less damage while you stand still and 40% to 31% less while moving, so they hit harder when you move. [wiki][pob]
Beam radius 19 base; the beam area benefits from area increases but not area damage. +0 to 2 melee range. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB, including "stronger while you move". It is worth stating the beam damage penalties (60-54% less still, 40-31% less moving) so the pulse is not overtuned.

audit.poe: Channelling support that shields you from damage while you channel and grants more damage for a few seconds after channelling stops.
audit.bob: Only a flat more damage for channelling skills. The barrier (less damage taken while using the skill) and the post-channel timing window are gone; the port note admits the barrier is dropped.
audit.repair: Give the supported skill a 'while using it' defence condition (less damage taken during its action) and a short damage buff after a channelled burst ends.

lines: Support (Channelling, Duration), reworked in 3.6.0, for channelling skills; mana multiplier 140%; totems cannot gain Infusion. [wiki]
Supported skills deal 20% (L1) to 39% (L20) more damage; only the channelled skill itself, not spells triggered by Cast While Channelling. [wiki][pob]
While channelling a supported skill you take 8% less damage from hits of the types matching the skill gem's tags (physical only if the skill has a physical tag, since 3.7.0). [wiki][pob]
After channelling for 1.6 s (L1) down to 1.0 s (L20) you gain Infusion, which lasts 6 s after you stop channelling and gives 10% more damage of the types matching the skill gem's tags. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit under-described the gem: its main payload is the 20-39% more damage Bob already gives, and the barrier is only 8% less damage while channelling. The remaining gap (the barrier and the 6 s Infusion after channelling) is smaller than the audit's wording suggested; the verdict stays drifted because the Infusion timing loop is absent.

audit.poe: A short-lived, fast, high-damage cold projectile that pierces and fades, losing damage and freeze chance with distance; a close-range freezer.
audit.bob: Piercing cold projectile with range 5 at 150% effectiveness and a 20% freeze chance. The fade is only the short range; there is no damage or freeze falloff (the falloff field exists in the behaviour but is not set).
audit.repair: Optional: set behaviour.falloff, and scale freeze chance with distance.

audit.poe: A fire strike that stacks a charged debuff on the target (6 stacks or expiry or death detonates it for AoE damage), and every debuffed enemy explodes on death; you pick it to turn single-target hits into delayed area bursts.
audit.bob: A plain melee strike, 50% fire conversion plus a flat 20% more damage; nothing is stacked or detonated (the 'area' tag has no area behind it, behaviour is single-target melee).
audit.repair: Add a per-target hit-stack debuff that detonates as an area burst at N stacks, on expiry and on death (the sim already has kill triggers and per-target ailment lists to hang it on), and drop the flat +20% more.

lines: Melee strike (sword, axe, mace, sceptre, staff or unarmed): 104% (level 1) to 133% (level 20) of base attack damage, 50% physical converted to fire, plus (5-75) to (8-113) added fire. [wiki][pob]
Each enemy hit gets a charged debuff that stacks up to 6 times; base duration 0.8 s, refreshed by further hits. Other enemies caught in the strike get an uncharged debuff. [wiki][pob]

At 6 charges, on expiry or on death the charged debuff detonates in an area for 66% of the attack damage per charge (same damage types as the hit, plus area damage), hitting that and nearby enemies. [wiki][pob]

Any enemy carrying a debuff explodes when it dies: fire damage equal to 6% of its maximum life to nearby enemies (a separate secondary effect that cannot be reflected; monsters slain by it explode too). [wiki][pob]
Explosion radius 15 base; +0 to 2 melee range; mana 6. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB: 6 stacks, expiry or death detonates, and every debuffed corpse explodes. The numbers to use are 0.8 s, 66% per charge and 6% of max life.

audit.poe: Totem that beams burning damage at you and every other totem, damaging enemies in between and at the ends; allows one more totem.
audit.bob: A pair of totems (deployCount +1) each pulsing a fire burst r3.4 around itself as hits, with no DoT, no link beams between totems or to the player.
audit.repair: Add a line hit between totems and the player and make it burning damage over time.

lines: Totem spell, cast time 1.0 s, mana 18 to 51; totem lasts 8 s, range 100; grants +1 maximum totems (so a pair is possible), shared with other totem types by taking the highest. [wiki][pob]
The totem casts a fire beam at YOU and at each other Searing Bond totem you control; links only form within range and unobstructed. [wiki]
The beams deal fire damage over time (23.6 to 1755.6 base fire damage per second), counted as burning damage; modifiers to spell damage apply to the DoT (3.8.0). [wiki]
It does not hit (no on-hit or on-crit effects, no fire penetration); damage from several beams does not stack on one enemy (1.0.5). [wiki]
Enemies near either end of a beam also suffer burning damage. [wiki]
spec.check: Audit PoE line holds. Note one correction to the audit's repair idea: the wiki says beams from several totems do not stack on the same enemy, so 'damage_over_time_stacking' means the DoT stacking rules, not multiple beams adding up. Bob's two totems with local fire bursts have no beam, no DoT, no player link.

audit.poe: 25% reserved herald: physical gained as fire, more spell fire damage, and when you kill any enemy, overkill damage burns the enemies near it. Rewards big hits and dense packs, needs no ignite.
audit.bob: Gain-as-fire and spell fire more are real. The kill effect only spreads an existing ignite from a dead burning enemy (sim/triggers.ts spread); it needs an ignited victim, so non-ignite builds get nothing, and there is no overkill scaling.
audit.repair: On any kill, ignite nearby enemies for a share of the dead enemy's overkill damage (needs the overkill amount passed to the kill event).

lines: Herald (Spell, Buff, Fire, AoE) that reserves 25% of mana; instant cast since 3.4.0 with a 1 s cooldown. [wiki][pob]
Gain 15% of physical damage as extra fire for non-damage-over-time damage (attacks, spells, traps), and 9% (L1) to 12% (L20) more spell fire damage (added in 3.2.0). [wiki][pob]

When you kill ANY enemy while it is active (no ignite needed), enemies within radius 10 of the corpse are burned based on the overkill damage (all excess damage of the killing hit, any type): 25% of the overkill per second (PoB 1500% per minute) for the 4 s base duration. [wiki][pob]
The burn gets up to 38% more burning damage at level 20 and is affected only by damage-over-time and burning modifiers; area modifiers widen the on-kill radius. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Bob's kill effect needs an already-ignited victim and has no overkill scaling, so non-ignite builds get no payoff.

audit.poe: Blink that damages enemies on the way and leaves burning ground; shares cooldown with other blinks.
audit.bob: Identical to Quick Step: blink distance 8, cd 3. applyUtility blink code has no damage and no ground effect; fire tags and cast time 0.7 are cosmetic.
audit.repair: Let blink skills deal a spell hit at start/end point and drop a burning ground zone using the existing 'ground' zones.

lines: Movement spell, blink: teleport to a target location (range is a square, ~41% longer diagonally); cast time 0.7 s but instant if not used continuously; mana 8 to 23. [wiki]
Deals fire damage 7-11 (L1) to 479-718 (L20) to enemies it hits, base crit 6%, effectiveness 100%. [wiki][pob]
Leaves a trail of burning ground behind you: 4 s duration, 18.9 to 1262.7 base fire damage per second. [wiki][pob]
Cooldown 3 s with 3 stored uses (three casts before it has to recharge); gains 0-76% increased cooldown recovery with gem level (3.10 cut this to 47%). [wiki]
Shares one cooldown with all Blink skills (Frostblink, Withering Step, Phase-style blinks). [wiki]
spec.check: Audit PoE line holds, but the wiki shows 3 stored uses on a 3 s cooldown (not a single charge), so I added blink_stored_uses; Bob's single-use cd 3 is stingier than the gem. Burning ground is a trail along the path, not only at the end.

audit.poe: Adds fire damage only against burning (ignited) enemies; a payoff for ignite builds, usable on any skill that hits.
audit.bob: Adds fire damage unconditionally to attacks only, plus 20% ignite chance (which creates its own burning enemy). The condition on the target being ignited is gone although the targetIgnited condition exists in the engine, and the gem is restricted to attacks.
audit.repair: Add condition targetIgnited to the damage.min/max mods and drop the attack restriction (data-only).

lines: Supports any skill that hits enemies, attack or spell [wiki]
Supported skills deal added fire damage against Burning enemies only: 42-63 at L1 to 205-308 at L20 [wiki]
Only skills that can hit benefit, not damage over time skills such as Righteous Fire [wiki]
It has no ignite chance of its own, so it depends on ignite from another source [wiki]
spec.check: Holds. The audit repair should also drop Bob's invented 20% ignite chance, which creates the burning target the gem should require, and Bob's flat 3-60 / 5-90 is much smaller than the 3.9 numbers because it is unconditional, so it should be repriced to 42-63 to 205-308.

audit.poe: A holy fire wave that hits in a line, leaves Consecrated Ground (sustain for you) and then sends a larger shockwave that hits enemies standing on it; the fire and consecrated ground combo is the draw.
audit.bob: A burst (radius 2.4) of fire and physical spell damage at the target; the line wave, consecrated ground and follow-up shockwave are dropped, as the port note admits.
audit.repair: Leave a timed ground zone under the target that regenerates the owner's life while standing in it and carries a delayed second burst.

lines: Spell (added in 3.6.0), 0.7 s cast, effectiveness 140%, base crit chance from the gem. Physical spell damage (7-10 at level 1 to 803-1205 at level 20) with 50% converted to fire. [wiki][pob]
A wave of divine fire hits enemies in a line, then creates Consecrated Ground (4 s base) and deals damage in an area around the target location. [wiki]
A larger shockwave then expands outward and hits enemies standing on the Consecrated Ground that were not already hit, at 25% less damage; each enemy takes damage once per cast. [wiki][pob]
Consecrated Ground: you and allies standing on it regenerate an extra 6% of maximum life per second, and hits against enemies on it have 100% increased critical strike chance. [wiki]
Radius +0 to 2 (wave) and +0 to 6 (consecration); mana 6 to 25. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds (line wave, consecrated ground, larger follow-up shockwave); I added the ground's second effect, +100% crit chance against enemies standing on it, and the 25% less / once-per-enemy rule for the shockwave.

audit.poe: Flat-mana reservation aura that gives flat mana regeneration, a cheap fix for mana sustain.
audit.bob: Reserves a flat mana amount by level (reserveFlat) and adds manaRegenFlat, which defence.ts reads (scaled by increased mana regen).

audit.poe: Projectiles deal more damage close up and less far away.
audit.bob: More projectile damage against nearby enemies only; no far-range penalty, so no trade. The engine has a closeQuarters flag and distanceMult (1.5 down to 0.5), unused by the gem.
audit.repair: Grant the closeQuarters flag so the distance curve applies.

lines: Support for projectile skills (attack hits); cost multiplier 120%. [wiki]

Supported skills count as having the Point Blank keystone: projectile attack hits deal up to 30% more damage to targets at the start of their movement, and less damage the farther the projectile travels. [wiki]
Falloff floor is 50% of normal damage at maximum range (since 2.1.0; before that it fell to zero). [wiki]
Also (0-38)% INCREASED projectile damage at all ranges. [wiki][pob]
The wiki text says 'Projectile Attack Hits', so only attack projectiles get the keystone curve (Bob's engine curve is likewise attack-only). [wiki]
spec.check: Audit PoE line holds in spirit. Corrected numbers: the near bonus in 3.9 is up to 30% more (the engine's closeQuarters curve starts at 1.5x, which is the old 50% value), plus a separate 0-38% increased projectile damage; Bob's gem applies 20-38% MORE only to nearby targets, with no far penalty.

audit.poe: Channelled close-range lightning pulses in front of you; every fourth pulse is a larger, stronger one.
audit.bob: Repeated self-centred lightning bursts at 0.25 s cast time with the larger-pulse bonus averaged in as +12% more damage. This is the engine's accepted channel averaging and the average matches (3 normal + 1 at +50%).
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Applies a chaos damage-over-time debuff to enemies in an area; when an affected enemy dies the debuff spreads to nearby enemies, so it snowballs through packs.
audit.bob: A ground cloud at the target (radius 2.5, 5 s, hits every 0.5 s) as direct chaos hits on whoever stands in it. No debuff that stays on the enemy, no spread on death (trigger effects exist only for shock/ignite on item triggers), no spell DoT scaling.
audit.repair: Make the cast apply a timed chaos DoT to enemies in the area, and on death of an affected enemy re-apply it to enemies nearby (extend the kill 'spread' trigger effect to this debuff).

lines: Spell (0.6 s cast) that applies a chaos damage-over-time debuff, 5 s base duration, to every enemy in the area (up to 40 targets per cast). It does not hit. [wiki]
DoT is 3.5 base chaos dps at gem L1 up to 235.9 at L20; spell damage modifiers apply to the DoT. [wiki]
If an affected enemy dies, the debuff spreads to other enemies nearby, using the same remaining duration (not reset). The spread radius equals the skill radius, so area modifiers raise both. [wiki]
A dying enemy that also carries Essence Drain spreads that debuff too, and Contagion spreads no other DoT. [wiki]
Radius is fixed (20 units base, no gain by level since 3.8.0); mana 5 at L1, 20 at L20. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds against the wiki, including the death spread. Added: the spread keeps the remaining duration, and the debuff lives on the enemy (not a ground cloud), which is the part Bob's cloud lacks.

audit.poe: Attack crits trigger the linked spell with a 0.15 s cooldown; the triggered spell costs no mana.
audit.bob: Trigger on crit with the attack tag, cooldown 0.15, castSocketed: spells in the same item become triggered-only and fire on the player's attack crits. Adds a damage bonus PoE lacks.

audit.poe: Projectile attacks: more physical damage and physical/chaos DoT, slower attack.
audit.bob: Same, with the dot bonus applying to all DoT.

audit.poe: Increases critical strike multiplier.
audit.bob: critMulti base added.

audit.poe: A slow, big single-target melee hit with extra stun (threshold reduction), knockback and a 20% chance to deal double damage; picked as the plain heavy-hitter.
audit.bob: Melee single-target hit at 150-190% with +25% stun duration and +25% stun damage, both read by the engine (stunDuration and stunDamage in buildProfile). No double-damage chance (the engine has a doubleDamage stat, unused here) and no knockback anywhere in the engine.
audit.repair: Optional: add a doubleDamage base 20 mod to the gem (engine already reads it); knockback has no engine support and is cosmetic for the bot.

audit.poe: Aura that makes nearby enemies take increased physical damage, starting at 15-19% and ramping to 30-39% over 4 s of exposure. Used by physical builds as a damage multiplier.
audit.bob: Reserves 50% mana for a more physical damage mod on the character (starting value, no ramp). The enemy-debuff form is folded into a self buff; for the character's own damage it plays the same.
audit.repair: Optional: apply it as an enemy vuln so the ramp and minion damage count (existing hexVuln field). Not needed for the spirit.

audit.poe: Hits can blind enemies so they miss you more; a defensive status that does not use your curse slot.
audit.bob: A global hexOnHit.feebleGrip: every hit by any of the character's skills applies a 'less damage dealt' hex. It is an acceptable proxy for the defensive value but shares the single hex slot (BASE_HEX_LIMIT 1, sorted by effect in deriveHexes) with real curses and gets boss/hexWarded reductions, and applies to all the character's skills, not just the supported one.
audit.repair: Add a separate status layer on enemies for blind/maim/flee that does not count against hex limit, scoped to the supported skill; blind could reduce monster accuracy.

lines: Support for any skill that hits enemies; mana multiplier 100%. [wiki]
10% chance to blind enemies on hit; 0% (L1) to 38% (L20) increased blinding duration. [wiki][pob]

Blind reduces the blinded enemy's chance to hit by 50% (since 1.2.0); it affects attacks only, not spells, and does nothing against attackers who cannot evade (Unwavering Stance, Resolute Technique). [wiki]
Blind is a separate status that does not use a curse slot. [memory]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Bob's feebleGrip proxy lands on every hit (original 10%), covers spells too, and takes the single hex slot; the audit's reading that the proxy has acceptable defensive value is fair.

audit.poe: Guard: less physical and elemental damage; consumes up to 5 endurance charges to extend the buff and reduce physical taken further (charges -> safety).
audit.bob: Guard utility (life<60%, 4 s, cd 8): hitTaken more -25..-35. Grit charges are never consumed (no charge-spend primitive exists in sim/charges.ts) and bring no extra benefit.
audit.repair: Add spend_charges_for_effect: on cast, remove held Grit charges to lengthen the buff and deepen the reduction.

lines: Instant Guard spell (cast time 0), base duration 1 s at all levels, 3 s cooldown that does not recover while the buff lasts, shared with other Guard skills (Steelskin, Molten Shell, Bone Armour); mana 21 to 36. [wiki][pob]
Take 25% (L1) to 34% (L20) less elemental damage and 25% (L1) to 35% (L20) less physical damage. [wiki][pob]

Consumes up to 5 Endurance Charges: each charge removed gives a further 15% less physical damage taken (multiplicative, so 5 charges at level 1 is 81.25% less physical) and 20% increased buff duration. [wiki][pob]
Works without charges since 3.7.0 (no more invulnerability window); with 5 charges the buff lasts about 2 s. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Bob's guard (4 s, cd 8, only when life is low, -25..-35% damage taken) is a longer, rarer window than the 1 s base / 3 s cooldown original and never touches the charges.

audit.poe: Larger chill effect, and chilled enemies take increased cold damage scaled by the chill (the main reason to use it).
audit.bob: Only the chill effect increase is present (read in skill.ts). Chills do not make the target take more cold damage.
audit.repair: When the supported skill chills, apply an increased-cold-damage-taken effect to the target tied to the chill.

lines: Support (Cold) added in 3.5.0 for any skill that can chill or create chilling areas; mana multiplier 120%. [wiki]
Supported skills have 25% (L1) to 44% (L20) increased effect of chill. [wiki][pob]
Enemies chilled by the supported skill, or standing in its chilling area, take 10% (L1) to 29% (L20) increased cold damage over time. [wiki][pob]

Those enemies also take increased cold damage (hits and damage over time) equal to the chill's slow amount; chill is capped at 30%, so this is at most +30%. Freeze adds nothing; only the strongest chill counts; chill from flasks does not count. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds; the wiki adds a second part (a fixed 10-29% increased cold damage over time) that the audit did not name, both fall under the same missing primitive.

audit.poe: Lowers the mana multiplier of the supported gems, so a supported skill with many supports costs less.
audit.bob: costMult 0.75 multiplies into the skill's cost along with other supports; the cost is read for the active skill. Auras are never supported by gems in Bob and support multipliers do not raise reservation (DESIGN 2.1), so the aura use of Enlighten is moot by design.

audit.poe: More damage against chilled enemies, more cold DoT, stronger chill, extra freeze chance.
audit.bob: More damage under targetChilled, cold DoT more, chill effect up; the extra freeze chance is dropped (minor).

audit.poe: Smaller area of effect but more area damage.
audit.bob: aoe -30% (radius is the square root) and more area damage; both read.

audit.poe: A brand that attaches to an enemy and periodically drops fiery meteors with a strong ignite bonus until it detaches.
audit.bob: A brand put down at the target that pulses a fire burst (radius 2) every 0.75 s at the nearest enemy in reach for 12 s, with ignite chance and more ignite damage; it does not attach to or follow an enemy but the pulse loop is intact.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Seals accumulate over time while you are not casting and are spent to repeat the spell; best on slow, long-delay spells, no benefit if you cast quickly.
audit.bob: One repeat on every use at less damage. The seal accumulation (repeats limited by idle time) is replaced by a constant, so fast spells repeat as much as slow ones.
audit.repair: Make the repeat count depend on time since the last cast (seals per 0.9 s, capped), applied in the sim.

lines: Support for spells: the spell gains a Seal every 0.9 s (L1) to 0.71 s (L20) while not being cast, to a maximum of 3 Seals. [wiki][pob]

On the next cast all Seals are spent and the spell's effect reoccurs once per Seal lost, in rapid succession while the character stands still; the reoccurrences are not casts, so on-cast effects do not trigger. [wiki]
Only the reoccurrences deal 35% (L1) to 26% (L20) less damage; the original cast is at full damage. Mana multiplier 140%. [wiki][pob]
Cannot support skills with cooldowns, triggered, Brand, Vaal, channelling or mana-reserving skills, or skills used by totems, traps or mines. [wiki]
Benefit per cast falls as casting speed rises (no seals when casting back to back). [wiki]
spec.check: Corrected, small: the audit's PoE line holds, but the damage penalty applies only to the reoccurrences while Bob's more-damage mod appears to apply to the whole supported skill (not checked in the engine), so the original cast is likely penalised too; added as a missing primitive. Seals and the time-since-last-cast rule are as the audit says.

audit.poe: A chance for one to three extra traps or mines on each throw, no damage penalty.
audit.bob: Guaranteed +1 deployCount with 15% less damage, replacing the chance-for-extra roll; the port note says as much. Expected deployments are similar at higher levels; the penalty is an invented drawback.

audit.poe: A trap whose beams chill and deal cold damage over time to up to ten enemies and give you large life and mana regeneration for each enemy affected, a sustain trap.
audit.bob: A cold ground zone that chills and hits for 3 s with a flat 1% life leech; the per-enemy life and mana regeneration (hundreds a second at high level) is reduced to leech on weak damage, so the sustain is negligible.
audit.repair: Add a timed owner life/mana regen that scales with the number of enemies inside the zone, in place of the 1% leech.

lines: Trap spell with a 4 s cooldown and one stored use at a time; trap lasts 4 s and fires on enemy trigger or at expiry; added in 3.3.0 [wiki][pob]

On firing it tethers debuff beams to the closest 10 enemies for a base 3 s; each beam chills the enemy (the wiki gives no chill magnitude, only +1% chill effect per quality) and deals cold damage over time, 15.5 base cold dps at L1 to 426.3 at L20, scaled by spell damage modifiers [wiki]
Gives the owner regeneration (not leech; players cannot leech through traps): 1.3 to 32.4 life/s and 0.3 to 1.7 mana/s for EACH affected enemy [wiki]

Plus a flat regeneration while at least one enemy is affected: 12.7 to 324.4 life/s and 2.9 to 17.2 mana/s. At L20 this flat part equals ten per-enemy beams, so the sustain does not depend on a crowd [wiki]
A beam also attaches to the owner as the visual of the regen; the beams end when the 3 s effect ends [wiki]
Mana 7 at L1 to 24 at L20 [pob]
spec.check: Partly corrected: the audit says regen scales with the number of enemies, but 3.9 gives a flat while-any-enemy-affected regen (12.7-324 life/s) as large as ten per-enemy beams plus a smaller per-enemy part; the repair must model both, cap at 10 targets, and replace (not add to) the 1% leech since traps cannot leech in PoE.

audit.poe: A slow orb that zaps every enemy around it many times a second as it drifts through a pack; cheap, multi-hit lightning.
audit.bob: A ground zone placed at the target (radius 2.2, 2 s, pulses every 0.4 s) hitting everything inside with low-effectiveness lightning, 10% shock. It does not move and does not follow the aim line, and the projectile-count supports are inert on it (skill.ts reads projectile count only for projectile behaviours).
audit.repair: Optional: let a ground zone carry a velocity so the orb drifts, and let projectile-count mods spawn extra zones.

audit.poe: Stance toggled by recasting (2 s cooldown): Blood gives melee 10-15% more area damage and 5% less AoE, Sand gives 10-15% more AoE and 5% less area damage, so you pick damage or reach and swap as the fight changes.
audit.bob: Free always-on buff of more melee-area damage with no cost, no AoE side and no toggle. Port note says the stances are averaged. The mod needs both melee and area tags on the skill.
audit.repair: Model two stances (damage-vs-AoE) with an auto-swap policy (for example Blood vs bosses and tight packs, Sand vs wide packs) and give each its trade-off.

lines: Instant stance toggle, 2 s cooldown (0-50% increased cooldown recovery by level), reserves 10% mana; reusing it alternates Blood and Sand. The stance is shared with Flesh and Stone. [wiki]
Blood Stance: melee skills deal (10-15)% more AREA damage and have 5% less area of effect. [wiki]
Sand Stance: melee skills have (10-15)% more AREA OF EFFECT and deal 5% less area damage. [wiki]
The gem only goes to level 6 in 3.9, so the range is 10 to 15 (the pob L20 value of 27 is not reachable). [wiki][pob]
Some skills (for example Bladestorm) behave differently depending on the stance. [wiki]
spec.check: Audit PoE line holds (10-15% numbers, 5% penalties, 2 s toggle); corrected only to add the 10% mana reservation and the max gem level 6 cap, which the audit omitted. Bob's always-on 5-12% more melee area damage with no toggle and no cost remains gutted.

audit.poe: A melee strike also strikes two extra nearby targets at once (not the same enemy); it extends a strike skill's reach across a pack and adds nothing against a single target.
audit.bob: repeats +2 at slightly less damage. Echoes re-fire at the same targetId a moment later, and a non-arc melee strike only hits that one target, so against a single enemy it is a triple hit (like Multistrike) and never reaches other enemies. The sheet counts 1+repeats lands. The use case is inverted.
audit.repair: Implement a hit-spreading effect: on a strike, also hit up to two other enemies near the target (excluding the target), instead of repeats.

lines: Supports melee Strike skills (not triggered skills); minion skills are supported but do not strike extra targets [wiki]

The supported strike also hits 2 additional nearby enemies simultaneously, automatically picked from valid targets in range; the extra targets must be a minimum distance from the user (value not given) [wiki][pob]
With only one enemy present nothing extra happens: it cannot hit the same target again [wiki]
Deals 19% (L1) down to 0% (L20) less Damage [wiki]
Crit is rolled once for the strikes [wiki]
spec.check: Holds: the wiki says the gem strikes two additional nearby enemies at once, and works only for melee single-target strikes. Bob's repeats on the same target invert the use case, as the audit says; the less-damage range 19 to 0 does match.

audit.poe: Spell repeats once, with a cast-speed bonus and slightly less damage; the repeat costs no extra mana.
audit.bob: repeats +1 is read by the sim (updateAction fires the spell again 0.25 of the use time later, no extra cost); castSpeed -20% and damage -10% pay for it. Net DPS gain is similar to PoE. Triggered spells do not repeat. No totem/trap exclusion.

audit.poe: More elemental damage with attacks.
audit.bob: Same more multiplier for elemental types.

audit.poe: Minions gain elemental resistances and max resistance, deal more elemental damage, and apply exposure to enemies on hit.
audit.bob: Only minionDamage more (all damage types, not just elemental). minionBody has fixed resistances per kind and no support modifies them; no exposure on minion hits. The port note's 'shrug off elements' is not implemented.
audit.repair: Pass minion resistance mods into minionBody and apply a resistance-lowering hex on minion hits.

lines: Minions from supported skills get +19 to 29% to all elemental resistances. [wiki][pob]
They deal 20 to 29% more Elemental Damage, which does not cover physical or chaos. [wiki][pob]
They inflict Exposure on hit: -10% to the elemental resistance matching the highest damage type the enemy has taken. [wiki][pob]
They also get +0 to 2% to all maximum elemental resistances (+2% at level 20). [wiki]
The mana multiplier is 130% (3.8.0). It supports minions only and no longer supports totems. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds, but I added two items to the missing list. The 'more' multiplier is elemental-only, whereas Bob's minionDamage more applies to all damage types. The gem also raises maximum elemental resistances (+0 to 2%). Bob's multiplier size (20 to 29%) and its 1.3 cost multiplier match.

audit.poe: A golem that grants you increased damage and throws fire.
audit.bob: One ranged fire golem; the owner gains 15-20% increased damage (always on).
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Arrows are shot into the air and rain on a target area, each landing as a small fire explosion; physical is converted to fire with fire penetration.
audit.bob: Ground zone at the target with a 0.6 s delay and one pulse at 150-180% (the stacked small explosions folded into one), 100% physical to fire and 15-25% fire penetration, both read by the engine.
audit.repair: None.

audit.poe: Flaming bolts rain over a target area for about 2 s, each exploding on landing.
audit.bob: Ground zone at the target (radius 2.6, 2 s, pulses every 0.25 s = 8 hits) with fire spells at low effectiveness and a wide damage spread.
audit.repair: None.

audit.poe: Gain a share of physical damage as extra fire.
audit.bob: Gain physical as fire, handled by the conversion/gain pipeline (supports attacks only).

audit.poe: Aura giving a large fire resistance bonus and raising maximum fire resistance (up to +4).
audit.bob: Reserves 35% mana for resist.fire and maxResist.fire, both read by defence.ts.

audit.poe: Raises the level of the supported gem.
audit.bob: levelBonus is read in character.ts and applied to the skill's level.

audit.poe: More burning (ignite) damage.
audit.bob: More ignite-tagged damage, which reaches ignite damage.

audit.poe: An ancestor totem melee-strikes nearby enemies and, while you stand near it, gives you more attack speed; you pick it to fight beside a totem and turn positioning into a damage bonus.
audit.bob: Placing it puts an invulnerable totem 1.5 tiles toward the target that strikes with your weapon (src/sim/deploy.ts shoot); the owner attack-speed bonus is dropped (mods is empty), so it is just a free extra melee hitter while the character also fights.
audit.repair: Add a 'near own totem' condition (a standing deployable of this skill within ~7 tiles) and give the owner the more-attack-speed mod on it.

lines: Attack totem, mana 8, cast time 1.0 s, 50% increased placement speed; totem lasts 12 s; strikes with your weapon at single targets, 90-144% of base attack damage, +16-18 melee range. [wiki][pob]
The totem is only ACTIVE while you stay within 85 units of it (about 7-8 tiles at Bob's scale); first activation also needs line of sight. [wiki]
While the totem is active you get (10-20)% MORE attack speed; the bonus does not stack across several totems. [wiki]
Cannot be supported by Multistrike; Melee Splash makes it hit several; can be used unarmed. [wiki]
spec.check: Audit PoE line holds, but it missed that the totem itself only attacks while you are near it (not just the buff). I added deployable_activation_range: Bob's totem always strikes, which is a second drift from the gem.

audit.poe: A slam that damages an area and then erupts again as a large aftershock after a short delay.
audit.bob: A slam burst (radius 2.4) at 85-120% with a flat +70% more damage; the aftershock is folded into the one hit rather than a second eruption, even though a ground zone with a delay is supported (Ember Downpour uses it). Total damage is about two thirds of the PoE sum and enemies are hit once.
audit.repair: Add a second burst on the same spot after a short delay (a ground behaviour with delay and two pulses) instead of the flat more-damage mod.

lines: Melee slam (axe, mace, sceptre or staff), attack speed -25%, mana 10: initial hit at 85-120% of base attack damage in the initial radius (18 units). [wiki]
After a 1 s base delay (scaled by duration modifiers) the crack erupts in an aftershock with a larger radius (28 units). [wiki]
The aftershock is a second real hit: the same attack damage with 70% more damage with hits and ailments, plus 30-46 up to 169-254 added physical damage by gem level. [wiki]
The initial hit has no more-damage bonus. Only the first quake's aftershock fires if quakes are stacked before it erupts. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Added detail: the aftershock is a separate hit with a bigger radius, added physical damage, and the +70% bonus applies only to the aftershock, whereas Bob puts the +70% on the one initial hit.

audit.poe: Cast curse that reduces enemy damage dealt, accuracy and critical strike chance and multiplier, a defensive curse against hard hitters.
audit.bob: Hex-kind gem usable only via Hexing Strikes on hit. Only the less damage dealt effect is real (damageMult in applyHit); accuracy, crit chance and crit multiplier reduction are missing.
audit.repair: Make it castable and add accuracy and crit penalties on cursed monsters.

lines: Cast area curse (radius +0 to +7 by L20), lasts 9 s (L1) to 10.9 s (L20); mana 16 to 33 [wiki][pob]
Cursed Normal and Magic enemies deal 21% (L1) to 30% (L20) less Damage; Rare and Unique enemies deal 10% to 15% less (3.6.0) [wiki]
Cursed enemies have 10% to 19% reduced Accuracy Rating, 25% reduced Critical Strike Chance at all levels, and -21% to -30% Critical Strike Multiplier [wiki]
All effects of Enfeeble are capped at 75% [wiki]
spec.check: Holds: damage, accuracy, crit chance and crit multiplier reductions are all in the wiki; I added the rarity split (normal/magic hit harder reduction than rare/unique) to the missing list.

audit.poe: Aura giving more spell damage and increased spell crit chance, plus a 10% chance on hit vs rare/unique to create Consecrated Ground (8 s) that regenerates life for standing allies and weakens curses on them.
audit.bob: Reserves 50% mana for more spell damage and inc spell crit chance (tags subset check works). The consecrated ground (a defensive ground effect and an offensive-aura rider) is dropped; the engine has no ground-effect conditions.
audit.repair: Add a small on-hit chance vs rare/unique that grants a timed life-regen buff (self_buff_on_use style), standing in for the consecrated ground.

lines: Aura reserving mana, no damage of its own: you and nearby allies deal 10-15% more spell damage and have 20-39% increased spell critical strike chance. [wiki]
Rider: you and nearby non-minion allies have a 10% chance to create consecrated ground, lasting 8 s, when hitting a Rare or Unique enemy. [wiki]
Consecrated ground gives +6% of maximum life regeneration per second and 100% increased crit chance for hits against enemies on it. [wiki]
Radius +0..19 by gem level; the aura has a 1.2 s cooldown on casting. [wiki]
spec.check: Corrected: the verdict moves from drifted to faithful because both defining effects (more spell damage, increased spell crit chance) survive and only the 10% rider vs rares/uniques is dropped (still optional). The 3.9 wiki says nothing about the ground weakening curses, so that part of the audit line is unconfirmed [memory] and is dropped.

audit.poe: Lay several extra mines per throw at a large laying-speed penalty and no damage penalty.
audit.bob: deployCount +4 and much slower cast/attack speed; no damage penalty, as in PoE. Mines are laid in a ring and auto-detonate near enemies.

audit.poe: A trap that sends rotating flames in several directions for a few seconds, hitting repeatedly and dealing more damage to burning enemies.
audit.bob: A ground line of fire from the trap toward the triggering enemy that hits every 0.35 s for 3.5 s with +25% damage versus ignited targets; the four-way rotation is reduced to one line and the ignite condition is read once at trigger time.
audit.repair: None required; optionally spawn several line zones at different angles.

audit.poe: Strength's melee damage bonus also applies to projectile attacks.
audit.bob: Only some inc projectile damage. The engine has a 'strongarm' flag that does exactly this (character.ts), but the gem does not grant it.
audit.repair: Give the support the strongarm flag as a global mod.

lines: Supports projectile attack skills; the user is treated as having the Iron Grip keystone for the supported skill only, and it does not stack with the keystone [wiki]
Strength's damage bonus (+1% increased physical damage per 5 Strength) then also applies to physical damage of the supported skill's Projectile Attacks; only the physical part is increased [wiki]
Also gives 0% (L1) to 38% (L20) increased Projectile Damage [wiki][pob]
spec.check: Holds. Bob already has the increased projectile damage half (0-38); the Strength half is missing. The engine strongarm flag is applied globally in the attribute step (character.ts), so a support-scoped version needs a per-skill grant, not just setting that flag.

audit.poe: A fire projectile that explodes on the first thing it hits for area damage, with an ignite chance.
audit.bob: Projectile with explodeRadius 1.2: on first contact it explodes and hits every enemy in the radius (explode() in actions.ts), 25% ignite chance, 240% effectiveness.
audit.repair: None.

audit.poe: The area spell also lands beside the target on both sides, widening the covered ground; no extra damage to a single target.
