audit.bob: repeats +2 on the same target spot at less damage and a smaller area. The echoes land at the same place a moment later, so it is a three-times repeat (like Spell Echo) rather than a spatial spread; lateral coverage is gone and single-target damage rises.
audit.repair: Replace repeats with two extra instances of the area offset to either side of the target.

lines: Supports spell skills that apply an effect to an area around a targeted location; not Vaal, minion, totem, trap or mine skills; works with triggered spells since 3.6.2 [wiki]
The spell also affects the areas in front of and behind the targeted area, one cascade each side by PoB, so three areas in total (along the cast line, not beside the target) [wiki][pob]
Supported skills have 25% (L1) to 16% (L20) less Area of Effect [wiki]
Supported skills deal 40% (L1) to 21% (L20) less Damage [wiki]
Inference: the areas are offset, so one target is hit again only where they overlap and gains little extra damage [memory, fairly sure]
spec.check: Mostly holds, but the wiki says the extra areas land in front of and behind the target along the cast direction, not beside it, so the audit's 'both sides' is corrected for the repair; also the area penalty is 25 to 16% less, not Bob's flat -20% increased, and triggered spells are allowed.

audit.poe: Consumes a corpse to give your minions attack, cast and movement speed, with more corpses extending it.
audit.bob: A rally-policy buff on the character: 20-30% attack/cast speed and 20-29% move speed for 8 s; the corpse is unused and minions do not receive it.
audit.repair: Apply the speed buff to minions and add corpse-based extension. Unsure whether the real effect also covers the player.

lines: Consumes a corpse and up to 4 more around it. Cast time 1.0 s, mana 16 at level 1, 33 at level 20. [wiki][pob]
Base duration is 5 s, plus 1 s for each extra corpse, so 9 s at most. [wiki]
It gives your minions 20 to 30% increased attack speed, 20 to 29% increased movement speed and 20 to 30% increased cast speed. [wiki][pob]
Only one offering can be active per player. Casting another cancels the older one. [wiki]
The buff goes to minions, not to the character. [wiki]
The gem deals no damage and has no cooldown. [pob]
spec.check: The audit's uncertainty is resolved: the 3.9 wiki gives the effect to minions only, which makes Bob's character buff the wrong recipient. I added single_active_offering. Bob's speed values match. The missing pieces are the corpse (which sets the duration), the minion recipient and the one-at-a-time rule. I kept drifted because the timed minion-buff shape and the stat values still match; the missing parts are the recipient and the corpse-driven duration.

audit.poe: Channelled dagger/claw/sword flurry that stacks up damage while you hold it, then releases extra hits per stage when you stop; the build-up and release is the loop.
audit.bob: A plain melee area arc (120 degrees, radius 1.8) at an averaged 90-126% per hit, with the channelling tag inert in the engine. Both the stack-up and the release hits are gone, so what is left is a wide fast arc without the ramp-and-release trade; no weapon restriction either.
audit.repair: Give an area melee skill a stage counter that grows damage per consecutive use and pays out extra hits on a reset (stand-in for channel then release).

lines: Channelled melee attack, Dagger, Claw or one-handed Sword only; while the key is held it repeatedly strikes a random enemy in front of you, damaging that enemy and those around it (dual wield alternates hands). Mana is paid again on every strike. [wiki]
Base hit is 32-45% of base attack damage (L1-L20) plus added physical, at a 60% attack speed bonus. [wiki][pob]
Stages: each strike while channelling adds one stage, 20% more damage per stage, up to 6 stages (+120%); the strike that reaches a stage does not get its own bonus yet. [wiki]

Release: when channelling ends you unleash one extra strike per stage reached, each at the full stage bonus. Build-up plus release averages 1.10x (1 stage) to 1.85x (6 stages) per strike, and the release is about half the damage. [wiki]
Stun, death or running out of mana ends the channel; on-use triggers fire only once at the start; Multistrike cannot support it. [wiki]
Added in 2.4.2; 3.7 widened the target-acquiring radius while channelling (+29%) and after it ends (+47%). [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds: stage build-up (20% more per stage, cap 6) and one extra strike per stage on release are exactly the loop, and Bob has neither. Minor: Bob also has no weapon restriction (dagger/claw/one-hand sword); the number of release strikes equals the stages reached, so release size is the main payoff.
spec.decision: Channelled gems need a 'hold then let go' that Bob's AI cannot perform. May the stand-in be: the character keeps striking the current target, gaining a stage per strike, and releases automatically when the stage cap is reached, the target dies or changes, or after a lull (and the same rule for the other channel gems)?

audit.poe: More spell damage in exchange for losing critical strikes.
audit.bob: More spell damage and -100% inc crit chance, which the crit multiplier turns into zero crit chance unless other increases stack.

audit.poe: More poison damage, and hits deal more per poison stack on the target, up to a cap.
audit.bob: More poison damage plus a flat 12% under targetPoisoned; no per-stack scaling, contrary to the port note.
audit.repair: Make the hit bonus scale with the target's poison count up to a cap.

lines: Support (120% mana multiplier): supported skills deal 30-49% more damage with poison. [wiki]
Supported skills deal 5% more damage with hits for each poison on the enemy, up to 6-9 poisons (max 30-45% more). [wiki]
Added in 3.0.0; no later change through 3.9. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds against the wiki, including the cap (6 at L1, 9 at L20, 5% per poison). Bob's flat 12% under targetPoisoned is a stand-in.

audit.poe: Longer ailment duration, more ailment damage, stronger shock/chill and non-damaging ailments.
audit.bob: Duration and damage for ignite, bleed, poison only; non-damaging ailment effect and shock/chill duration are not included (the engine has the stats).
audit.repair: Add effect.shock/effect.chill/duration.shock stats.

lines: Supports any skill that hits enemies [wiki]
35% (L1) to 54% (L20) increased Duration of all Ailments on enemies [wiki]
25% to 34% more Damage with Ailments [wiki]
25% to 34% increased Effect of non-damaging Ailments on enemies (shock, chill and similar) [wiki]
Values raised in 3.8.0 [wiki]
spec.check: Holds: the wiki lists all three effects. Bob covers more ailment damage and the poison, ignite and bleed durations; shock, chill and freeze duration and the non-damaging effect bonus are missing, and I added the duration of the non-damaging ailments to the missing list.

audit.poe: Minion hits can give you a Puppet Master buff; while you have it minions deal more damage; minions aggro from further away.
audit.bob: Averaged into permanent minion damage and a flat minion speed. The buff's uptime from minion hits is not modelled, but in PoE uptime is high when minions fight, so the net is similar. The aggro radius bonus is irrelevant because minions seek enemies 14 tiles away anyway.

audit.poe: More damage while at full life.
audit.bob: More damage under onFullLife.

audit.poe: 15% freeze, added cold damage that grows with frenzy charges, and charge gain when killing a frozen enemy.
audit.bob: 15% freeze, flat added cold, and a chance to gain Fervour on any kill. The cold does not grow with charges (despite the port note) and the kill need not be of a frozen enemy.
audit.repair: Add cold damage per Fervour charge and restrict the charge to kills of frozen enemies.

lines: Support (Cold) for any skill you use to hit enemies yourself; cannot support totems, traps or mines; mana multiplier 130% (reworked in 3.0.0). [wiki]
15% chance to freeze at every level. [wiki][pob]
Adds 8-12 cold damage at level 1 up to 69-103 at level 20, and additionally 2-3 (L1) up to 15-23 (L20) cold damage per Frenzy Charge held. [wiki][pob]
50% (L1) to 69% (L20) chance to gain a Frenzy Charge on killing a frozen enemy (only frozen victims). [wiki][pob]
Quality bonus applies only to hits on frozen targets. At level 20 the per-charge scaling beats Added Cold Damage once about 7 charges are held. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. I dropped per_charge_added_damage from the missing list: Bob already has 'per: charges.<kind>' on damage.min/max (Discharge), so it is a data edit; the second half of the original (a flat piece plus a per-charge piece) only needs a second mod. The kill condition is a real gap: sim/charges.ts rolls chargeOn.kill for every kill without looking at the victim.

audit.poe: Aura (50% reserved) giving 16-25% of physical damage as extra cold plus 14-18% more cold damage; the more-cold multiplier makes it good for non-physical cold builds too.
audit.bob: Reserves 50% mana and adds gain.physical.cold (read by convertChunks, so it works). No more-cold-damage multiplier.
audit.repair: Add a more cold damage mod (damageTypes cold) to the aura.

lines: Instant aura reserving mana (50 in PoB data), affects you and nearby allies; radius +0 to +19 by L20 [wiki][pob]
You gain 16% (L1) to 25% (L20) of physical damage as extra cold damage [wiki]
You also deal 14% (L1) to 18% (L20) more Cold Damage (added 3.6.0); the more multiplier applies to the extra cold as well, so the effective conversion is about 29.5% at L20 [wiki]
Applies to attacks and spells; traps and minions only if they are inside the aura when they attack [wiki]
spec.check: Holds: 16-25% physical as extra cold and 14-18% more cold damage are both in the 3.9 wiki and PoB; Bob has the extra-cold half (10-19) and lacks the more-cold multiplier.

audit.poe: Two spears that change into a much faster piercing second form with a huge critical-strike chance and multiplier boost; the crit-based second form is why crit casters use it.
audit.bob: A single piercing cold projectile (pierce 99, one projectile) whose damage falls to 50% with distance (behaviour.falloff 0.5, applied in distanceMult), the opposite of Ice Spear's gain in the second form. No form change, no crit boost, no second spear.
audit.repair: Add a behaviour field for a second form (after N tiles the projectile gains crit chance/multiplier and speed) instead of the falloff, and a second spear.

lines: Spell, projectile, cold; cast time 0.7 s, base crit 7%, damage effectiveness 80%; fires a rapid sequence of 2 spears (1 additional projectile, fired in sequence, not a simultaneous fan). [wiki]
Two forms. First form: slow, no natural pierce. After a preset short distance it instantly changes to the second form. [wiki]
Second form: 300% more projectile speed, pierces every target, 600% increased crit chance (7% base becomes ~49%), plus +30% (L1) to +49% (L20) critical strike multiplier. [wiki][pob]
Full spell damage in either form; the second form does not fork or chain. Projectile speed does not move the form-change distance. [wiki]
Net effect: strong at long range, deliberately weak at close range (wiki: 'substantially weaker when used at close range'). [wiki]
Damage 22-33 cold at L1 to 383-575 at L20; mana 8 to 23. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds (two spears, faster piercing second form, big crit boost); the wiki adds that the FIRST form does not pierce and the second form's crit is +600% increased chance plus extra multiplier. Bob's pierce-99 projectile with 50% falloff is indeed the inverse of the gem (strongest early, weak late), so drifted stands.

audit.poe: A bow arrow that converts some physical to cold on the target and all physical to cold in a cone behind it, with strong chill.
audit.bob: Bow arrow that explodes in radius 1.4 at impact with 60% cold conversion and +100-195% chill effect (read). The cone behind the target becomes a circular area at the impact.
audit.repair: None.

audit.poe: A nova of cold from the caster that does extra cold damage to chilled enemies; it can also be cast on Frostbolts for a combo.
audit.bob: Self-centred burst (radius 3.2) with added cold damage conditional on targetChilled (the condition is real). The Frostbolt combo is absent.
audit.repair: Optional: let this burst originate at the projectiles of Glacier Dart.

audit.poe: A big slam that hits the area three times in expanding stages, each slightly weaker, half converted to cold.
audit.bob: A single slam burst (radius 2.4) at 190-240% with 50% cold conversion and a 10% less-damage malus standing in for the stages. Only one hit lands instead of three, so total damage is lower and the stage radii are absent.
audit.repair: Optional: three pulses with growing radius and decaying damage on a ground/burst behaviour.

audit.poe: A trap that detonates in icy blasts dealing cold area damage to everything caught in it.
audit.bob: A trap that goes off when an enemy steps within range and bursts for 150% effectiveness cold damage in a radius of 2.4.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Aura giving cold resistance and raising maximum cold resistance.
audit.bob: Reserves 35% mana for resist.cold and maxResist.cold, both read by defence.ts.

audit.poe: Hits penetrate cold resistance.
audit.bob: Penetration cold, read by the damage calculation.

audit.poe: Channel up to 10 stages to build one huge, wide fire explosion released when you stop; commitment (standing and charging) for a big boom is the whole identity.
audit.bob: A self-centred fire burst (radius 3.2) every 0.5 s at 110% effectiveness with 15% ignite. There is no charge-up, no growing radius or damage, no release; it is a fast fire nova.
audit.repair: Add a charge-up where consecutive uses on the same position stack stages (radius and damage) and a single big burst fires after N stages or on a lull.

lines: Channelled fire spell, cast time 0.2 s, crit 5%, effectiveness 60%: every cast tick adds a stage up to 10 (2 s at base cast speed; faster casting reaches it sooner). Channelled skills pay the mana cost again each tick. [wiki][pob]
Release (key up, or reaching the cap) fires one explosion about 0.5 s later; damage and area both grow with stages. [wiki]
Damage: 110% more spell damage per stage (10.9x base at stage 10), 90% more ailment damage per stage, +5% ignite chance per stage. [wiki][pob]
Radius in 3.9 is a base 5 plus 2 per stage (3.10 changed it to 2 plus 3). [wiki]
Totems stop channelling on their own at max stacks, or release when the totem dies or expires; cannot be triggered, nor used with traps or mines unless also totemed. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds; 10 stages, one wide explosion on release and standing still to charge it are the identity, and Bob has none of it (a fast fire nova with 15% ignite). The ignite chance in the gem scales by stage (+5% each) rather than a flat 15%.
spec.decision: Charging is a 2 s commitment (10 stages). Should Bob's AI always charge to the full 10 stages before releasing, or release early when the target dies or a monster is about to reach the character?

audit.poe: Melee hits grant Rage (with a 0.4 s gain cooldown); rage gives added physical damage per 10 rage to the supported skill and the general rage bonuses; decays out of combat.
audit.bob: rageOn.meleeHit 1 per melee hit feeds the engine's rage count (cap 50, decays after 4 s, +1% attack damage, +0.5% attack speed, +0.2% move speed per point). Loop is recognisable. Lost: the 0.4 s per-gain cooldown (an arc hitting five enemies gives five rage) and the skill-specific added-damage-per-rage.

audit.poe: Arrows stick into the target and explode after a fuse; several stuck arrows are consumed by the first explosion, adding their damage and radius, so you shoot a stack and watch it go off. Ignite bonus per stack.
audit.bob: A bow arrow that explodes in radius 1.8 at once with fire conversion and added fire. The sticking, the fuse timer, the stack consumption and the per-stack bonuses are gone, so it is a fire arrow with an explosion.
audit.repair: Let the arrow attach to its target and explode after a timer, with the first explosion absorbing the other stuck arrows' damage and radius.

lines: Bow attack. The arrow sticks into the enemy it hits (or into terrain/wall) and explodes after a 1 s base fuse; a pierced or evaded target gets no arrow. Duration modifiers change the fuse. [wiki][pob]
The explosion is area fire projectile damage: 50% of base weapon damage plus added fire (47-71 to 522-783 across levels). Crit and ignite are decided by the arrow that explodes. [wiki][pob]

Further arrows stuck in the same enemy do not start new fuses or refresh the timer; the first one to explode consumes all the others and adds their damage (each with its own crit roll) to its explosion. [wiki]

Each arrow on the target adds +2 explosion radius, up to +10 (level 1) to +19 (level 20) in 3.9, and 3% more damage with ignite per arrow. (The 20-arrow cap, +12 radius cap and 3% more hit damage are 3.10 changes, not 3.9.) [wiki][pob]
Mana 8 to 10; base explosion radius 15. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB (stick, fuse, consumption, radius and ignite per stack). Note the page was edited for 3.10 before 2020-03-12, so the 3.9.0 version-history block, not the page head, is the 3.9 rule set.

audit.poe: Half of physical becomes lightning plus extra.
audit.bob: convertSkill/gain physical to lightning.

audit.poe: A fan of ten physical knives cast in an arc; strong clear that shotguns up close.
audit.bob: Spell projectile fan of 10 over 80 degrees at 120% effectiveness. The shared per-use hit list means a lone target takes one knife, so the point-blank shotgun is absent, but the wide fan itself is intact.
audit.repair: None (engine-wide single-target dedupe).

audit.poe: Throws a spectral copy of your shield whose damage scales with the shield's armour and evasion, shattering on impact into shards that fly in all directions; the build-around for shield defences.
audit.bob: Needs a shield, then fires a nine-shard physical fan over 120 degrees with flat added damage by gem level. Nothing reads the shield's defences (the port note says it scales with them; the gem has no such mod), and the shatter is a forward fan, not a burst from the impact point.
audit.repair: Add added physical damage per N of shield armour and evasion (the shield stats are already computed in character.ts) and make the shards fan out from the first impact.

lines: Attack that needs a shield (can be used with a wand or unarmed main hand). Throws a spectral copy of the shield as one projectile that cannot pierce (it can chain and fork). [wiki][pob]

Damage is off-hand: 18-27 (level 1) to 182-272 (level 20) base physical plus 2 to 3 added physical per 15 armour or evasion rating on the shield; off-hand attack time 0.7 s to 0.6 s; base crit 5% plus 0.1% per 10 shield energy shield. [wiki][pob]

When it collides with something it shatters into 8 (level 1) to 13 (level 20) smaller shard projectiles fired in all directions, which pierce and deal 25% less damage. Extra-projectile modifiers add shards, not shields. [wiki][pob]
Shard distance scales with projectile speed; bonuses to the shield's defences from the passive tree do not raise the damage. Cannot be supported by Ranged Attack Totem. [wiki]
Mana 7 to 10. [pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB. Add the first stage: a single non-piercing shield projectile hits first, and the shards (25% less damage) burst from where it lands.

audit.poe: A slow, piercing cold projectile; its slowness also lets Ice Nova be cast on the bolts.

audit.repair: Optional: a per-skill projectile speed value.

audit.poe: Creates a wall of ice that blocks enemy movement and damages and pushes back those under it; used for crowd control and kiting.
audit.bob: A 5-tile line ground zone lasting 3 s, pulsing cold damage with a 15% freeze chance. It damages but does not block or push, so only the freeze chance stands in for control.
audit.repair: Let a ground line act as terrain monsters path around (or are held by), plus an outward push on pulse.

lines: Cold spell, 0.5 s cast, 3 s cooldown (not bypassable; it was 5 s before 2.0.2). [wiki][pob]
Creates a wall of ice: wall sections appear every 0.15 s along a line 28 (level 1) to 56 (level 20) units long, lasting 3 s (level 1) to 4.9 s (level 20). [wiki][pob]
The wall is impassable and indestructible: monsters, players and most projectiles cannot cross it. The caster's own projectiles and teleport/leap skills pass through. [wiki]
Targets under the wall take cold damage (8-12 at level 1 to 462-693 at level 20) and are pushed back. [wiki][pob]
Mana 9 to 33. The 3.9 gem has no freeze chance. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds, but the 3 s cooldown is part of the loop and Bob's gem has none, so I added skill_cooldown to the missing list; Bob's 15% freeze chance is not in the 3.9 gem.

audit.poe: Crits give a power charge; more damage per power charge.
audit.bob: chargeOn.crit.insight with per-charge more damage reading held charges.

audit.poe: Always bleeds the target; the bleed lasts 8 s (skill duration, so duration mods scale it) with a 30-49% more bleed damage bonus; a long-bleed applicator for bows, daggers, claws and swords.
audit.bob: 100% bleed chance and bleed-tagged more damage are real, but there is no duration modifier, so the bleed uses the base 5 s (BLEED_DURATION) - the port note's 'eight seconds' is not implemented. It is always a range-9 projectile, even with a dagger or claw.
audit.repair: Add a duration.bleed increase (about +60%) to the gem and let skill-duration mods feed bleed duration; make the stab a melee hit when a melee weapon is held.

lines: Attack with a bow, dagger, claw or sword (one- or two-handed): a projectile attack with a bow, a melee strike with a melee weapon. 135% (level 1) to 165% (level 20) of base attack damage plus (3-75) to (4-113) added attack physical. [wiki][pob]
Always causes bleeding. The bleed lasts 8 s base and is affected by skill effect duration modifiers (unlike other bleeds). [wiki][pob]
(30-49)% more damage with bleeding. As with all bleed, the damage is higher while the target moves. [wiki][pob]
Attack speed multiplier 70% (30% slower); +0 to 2 melee range; mana 6. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB: 100% bleed, 8 s scaling with skill duration, 30-49% more bleed damage.

audit.poe: Reduces enemy block, spell block and dodge chances, and applies Overpowered to enemies that blocked; the counter to blocking enemies.
audit.bob: Only a flat accuracy bonus for the skill. Enemy block exists in the engine (blockChance in calc/combat.ts, a monster with blockSpell 40, shield-bearers) but the accuracy mod does not touch it; it is Additional Accuracy under the old name.
audit.repair: Add a profile stat that lowers the target's block chances (and an Overpowered stack when a blocked hit occurs); hook is in blockChance().

lines: Support for any skill that hits enemies; recipe-only, aimed at PvP; mana multiplier 100% (no extra cost since 1.3.0). [wiki]
Enemies have 10% (L1) to 20% (L20) reduced chance to block attack or spell damage from supported skills. [wiki][pob]
Enemies have 20% (L1) to 29% (L20) reduced chance to dodge attack or spell hits from supported skills. [wiki][pob]
When a supported skill is blocked it inflicts Overpowered for 4 s: a further -5% chance to block attacks and spells, stackable any number of times (added in 3.5.0). [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Bob's accuracy bonus does not touch enemy block, so nothing of the gem remains.

audit.poe: A strong strike that gives Fortify; it has a 4 s cooldown which you can bypass by spending an Endurance Charge. Used to keep Fortify up between other attacks.
audit.bob: A melee strike that gives Fortify on melee hit (buffOn.meleeHit.fortify, which the engine reads: 20% less damage taken for 4 s). It has no cooldown, so it is simply a spammable fortifying strike, and no charge is spent; the damage is also far below the original's 222-260%.
audit.repair: Give it an explicit cooldown and let a Grit charge be spent to skip it, with a heavier hit to pay for the cooldown.

lines: A melee strike (Attack, Melee, Strike) with attack speed multiplier 85%, flat 6 mana at every gem level, cast time 1.0; cannot be evaded (it can still be dodged or blocked), crits work normally. [wiki][pob]
Deals 222% of base attack damage at level 1 up to 260% at level 20, one of the highest base damages of any attack. [wiki][pob]

Grants Fortify on melee hit (100% chance): 20% less damage taken from hits for 4 s (not damage over time); the gem adds 75% (L1) to 170% (L20) increased Fortify duration and +2 to +4 melee range. [wiki][pob]
4 s cooldown with one stored use; the cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge. [wiki][pob]
Intended partner is Endurance Charge on Melee Stun: a stun refunds the charge so the strike can be repeated; Multistrike repeats it and makes the cooldown and charge spend more effective. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds against the wiki and PoB (4 s cooldown, charge bypass, Fortify). Bob keeps the strike and the Fortify buff (20% less damage for 4 s matches the wiki's Fortify page) but loses the cooldown/charge loop and hits for 100-140% instead of 222-260%.

audit.poe: A relic that follows you and, when you hit with an attack, casts a nova that damages enemies and regenerates life for you and minions.
audit.bob: A ranged relic minion that shoots enemies while the owner gets 3.5-100 life regen (always on); the on-hit nova trigger and the stronger minion regen are not modelled.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: (From poedb, current version; no PoB data.) A two-handed mace/staff circular swing with 50% lightning conversion that also calls down holy hammers on up to three struck enemies.
audit.bob: A 360-degree self burst with 50% lightning conversion usable with swords, maces, axes and staves (no two-hand limit); the hammers that land on struck enemies are missing.
audit.repair: After the sweep, add reduced-damage area hits on up to three enemies it struck.

lines: The page title resolves to the gem that was called Sweep in 3.9 (renamed later; release 0.8.0). The lightning conversion and holy hammers of the audit line belong to the later gem. [wiki]
Melee attack that needs a two-handed melee weapon (staff, two-handed sword, axe or mace). Swings in a full 360-degree circle around the player. [wiki][pob]
Always knocks enemies back on hit (it was a 30% chance before 3.7.0). Radius 26 base, +0 to 4 by level. [wiki][pob]
170% (level 1) to 225% (level 20) of base attack damage, plus (5-75) to (8-113) added attack physical; all physical, no conversion. [wiki][pob]
Attack speed multiplier 70% (30% slower); mana 8. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line does not hold for 3.9: Sweep is a plain physical 360-degree knockback swing, with no lightning and no hammers. Bob's self-centred burst keeps the shape, so the verdict is drifted for different reasons (invented 50% lightning, no two-hand limit, no knockback; the engine has no knockback primitive).
spec.decision: The 3.9 gem is Sweep (physical, 360-degree, knockback, two-handed only). Rebase Halo Sweep on Sweep (drop the lightning conversion), or keep the later Holy Sweep design as a Bob original outside the 3.9 repair plan?

audit.poe: Hits maim enemies: they are slowed and take more physical damage, and the skill deals more physical damage against maimed enemies.

audit.repair: Apply a maim debuff with both a movement/action slow and phys vulnerability, outside the hex limit, scoped to the supported skill.

lines: Support (Attack, Physical) added in 3.0.0 for attack skills or skills that can maim; mana multiplier 115%. [wiki]
30% chance to maim on hit. Maim is a debuff giving 30% reduced MOVEMENT speed for 4 s (not action speed); it does not stack and is separate from hinder; maim alone does no damage effect. [wiki]
Enemies maimed by supported skills take 10% (L1) to 14% (L20) increased physical damage. [wiki][pob]
Supported skills deal 15% (L1) to 30% (L20) more physical damage, listed without a condition (it applies whether or not the target is maimed). [wiki][pob]
Maim is not a curse, so it does not use a curse slot. [memory]
spec.check: I corrected the audit on one point: the 15-30% more physical damage is unconditional (not 'against maimed enemies'), so Bob's mod already matches it. The slow is a 30% movement-speed reduction for 4 s on a 30% chance, not an always-on slow. The extra physical damage taken is 10-14%, which Bob's openWounds hex provides at its own 20..35% scale.

audit.poe: Minions have more maximum life.
audit.bob: minionLife more is used in minionBody, which sets minion max life; works.

audit.poe: More DoT, shorter ailment duration.
audit.bob: More dot damage, duration.* -15%.

audit.poe: Mine support with less base damage but a damage bonus (double-damage chance) against enemies near mines; reconstructed from stat ids, exact wording unsure.
audit.bob: Adds mine, less damage, and 40% more damage under the targetNearby condition. But deployed shots build their profile with playerConds(w, target), and targetNearby is tested between the target and the player (2 tiles + radius), not between the target and the mine, so for a ranged build the bonus is almost never on and the gem is a plain mine with a damage penalty.
audit.repair: Evaluate target-proximity conditions from the deployable's position in shoot(), or count other mines near the target as the bonus.

lines: Support for spells and bow/wand attacks (no melee weapons, no channelling): the skill is thrown as a mine the player detonates. [wiki]
Mine lasts 5 s; base detonation time 0.25 s. [wiki][pob]
Supported skills deal (30-20)% less damage, 30% at L1 down to 20% at L20. [wiki][pob]
Each mine carries an aura: it gives hits against enemies near it a 2% chance to deal double damage; the chances from different mines add, up to a maximum of 100%. [wiki]
So the bonus scales with how many mines surround the target (one mine = 2% chance, ~50 mines = 100%), not with a flat condition. [wiki]
spec.check: Audit PoE line holds, and the wiki confirms what the reviewer reconstructed from stat ids: 2% double-damage chance per mine near the enemy, capped at 100%, with 30-20% less damage. Bob's flat 40% more (not per mine) is the drift on top of the broken proximity test the audit found.

audit.poe: Supported skills apply the linked curses on hit (no casting). In 3.9 the gem was the older curse-on-hit; poedb's 3.27 page shows reduced curse effect and duration, which I did not hold against Bob.
audit.bob: hexOnHit: the hex gems in the same item as the primary skill are applied to enemies hit (deriveHexes). Scoped to the primary skill's item only for choosing the hexes, but they are applied by all of the character's hits, and share the one-hex limit.

audit.poe: Channelled orb above you that pelts the ground with cold projectiles; channelling builds stages (more duration/fire rate) that decay when you stop - commit-to-ramp skill.
audit.bob: A plain 'burst' nova around the caster at 45% effectiveness, 0.3 s cast, chill. 'channelling' is only a tag in calc/skill.ts (no ramp state); nothing builds up, no orb, no projectiles.
audit.repair: Add a channel_ramp primitive (stages that rise per use and decay after a gap) that scales hit rate/damage, and use it here.

lines: Channelled spell (0.25 s cast, 6% crit, 50% effectiveness): conjures an orb above you that fires cold projectiles which target the ground and explode in an area, hitting for 30-37 up to 232-291 cold damage (gem L1 to L20). [wiki]
Channelling builds stages, up to 10 (several can be added per action). When you stop channelling the stages decay over the orb's duration. [wiki]
The orb lasts 1.2 s base plus 25% increased duration per stage. [wiki]
Projectile frequency: one volley every 1.6 s base, +15% per stage, and 100% more while channelling; cast speed modifiers also apply. [wiki]
The projectiles fan out from the orb with a distance offset (spread radius 100); Fork, Pierce and Chain give no benefit. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds against the wiki: orb above you, stages that raise fire rate and duration, decay after release. Added: 10 stages and the fire-rate numbers; Bob's 0.3 s nova pulse keeps only the channelling and chill.

audit.poe: No PoB data. From memory of 3.9 (low confidence; poedb shows only 3.24 values) : marked enemy takes more projectile damage and is easier to hit, with flask charges on hitting it; later versions add projectile splitting.
audit.bob: huntMark hex: character deals 12..25% more projectile damage and +accuracy to the marked, plus 6..15% damage taken. Core projectile-damage-vs-marked loop works.
audit.repair: None needed; flask charges / projectile split are optional extras.

audit.poe: Thrust an axe or sword to throw a main impaling projectile plus four smaller shards; each enemy can only be hit by one projectile, so extra projectiles add coverage, not damage.
audit.bob: Five-projectile fan with 100% impale chance; the engine gives all projectiles of one use a shared hit list, so each enemy is hit once, matching the 'one projectile per enemy' rule. Impale is a real mechanic here (recordImpale/payImpales).
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: A mine that detonates in a nova of short-lived cold projectiles; extra projectiles with more mines and an aura raising enemy crit chance near it.
audit.bob: A mine that goes off when enemies are near and fires five icicles in a 100 degree fan at range 7; the nearby-enemy crit aura and mine-sequence projectiles are omitted.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Reserve mana for a large more-armour multiplier.
audit.bob: Reserves 50% mana for a more armour mod, which defence.ts reads through db.calc.

audit.poe: Guard: absorbs 70% of hit damage up to a pool, then ends; shares a cooldown with other guards; cooldown does not recover while up.
audit.bob: Guard utility (policy guard, life<60%, 3 s, cd 8): hitTaken more -35..-50 (real, defence.ts hitTakenMult). Absorb pool becomes a flat reduction; no shared guard cooldown.
audit.repair: Optionally model the pool (absorb up to N damage) and share guard cooldowns.

audit.poe: A trap that damages one enemy and immobilises it, then slows it and makes it take more damage from your traps and mines; it is a trap/mine setup and control tool.
audit.bob: A trap with a big physical burst (200% effectiveness) and a 30% lower enemy stun threshold; nothing holds or slows the enemy and there is no trap/mine vulnerability, so the port note 'holds it for a few seconds' is false. The enemyStunThreshold stat only affects stun chance (src/calc/combat.ts).
audit.repair: Add an enemy root/slow status (a timed move-speed multiplier) and a debuff giving more damage taken from trap and mine hits.

lines: Trap spell dealing secondary damage (not affected by spell or attack damage modifiers, so it cannot be blocked or dodged): cast time 1.0, 4 s cooldown with 3 stored uses, trap lasts 4 s and does not explode on timeout, crit 6%, damage effectiveness 200%, mana 6 to 23. [wiki][pob]

Damages one enemy and immobilises it (locks it in place; not a stun): the immobilise lasts 150 ms per 1% of its maximum life dealt, capped at one third of max life (about 5 s), and skill duration modifiers lengthen it. [wiki]
When the immobilise ends a 3 s debuff remains: enemy movement speed starts 80% lower and recovers to normal over the debuff. [wiki][pob]
While debuffed the enemy takes 15% increased damage from trap and mine hits. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Added detail: the immobilise length comes from damage dealt as a share of max life, and the slow decays over 3 s. Bob keeps only the 200% physical burst, so the control and trap/mine vulnerability that define the gem are absent.

audit.poe: Channel to build stages, zapping nearby enemies as you do, then release a powerful lightning beam; ramp and release is the loop.
audit.bob: A self-centred burst (radius 3) every 0.25 s at 45% effectiveness, half physical converted to lightning, with the channelling tag inert. The stage build-up and the release beam are both absent, so it is a fast lightning nova.
audit.repair: Add a stage counter that grows with hits and, after a lull or at a cap, fires one large beam at the target (stand-in for release).

lines: Channelled spell (cast time 0.22 s, crit 6%): each channel tick builds a stage and zaps up to 5 nearby enemies (the zaps cannot chain; their range follows area mods). [wiki][pob]
Extra stages come from hitting enemies: 40% chance per Normal/Magic enemy hit and a guaranteed extra stage per Rare/Unique hit, rolled per enemy, so a crowd charges it faster. [wiki][pob]
While channelling the skill deals 50% less damage; this ends the moment you release, so it does not touch the beam. [wiki]

Release fires a beam in front of you (fixed length and width) plus a small area bubble around you: beam hits deal 100% more damage per stage after the first and ailments 70% more per stage. 10 stages give maximum width, 20 stages maximum damage. [wiki][pob]
Physical damage (17-25 at L1 to 140-210 at L20), 50% converted to lightning; effectiveness 30%. [wiki][pob]
A spell totem charges the full 20 stages before firing. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Added detail: stage gain depends on enemies hit (crowd-dependent), the channel zaps are weak (50% less) and nearly all the payoff is the released beam, which scales linearly with stages up to 20. Bob's rapid 0.25 s nova really is a different skill.

audit.poe: Flat accuracy.
audit.bob: Flat accuracy, read by hit chance.

audit.poe: Aura giving flat accuracy and increased critical strike chance.
audit.bob: Reserves 35% mana for base accuracy and inc critChance, both read by the profile code.

audit.poe: Added fire damage against burning (ignited) enemies: rewards stacking ignite from another source.
audit.bob: Gives its own 30% ignite chance and more ignite damage; no added flat fire and no dependence on an already-ignited target. The engine has the targetIgnited condition, but the gem does not use it.
audit.repair: Add flat fire damage under the targetIgnited condition and drop the self-ignite chance.

lines: Supports any skill that hits enemies; the supported skill deals added fire damage against Burning enemies: 42-63 at L1 to 205-308 at L20 [wiki]
It only helps skills capable of hitting (not Scorching Ray or Righteous Fire) and does nothing against a target that is not already burning [wiki]
It gives no ignite chance and no ignite damage of its own, so it rewards ignite supplied by another source [wiki]
Added in 3.0.0 [wiki]
spec.check: Audit PoE line holds, but I changed the verdict to gutted: Bob's Kindle (own 30% ignite chance plus more ignite damage) is a different gem that duplicates Tinderbox/Combustion, and nothing of the Immolate loop (added fire conditional on a burning target) survives. Kindle and Cindering both map to the single Immolate Support.
spec.decision: Two Bob gems (Kindle and Cindering) map to the single 3.9 gem Immolate Support. Should Cindering carry the faithful conditional-added-fire version, and Kindle be removed, or kept as a Bob original ignite-chance support?

audit.poe: No PoB data; memory plus poedb (current values, 3.9 similar): warcry that exerts your next attacks (Combust: fire area hit on the first hit of each exerted attack), converts phys to fire scaling with enemy power, and makes enemies explode on death.
audit.bob: Plain timed buff (8 s, cd 8): 25..40% more attack damage and 20% ignite chance. No exert counter, no Combust, no death explosion, no fire conversion.
audit.repair: Add an exert_next_attacks primitive (counter of N attacks that get more damage plus an extra fire area hit) and use it for the warcry family.

lines: At 2020-03-12 the page titled Infernal Cry is Abyssal Cry (SkillGemAbyssalCry, release 2.0.0; PoB 3.9 also has only Abyssal Cry), a Warcry (AoE, Duration, Chaos). The exert and Combust gem the audit describes postdates 3.9. [wiki][pob]
Cast time 0.25 s, 4 s cooldown shared with other Warcry skills, base duration 6 s, mana 10 (L1) to 16 (L20); taunts all nearby enemies to attack the user. [wiki][pob]
Hinders enemies in the area: 20% (L1) to 26% (L20) reduced movement speed, plus 0.6% (L1) to 0.86% (L20) reduced movement speed per nearby enemy, so the effect grows with pack size. [wiki][pob]

Enemies explode when killed while affected: chaos secondary damage equal to 8% of that monster's maximum life, in an area around the corpse, scaled by chaos and area modifiers; the explosion removes the corpse and its damage cannot be reflected. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line does not hold for 3.9: it describes the later Infernal Cry (exerted attacks, Combust, fire conversion, enemy-power scaling), not the 3.9 Abyssal Cry. Bob's gem (timed attack-damage and ignite buff) shares nothing with the 3.9 loop, so the verdict stays gutted, but the audit's repair (an exert_next_attacks primitive) would build a post-3.9 mechanic; the missing list is replaced.
spec.decision: The 3.9 gem is Abyssal Cry: a chaos hinder-and-taunt that makes enemies explode on death. Bob's Kindled Bellow is fire-themed and described as a damage buff. Do we rebuild it as the Abyssal Cry loop (chaos explosion, rename or keep the fire theme), keep it as Bob's own buff warcry, or drop it from the plan? Also, does taunt matter in Bob, or do enemies already target only the character?

audit.poe: Half of cold damage converts to fire, plus some cold gained as fire.
audit.bob: convertSkill and gain handled in convertChunks with ancestry.

audit.poe: A mana-reserving aura that adds fire damage to attacks and spells for you and allies.
audit.bob: A 50% mana reserve aura that adds flat fire damage by level to the character's hits; minions are not covered, but the added-damage aura role is intact.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: More melee damage to close enemies, scaling with distance; usable only with axes or swords; hits give a short speed buff for travel skills (poedb).
audit.bob: Flat more damage to enemies within 2 tiles plus radius; no weapon restriction, no hit buff, no distance gradient. The damage trade works, but it loses its restriction-for-power.
audit.repair: Restrict to axe and sword attacks (needs a support-side weapon filter).

lines: Supports melee attack skills (not those that create minions); the skill can only be used with Axes and Swords [wiki]
Up to 40% (L1) to 59% (L20) more Melee Damage depending on target proximity: full bonus up to 15 units away, scaling linearly down to 0 at 40 units [wiki]
Supported hits grant Combat Rush for 2 s, or until you use a Travel skill [wiki]
Combat Rush gives 20% to 24% more Attack and Cast Speed to Travel skills that are not supported by Close Combat, so it matters only if the character owns a travel skill [wiki]
Added in 3.7.0 [wiki]
spec.check: Audit line holds; I added the distance gradient (full to 15 units, zero by 40) to the missing list, since Bob uses a flat near/far condition. Combat Rush only benefits other travel skills, so it can be skipped unless one is equipped.

audit.poe: A ballista totem fires long, deeply piercing arrows; you choose it for repeated piercing hits from several bow turrets.
audit.bob: Three ballistas (deployCount 2 extra) each fire a single arrow with pierce 9 at range 11 using your bow; totems shoot on their own while the character fights.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Cast curse that slows enemies' actions and also makes buffs and ailments on them expire more slowly (40% slower, so their debuffs and effects on them last longer), a utility curse for control and DoT builds.
audit.bob: Hex-kind gem usable only via Hexing Strikes on hit. The slow is real (speedMult drives action timing and movement in the sim). The slower expiry of effects on enemies (Bob's own ailments and hexes) is absent.
audit.repair: Make it castable and scale tick-down of ailments and hexes on cursed targets by the curse's slow factor.

lines: Curse (Spell, AoE, Duration), cast time 0.5 s, base duration 5 s (L1) to 5.95 s (L20), radius +0 to +7, mana 16 to 33. [wiki][pob]
Cursed normal and magic enemies have 20% (L1) to 29% (L20) less action speed; rare and unique enemies 10% (L1) to 14% (L20) less. The slow is capped at 75%. [wiki][pob]

Other effects on cursed enemies expire 40% slower (cap 75%): damage-over-time debuffs last longer but deal the same damage per second, so total damage rises; the curse's listed duration already accounts for slowing itself. [wiki][pob]
Curse effect against players is 40% lower (monster use). Can be turned into an aura with Blasphemy Support. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Extra detail for the repair: rares and uniques are slowed only about half as much, which Bob's boss curse reduction (0.67) only partly mirrors.

audit.poe: Cheaper skill; casting builds Inspiration charges that raise elemental damage and crit chance until a mana-spent threshold clears them. Self-generating.
audit.bob: Real 30% cost reduction, but the charge loop is folded into the shared Insight charge and the gem generates none; the per-charge crit and damage bonus only works if another item grants Insight. On its own it is just a cheaper skill.
audit.repair: Give the gem a chargeOn.cast-style source (or its own charge that gains with mana spent and resets on a threshold).

lines: Support for any skill; mana multiplier 115%; 25% (L1) to 34% (L20) reduced mana cost of supported skills (not reservation). [wiki][pob]

Gain an Inspiration Charge whenever supported skills spend mana, up to 5 charges; they last 10 s and are all lost if none is gained in that time. Minions, totems, traps and mines cannot gain them. [wiki][pob]

Each charge gives 5% (L1) to 7% (L20) more elemental damage and 6% (L1) to 8% (L20) increased critical strike chance to all supported skills; the charges are shared and help even a skill that spends no mana. [wiki][pob]
A mana counter shared by all supported skills clears every charge once total mana spent exceeds 122 (L1) up to 800 (L20), so cheaper skills keep charges longer. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Bob's per-charge crit and elemental damage numbers match; the gem never makes its own charges, so it relies on another source of Insight.

audit.poe: More ailment damage, less hit damage.
audit.bob: More dot-tagged damage and less hit-tagged damage; both applied separately.

audit.poe: Longer-lasting skill effects (zones, minions, trap and curse durations) with only a mana multiplier cost (poedb 3.27: no damage penalty).
audit.bob: skillDuration more plus an invented 15% less damage. Because the sim ignores skillDuration for ground zones, curses and buffs, the benefit works only on deployables and timed minions while the damage penalty always applies; the sheet and the sim disagree for zone skills.
audit.repair: Wire skillDuration into zone pulses and hex/buff duration in the sim; do not add an invented drawback.

lines: Supports any skill with a duration (the wiki page is named Increased Duration) [wiki]
45% (L1) to 64% (L20) increased Skill Effect Duration [wiki]
No damage penalty at all; its only cost is the mana multiplier (140% since 2.0.0) [wiki]
It lengthens the effects the skill creates: totem lifetime, Caustic Arrow clouds, conversion time; when linked to a minion or remote skill it also lengthens the skills those use [wiki]
Ailments do not gain duration from it unless a skill says so; charge durations are not changed either [wiki]
spec.check: Holds, now confirmed from the 3.9 wiki (PoB had no data): no damage penalty, so Bob's invented 15% less damage is wrong and should go; Bob's 25-44% duration range should be 45-64%.

audit.poe: Slower projectiles that deal more damage.
audit.bob: projectileSpeed down, damage up.

audit.poe: Added lightning, shock chance, and a buff after killing a shocked enemy.
audit.bob: Added lightning plus 20% shock chance; the buff after killing a shocked enemy is dropped (secondary).

audit.poe: Detonating a mine may grant Power or Frenzy charges; power charges add mine crit chance, frenzy charges speed mine laying.
audit.bob: Same mechanism as Livewire Snares with critChance per Insight charge. Charges roll on each hit by a mine; works through p.gains.

audit.poe: Triggering a trap may grant a Power or Frenzy charge; power charges raise trap crit multiplier, frenzy charges raise throw speed.
audit.bob: chargeOn.hit.insight and chargeOn.hit.fervour are rolled by the skill's gains each time a trap hit lands (the deployed shot keeps isPlayer, so rollCharges runs); each Insight charge adds crit multiplier via per charges.insight. The frenzy charge's throw-speed bonus is replaced by Fervour's generic speed.

audit.poe: A sturdy totem that taunts nearby monsters so they attack it instead of you, soaking hits and giving a zone of safety.
audit.bob: Only a guard buff of 15-25% less damage taken for 8 s when life is low; there is no totem, no taunt and no redirect. Deployables are not actors, enemies cannot target them (src/sim/deploy.ts), so nothing absorbs hits.
audit.repair: Make deployables targetable actors with life and let enemy AI pick a taunting totem within radius before the player.

lines: Totem spell, 1.0 s cast, 4 s cooldown, mana 9 to 35; deals no damage. [wiki][pob]
Summons a totem that lasts 8 s and taunts monsters within range 60 so that they attack it. [wiki][pob]
The totem has its own base life by gem level (totem level 4 to 68) with 0 to 38% increased totem life, and it cannot evade. [wiki][pob]
Area-of-effect support gems work with it (since 0.10.0g). [wiki]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB; the numbers to use are 8 s, taunt range 60 and a 4 s cooldown (Bob uses 10).

audit.poe: A fire slam that sends fissures forward; with an Endurance Charge it can spend the charge for a Charged Slam with more damage, bigger area and more fissures.
audit.bob: A burst slam with 50% fire conversion and a 20% ignite chance (the ignite is not in the original); it never consumes charges, so the grit (Endurance analog) interaction is missing.
audit.repair: Let the slam spend one Grit charge for more damage and area (charges and their spending hooks exist in sim/charges.ts).

lines: Melee slam (mace, sceptre, sword, axe, staff or unarmed), attack speed -20%, mana 10: 170-200% of base attack damage, 60% of physical converted to fire, in a cone. No ignite chance. [wiki]
It unleashes a primary fiery fissure (36 units long) plus a random number of smaller secondary fissures branching off it. [wiki]
Each use has a 35% chance to consume one Endurance Charge (if you have one) to make a Charged Slam: 60% more damage, a larger area, and the maximum number of fissures. [wiki]
With Multistrike each of the three strikes tries to consume a charge. [wiki]
spec.check: Corrected: the audit says the slam spends the charge, but the 3.9 wiki gives a 35% chance per use to consume a charge (3.5.0 lowered it from 100%) for 60% more damage, so the charge spend is probabilistic. Bob's 20% ignite is not in the original, and its 50% conversion and 160% base differ slightly from 60% and 170%.

audit.poe: Aura giving more damage over time and increased skill effect duration; the pick for DoT builds (poison, bleed, ignite, ground DoTs).
audit.bob: Reserves 50% mana for a more damage mod on the dot tag (ailment contexts carry dot) and increased poison/ignite/bleed durations. Ground/buff durations (skillDuration stat) are not raised, a small gap.
audit.repair: Optionally add skillDuration inc so ground and buff durations lengthen too.

audit.poe: A short-lived totem with an aura that regenerates life for you and allies standing near it; used as a regeneration window.
audit.bob: A guard-policy buff: cast when life is under 60% and not already up, it gives 6-160 life regen a second for 8 s (cooldown 10 s); it is not a physical totem and minions are not healed, but the regen window matches.
audit.repair: None needed (allies/minions regen is the only nuance).

audit.poe: Every third use of the melee attack is a big hit: much more damage, a longer stun, and extra bleed damage; a rhythm/burst support with a counter.
audit.bob: Averaged into a permanent more melee damage and more bleed damage (value is exactly one third of the PoE big-hit bonus). No counter, no big hit, no stun component.
audit.repair: Count melee uses of the supported skill in the sim and apply the big-hit mods (damage, bleed, stun duration) on every third; keep the sheet on the average.

lines: Supports melee attack skills (not channelling skills such as Cyclone) [wiki]
Every third use of the supported attack is a Ruthless Blow; the counter counts uses whether or not they hit, and with Multistrike it counts whole uses, not single strikes [wiki]
A Ruthless Blow deals 75% (L1) to 132% (L20) more Melee Damage [wiki]
A Ruthless Blow also deals 75% to 132% more damage with Bleeding caused by melee hits [wiki]
A Ruthless Blow has a base stun duration of 0.8 s [wiki][pob]
spec.check: Holds: Bob's averaged 25-44 is exactly one third of the wiki's 75-132, as the audit says; the counter, the bleed part and the 0.8 s stun are the missing loop.

audit.poe: Culling strike: enemies left below 10% life die.
audit.bob: culling flag read in sim/combat.ts at CULLING_SHARE 0.1; plus some damage.

audit.poe: A wand volley that culls low-life enemies and feeds power charges; crit chance (and multiplier) scales with power charges, so it is the charge-building crit wand skill.
audit.bob: Five-bolt wand fan with culling strike (real), 20% chance on hit to gain an Insight (power-charge analog) charge (real, rollCharges), and +20% crit chance increase per Insight charge (per: charges.insight is read by the engine). Missing the crit-multiplier per charge, and the gain is not limited to rare/unique targets (chargeOn ignores conditions).
audit.repair: Optionally add critMulti per Insight charge.

audit.poe: Fires an arrow to a spot where a clone is summoned that uses your bow for a few seconds.
audit.bob: Summons a bow clone for 3 s that shoots enemies; it appears next to the player instead of at the arrow's landing point.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: A ballista totem lobs fire arrows that land in a line and each explode in an area, so it is an AoE ground-pounder from a bow totem.
audit.bob: Up to three ballistas fire a 6-arrow fan of plain fire-converted projectiles (no explodeRadius, no area tag) that hit only what they touch; the ground-impact explosion that defines it is gone.
audit.repair: Give the behaviour explodeRadius (the projectile engine already supports it) and the area tag so arrows burst where they land or hit.

lines: Bow attack that summons a ballista totem (lasts 8 s; ballistas add +2 to max totems, are summoned close to you and attack at half speed). [wiki][pob]
33-42% of base attack damage, 100% of physical converted to fire, 5 additional arrows (6 in total). [wiki][pob]
The arrows are fired into the air and hit the ground in a line, each dealing area damage around where it lands. [wiki]
Added in 3.9.0 (3.10 raises the damage multiplier). [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Bob has the 6 arrows, 100% fire and two extra totems; the landing explosion and the line pattern (rather than a forward fan) are missing.

audit.poe: A mine that blasts an area and then rains fiery projectiles around it, while an aura makes nearby enemies take added fire damage.
audit.bob: A mine with a single fire burst (radius 2.4, 80%); the follow-up projectile rain and the fire-damage-taken aura are absent.
audit.repair: Add a secondary ring of small explosions or projectiles after the first burst and a fire-damage-taken debuff on enemies near the mine.

lines: Spell mine (lasts 5 s, reserves mana, 0.35 s base detonation time): on detonation deals fire area damage (effectiveness 80%, crit 5.5%, radius about 30 units). [wiki][pob]
Then launches 2 additional projectiles that rain down around the mine, each dealing damage in a smaller area; plus 1 more projectile for every 2 prior mines in the detonation sequence. [wiki]
Aura: each mine adds fire damage to hits against enemies near it, stacking per mine up to a cap (1-2 each, cap 64-96 at L1; 12-18 each, cap 601-901 at L20). [wiki]
In 3.10 the sequence bonus became 1 per 4 mines and the cast time 0.18 s; these are not 3.9 values. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds (burst, rain of projectiles, nearby-enemy fire damage aura). Extra detail for the repair: the projectile count rises with the number of mines detonating in sequence (1 per 2 prior mines).

audit.poe: Cast curse: enemies take increased physical damage and increased physical damage over time, and your attacks against them can bleed and maim.
audit.bob: Hex-kind gem usable only via Hexing Strikes on hit; physical vulnerability is real (hexVuln in rawHit and hits). No physical DoT vulnerability, no bleed-and-maim on attack, and the engine has no maim at all.
audit.repair: Make it castable, add a physical DoT taken mod, and a self mod giving bleed chance against cursed targets (maim needs a new slow primitive).

lines: Curse spell (0.5 s cast, mana 16 to 33): curses all targets in an area (22 units, +0..10 by level) for 9-10.9 s. [wiki]
Cursed enemies take 30-39% increased physical damage (multiplicative with attacker damage, additive with other damage taken). [wiki]
Cursed enemies take 30% increased physical damage from damage over time. [wiki]
Cursed enemies have 20% chance to bleed when hit by attacks and 20% chance to be maimed when hit by attacks. [wiki]
Maim is a debuff: 30% reduced movement speed for 4 s. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds against the wiki. Added: 30% increased physical DoT taken is a flat value, maim is a 4 s 30% movement slow, and the bleed and maim chances are 20% each.

audit.poe: Each cast adds a blade (max 10) to a persistent orbit around you that hits everything nearby every 0.6 s, with hit rate, crit and damage rising per blade; the loop is stacking blades, then fighting from the middle of them.
audit.bob: A self-centred nova (radius 2.4) fired every cast (0.6 s). No persistent blades, no stacking per cast, no per-blade scaling; the hit rate does match a full orbit roughly.
audit.repair: Make the cast add a stack to a timed self-centred zone that pulses on its own, with per-stack hit rate, crit and damage.

lines: Spell (physical, area, duration), 0.5 s cast, effectiveness 25%, base crit 6%. Each cast adds one ethereal blade that orbits the caster for 5 s base; at most 10 blades, and at the cap a new blade removes the oldest. [wiki][pob]

Blades do not hit separately: all enemies inside the radius (15 base, +0 to 4 by level) are hit together once per spin, base spin 0.6 s. Since 2.5.0 each blade raises the frequency and damage of that one round. [wiki]
Per blade: +35% hit rate (spin time 0.6 s / (1 + 0.35 x blades)), 35% more damage with hits and ailments, +10% crit chance. [wiki][pob]
Damage 3-5 (level 1) to 101-151 (level 20) physical per hit; mana 6 to 16. Cast speed sets how fast blades are added; only one instance can exist at a time. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB (10 blades, 0.6 s, hit rate, crit and damage per blade). The per-blade numbers are 35%/35%/10% and blade life is 5 s, which the repair can use.

audit.poe: Minions deal more damage.
audit.bob: minionDamage more; summonMinions stores prof.minionDamage on each minion and attack damage multiplies by it. Works.

audit.poe: Minions move, attack and cast faster.
audit.bob: minionSpeed inc multiplies the minion's movement speed and its attack rate (m.speed in tickMinions). Works.

audit.poe: More spell and DoT damage, longer skill duration.
audit.bob: More spell damage and more DoT; duration is not included.

audit.poe: Curse that makes the cursed enemy grant the attacker a melee buff when hit by melee: more melee damage and increased attack speed. A melee-only curse.
audit.bob: hardTimes hex: target takes 10..19% increased damage of every type (vulnAll). No attack speed, not melee-restricted (spell and bow builds benefit equally), no buff-on-hit step.
audit.repair: Make it a mark-style hex with selfMods (more melee damage and attack speed against the target) instead of vulnAll.

lines: Curse (Spell, AoE, Duration, Physical), cast time 0.5 s, base duration 9 s (L1) to 10.9 s (L20), mana 16 to 33. [wiki][pob]
Cursed enemies have -20% to physical damage reduction at every level, in addition to the buff below. [wiki][pob]

Anyone who hits a cursed enemy with a melee hit (a blocked melee hit still counts) gains the Punisher buff: 25% (L1) to 35% (L20) more melee physical damage and 10% to 19% increased attack speed, lasting 9 to 10.9 s. [wiki][pob]
Only melee hits grant it; spells and bows do not. Curse effect scales both the buff's duration and its magnitude. No longer reflects damage (changed in 2.0.0). [wiki]
Can be turned into an aura with Blasphemy Support. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's melee-buff reading holds, but it left out the curse's own effect, -20% physical damage reduction on the cursed, so I added enemy_physical_reduction_debuff to the missing list. Bob's hardTimes (10..19% damage taken, all types) replaces both halves.

audit.poe: Throws a spectral copy of your weapon that flies out and returns, hitting enemies along its path both ways.
audit.bob: A returning projectile (behaviour returns:true: it reverses at max range, resets its hit list and hits again on the way back, verified in updateProjectiles).
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Projectiles pierce a number of enemies, with some more damage at high level.
audit.bob: The pierce stat is read (pierceLeft in updateProjectiles); projectiles pass through and continue.

audit.poe: Mark: enemy is less evasive; hits on it return life and mana, kills fill flask charges and may give a frenzy charge.
audit.bob: flaskMark hex: 6..15% increased damage taken, and the character gets chargeOn.kill.fervour 20..35 vs the marked. Evasion reduction, life/mana on hit and flask charges dropped.
audit.repair: Add recover.hit life/mana and flask-charge-on-kill selfMods to the hex.

lines: Curse (Spell, AoE, Duration), cast time 0.5 s, base duration 6 s (L1) to 9.8 s (L20), mana 24 to 50. [wiki][pob]
Cursed enemies have 30% (L1) to 49% (L20) less evasion. [wiki][pob]
Cursed enemies grant 5 life and 5 mana (L1) up to 24 life and 12 mana (L20) each time they are hit by attacks. [wiki][pob]
Cursed enemies grant 100% increased flask charges when slain; the killing blow must be yours for the flask and charge bonuses. [wiki][pob]
21% (L1) to 30% (L20) chance to gain a Frenzy Charge when a cursed enemy is slain. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Bob keeps the charge-on-kill (20..35% Fervour, close to 21..30%) and adds a 6..15% damage-taken bonus that is not part of the gem.

audit.poe: Increased critical strike chance (plus a small base crit).
audit.bob: Increased crit chance plus some crit multiplier (a Bob extra); numbers differ only.

audit.poe: Each attack randomly picks fire, cold or lightning (never twice in a row) and deals only that element, with an area burst that is larger if the target has the matching ailment, and extra damage per elemental ailment on the target.
audit.bob: A melee strike with no physical or chaos damage, and added fire and cold damage together every hit (no lightning), plus 10-16% ignite/freeze/shock chances. Nothing picks an element, no area burst, no ailment-count damage bonus.
audit.repair: Pick one of three elements per use (not repeating) that sets the added damage and the ailment, add a small area burst on hit and a more-damage per distinct elemental ailment on the target.

lines: Attack usable with any weapon or unarmed. Each use picks one element at random (fire, cold or lightning), tries not to repeat the last one, and deals damage of only that element: all other damage types (physical, chaos) are removed. [wiki][pob]

Adds flat damage for all three elements on the gem: level 1 fire 22-40, cold 18-33, lightning 4-67; level 20 fire 480-891, cold 392-729, lightning 77-1465. Only the chosen element applies; conversion happens before the choice. [wiki]
30% (level 1) to 49% (level 20) chance to freeze, shock and ignite. [wiki][pob]

If it hits, it also deals damage in a small area around the target; the area radius is 80% larger against an enemy suffering the ailment associated with the chosen element (the wiki example: fire against an ignited enemy). [wiki][pob]
10% more damage per elemental ailment on the enemy. +0 to 2 melee range; mana 7 to 11. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB. Bob also has only 10-16% ailment chances against 30-49%, and carries fire and cold at once with no lightning.

audit.poe: Melee strike converting all physical to a random element per use; depending on the element it also releases a fire explosion, an arcing lightning bolt, or an icy wave.
audit.bob: Melee single-target hit with 'noPhysicalDamage' (calc/skill.ts filters out phys chunks, so the weapon's damage is discarded) and flat added fire damage, plus 15% each ignite/freeze/shock chance. No random element, no conversion of weapon damage, and the 'projectile' tag adds nothing: no explosion, arc or wave is fired (behaviour is plain melee).
audit.repair: Roll an element per use (hit-level conversion of 100% phys to it) and fire a follow-up area / chain / cone for that element from the target.

lines: Melee attack with almost any melee weapon (one- or two-handed). 160% (level 1) to 185% (level 20) of base attack damage; mana 6; +0 to 2 melee range. [wiki][pob]
100% of the weapon's physical damage is converted to a random element per use: fire, cold or lightning with equal chance; conversion applies to every part of the attack. [wiki][pob]

The struck enemy takes the melee hit, then the element adds a secondary effect: fire gives a fiery explosion (area), cold gives an icy wave (projectiles, 2 additional, pierce all), lightning gives an arcing bolt (beam chaining 4 to 7 times). [wiki][pob]
0 to 19% increased area of effect. Dual wielding alternates weapons. [wiki][pob]
The tooltip damage shows only the initial hit. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB. The element roll has no anti-repeat rule here (equal chance each time).

audit.poe: Consumes a targeted corpse: it explodes for a share of the corpse's life, then becomes a geyser that fires projectiles around it for 8 s. Needs a corpse, so it is a use-what-you-killed skill.
audit.bob: A ground zone at the target (radius 2.5, 2.4 s, pulses every 0.8 s) with fire hits. No corpse needed or consumed (the engine has no corpses), no corpse-life explosion, shorter duration.
audit.repair: Add a corpse record on enemy death and let the skill consume the nearest one, scaling an opening explosion by its life, then leave the existing ground zone for the geyser.

lines: Targets a corpse (it cannot be cast without one); the corpse explodes for fire area damage equal to 4% of the corpse's maximum life, which spell-damage modifiers do not scale and which cannot be reflected. [wiki]
The corpse then becomes a volcanic geyser lasting a base 8 s. At most 3 geysers exist at a time. [wiki][pob]

The geyser fires projectiles one after another over the area around it: 3 additional projectiles, about 42 over the 8 s. Each projectile explodes for fire damage, can hit the same enemy again, and rolls its own crit (base 5%). [wiki]
Cast time 0.6 s, damage effectiveness 100% since 3.6.0 (Bob has 70). Mana 11 at level 1, 20 at level 20. [wiki][pob]
Cast speed only changes how fast a geyser is created, not how fast it fires. Area of effect widens both the blast and how far the projectiles land from the geyser. Pierce and chain do nothing. [wiki]
Radius grows with gem level: +1 at level 6, +2 at level 11, +3 at level 20. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds (corpse explosion, then a geyser firing projectiles for 8 s). I changed the missing list: the ground zone already exists, so ground_effect is not the gap. What is missing is a geyser that fires scattered projectiles one at a time, each hitting and critting on its own, and a cap of 3 at once. I also noted the effectiveness gap (100 vs Bob's 70) and the 8 s vs 2.4 s duration.
spec.decision: Cremation cannot be cast without a corpse. Once Bob has corpse records, should the character idle this skill until a corpse exists (faithful), or fall back to a corpse-free geyser at the target? An autobattler cannot aim at a corpse, so the character would pick the nearest or most recent one.

audit.poe: Totem that fires streams of flame at nearby enemies and leaves consecrated ground.
audit.bob: Totem type: deploy.ts places a totem that shoots 3 projectiles half-converted to fire at enemies in reach, for the totem duration. Consecrated ground and channel are dropped.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: A slam in front that sends out a wave, with extra stun chance and more damage on enemies close to you.
audit.bob: Slam burst (radius 2.6) with a 25% enemy stun threshold reduction (read) and 40-49% more damage to nearby targets (targetNearby condition, within 2 tiles of the caster). Centred on the target rather than a wave in front.
audit.repair: None.

audit.poe: Totem that releases shockwaves, damaging and knocking back nearby enemies.
audit.bob: Totem that fires a self-centred burst r3 of physical spell damage on its own. No knockback, which is minor.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Pure increased cast speed.
audit.bob: Increased cast speed, read by the engine.

audit.poe: No-damage blink with a 2 s cooldown toward a location; pure mobility.
audit.bob: Utility blink (distance 7, cd 2): when the target is out of reach, the player jumps toward it (utility.ts). Gap-closer only; no free aiming, which is the legitimate autobattler adaptation.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: 25% reserved aura giving increased attack speed, cast speed and movement speed.
audit.bob: Reserves 25% mana and applies attackSpeed, castSpeed and moveSpeed inc mods, all read by the engine.

audit.poe: A fast bow/wand attack that gives a Frenzy charge on hit; each charge makes the skill itself faster and stronger. Build then spend by firing.
audit.bob: Bow/wand attack with chargeOn.hit.fervour 100 (read through the skill's gain mods) and 5% more damage and 5% more attack speed per Fervour charge held (per-stat scaling uses the character's held charges). Charges are Bob's Fervour kind, 10 s, max 3.
audit.repair: None.

audit.poe: Barrage (the active gem) makes a short preparation, then fires its projectiles one after another (40% of base damage each, small random spread of about 20 degrees); because they are sequential, they can all strike the same target, which is the skill (big single-target damage up close). (Row corrected after checking the 3.9 wiki; see the erratum.)
audit.bob: A tight fan of 5 arrows fired together at 60-72% each. A use hits each target once, so it plays as a second Split Volley.
audit.repair: Fire the volleys in sequence, each with its own hit list, at the gem's per-volley damage.

lines: Bow or wand attack. A short preparation (1.0 s base use time), then all projectiles are fired one after another, not as a fan: "Fires Projectiles sequentially". [wiki][pob]

Fires 4 additional projectiles, so 5 in all. Each deals 40% (gem level 1) to 47.6% (level 20) of base attack damage; no "less damage" penalty on the active gem (the 68-62% less is the Barrage SUPPORT). [wiki][pob]

The projectiles carry a small randomised spread of about 20 degrees; every one of them can strike the same target (up to 13 hits on one enemy with all extra-projectile sources). That is the skill: big single-target damage at close range. [wiki]
The extra projectiles from the Volley Fire jewel are the exception: they cannot strike the main target. Volley Support makes the barrage five parallel lines. [wiki]
Dual wielding: projectile count is unchanged; the volley alternates weapons per projectile. The old 33% attack speed penalty was removed in 1.1.0. [wiki]
Mana 7 (level 1) to 11 (level 20). [pob]
spec.check: The audit line (after its erratum) holds: the wiki says the projectiles are sequential and can all hit one target, 40-47.6% each, ~20 degrees. I dropped attack_time_per_projectile from missing (it belongs to Barrage Support, not the active gem; the PoB block in the input is the support) and note that Bob's 60-72% per arrow is about 50% too high for a 5-arrow salvo.

audit.poe: Five volleys of blades fall on an area, each wider and weaker than the last, with a big crit-chance bonus.
audit.bob: Ground zone at the target (radius 2.5, 1.5 s, pulses every 0.3 s = 5 volleys) with +100% crit chance. The per-volley widening and damage fall-off are not modelled, so all five hit the same circle at equal strength.
audit.repair: Optional: per-pulse radius growth and damage decay on ground behaviours.

audit.poe: Raises zombies from corpses, up to 3-7, tanky melee minions with an unevadable slam.
audit.bob: Summons 3-7 zombies with large life, melee reach and splash, followed by a respawn when recast; no corpse is needed (accepted engine divergence).
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Warcry: increased damage scaling with nearby enemies plus mana regeneration for you and allies, taunting.
audit.bob: Utility buff (rally, cd 4, 8 s): inc damage 24..40 and manaRegenFlat 1.8..14.8, real buff mods behind a condition. Per-enemy scaling averaged; allies/taunt irrelevant.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Consumes Rage at an accelerating rate for a big buff (more damage, attack and move speed, less damage taken); needs minimum rage; length depends on stored rage.
audit.bob: Rally buff (8 s, cd 12): more attack damage 15..20, more attack speed, move speed, less hit taken. Bob has rage (rageOn.*, w.rage), but Berserk neither requires nor consumes it - a cooldown buff with free uptime.
audit.repair: Require min rage to cast, drain rage while active at an accelerating rate, and end the buff when rage runs out.

lines: Instant spell buff, 5 s cooldown that does NOT recover while the buff is active; mana 10 to 16. [wiki][pob]
Needs at least 5 Rage to start. [wiki]
While active: (15-20)% more attack damage, (15-20)% more attack speed, (25-30)% more movement speed, (15-19)% less damage taken, 25% increased character size. [wiki]
Drains 5 Rage per second, and the drain rate rises 20% more each second (accelerating loss). [wiki]
The buff ends when Rage runs out, so its length depends on how much Rage you had banked. [wiki]
spec.check: Audit PoE line holds exactly (min rage, accelerating consumption, length from stored rage). Wiki gives the numbers: min 5, loss 5/s with +20% per second, cooldown paused during buff. Bob's flat 8 s / 12 s cooldown buff ignores rage, so drifted stands.

audit.poe: A wide melee arc that hits every enemy in front and strikes with both weapons when dual wielding (with a dual-wield damage penalty); axes and swords only.
audit.bob: Arc melee (120 degrees, radius 2.2) that hits every enemy in the cone; with two weapons it hits with both hands (the arc branch in fire() loops over all hands, so this one really works). No axe/sword restriction and no dual-wield damage penalty.
audit.repair: Optional: add requiresWeapon axe/sword and a final damage malus while dual wielding; no engine change needed.

audit.poe: Linked spells are cast when you are stunned; a reactive trigger that turns being hit into spells.
audit.bob: Trigger on hitTaken: fires after 20% of max life has been taken since the last firing, 0.5 s cooldown, castSocketed for the linked spells (made triggered so they are never the primary). Uses damage taken as a stand-in for stun; the reaction to being hurt is intact.

refineGem.name: Refine Gem

audit.poe: Raises the quality of the supported gem, amplifying its quality bonus; a tuning/utility support rather than a damage gem.
audit.bob: A small inc damage. There is no quality system (DESIGN 2.1: gem quality not modelled), so the gem has no real object; it is a stat gem with the old name.
audit.repair: Reinterpret as a small levelBonus on the supported skill (the Empower hook), or introduce quality.

lines: Supports any active skill gem; cannot support skills that do not come from gems [wiki]
Adds +8% quality to the supported gem per level above 1 (L2 +8%, L3 +16%, up to +72% at L10) and nothing at level 1 [wiki][pob]
A drop-only gem that normally reaches only level 3 by experience (needs a much larger experience bar) [wiki]
Mana multiplier 115% since 2.0.0; part of the trio with Empower (level) and Enlighten (mana cost) that change the supported gem's stats, not its effects [wiki]
spec.check: Holds: the wiki confirms it only adds quality to the supported gem and does nothing else; Bob's inc damage is a stand-in with no real object because quality is not modelled.
spec.decision: Bob has no gem quality system, so this gem has no real effect to port. Introduce gem quality (an extra system that every gem would then need), turn it into a small level bonus on the supported skill like Empower, or drop it?

refineGem.accepted: Divergence D5: Bob has no gem quality, and Enhance only raises quality in 3.9. The gem stays a small damage stand-in for the supported skill.

audit.poe: Attacks gain 25% bleed chance, added physical damage and more bleed damage.
audit.bob: 25% bleed chance and more bleed damage (bleed tag reaches the ailment calc). No added flat physical.

audit.poe: More melee physical damage against bleeding enemies, but the skill cannot cause bleeding: needs another bleed source.
audit.bob: Same: chance.bleed -1000 removes the skill's bleeding; more damage under the targetBleeding condition, evaluated live in the sim.

audit.poe: Projectiles (and chain skills) chain to further enemies after hitting, at a damage penalty; how projectiles clear packs.
audit.bob: Adds chains +2 and a damage penalty, but only skills with chain behaviour read 'chains' (sim actions.ts chain branch). On a normal projectile skill (bow, bolt) the chains stat does nothing, so the support is a pure damage penalty. Works only on the ~5 chain-native skills.
audit.repair: Let projectile skills chain on hit: redirect the projectile to the nearest unhit enemy up to the chain count.

lines: Support for projectile skills and other skills that chain (Arc, Orb of Storms, Wild Strike and similar): Supported Skills Chain +2 times. [wiki][pob]
When a projectile hits an enemy it picks another enemy in range, changes direction toward it, and continues until its chains run out. [wiki]
Supported skills deal 30% (L1) to 11% (L20) less damage with hits; the penalty applies to hits only (3.0.0). Mana multiplier 150%. [wiki][pob]
Projectiles that pierce do not chain. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds: Bob only has the chain count and the damage penalty, and on normal projectile skills the chains do nothing.

audit.poe: A golem that gives you increased critical strike chance and accuracy.
audit.bob: One cold golem; the owner gets 20-30% increased crit chance and accuracy (always on).
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Place a crystal that pulses a debuff (cold exposure, slowed regen) and then explodes for heavy cold damage when its duration ends; you pick it as a set-and-detonate exposure applier.
