audit.bob: A 2 s ground zone pulsing full spell hits every 0.5 s with 25% cold penetration standing in for exposure (penetration is read by the engine); there is no end-of-life explosion and no regen debuff.
audit.repair: Let a ground zone carry an 'on expiry' burst (a heavier hit at the zone's end) and make the pulses debuff-only or weak.

lines: Spell (0.5 s cast, 6% crit, 200% effectiveness) with a 2.5 s cooldown (1 stored use). It places a crystal that lasts a 2 s base duration (duration modifiers change the detonation time). [wiki]

While it lasts it pulses; each pulse applies a debuff for 5 s that gives Cold Exposure (-25% cold resistance), 75% reduced life regeneration, 75% reduced energy shield regeneration and 25% reduced ES recharge. Pulses are not hits. [wiki]
When the duration ends it explodes for 14-21 up to 959-1439 cold damage (gem L1 to L20). Only the explosion is a hit, so all the damage is the end burst. [wiki]
The debuff can push resistance below zero. Mana 4 at L1, 16 at L20. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Corrected: all of the damage comes from the end explosion (pulses do no damage), so Bob's pulsing damage zone inverts the damage source, and the gem has a 2.5 s cooldown the audit missed (skill_cooldown added).

audit.poe: Area curse: -cold resistance and extra chance for the target to be frozen by cold.
audit.bob: coldSap hex: -25..-44% cold resistance in r3.5, working. Freeze-chance-taken half absent.
audit.repair: Optionally add enemy-side 'extra freeze chance' to the hex.

audit.poe: (From poedb, current version; no PoB data.) A cold projectile bursts at impact or the target point and leaves a chilling area that deals cold damage over time and creeps toward nearby enemies for about 5 s.
audit.bob: A 3 s cold ground zone at the target pulsing every 0.5 s, with increased chill effect (real: effect.chill is consumed, cold hits can chill). It is stationary and has no projectile or creeping, but the lasting chilling-field loop is there.
audit.repair: Optionally let a ground zone drift toward the nearest enemy.

audit.poe: 25% reserved herald: added cold damage to attacks and spells, and shattering (killing) a frozen enemy makes it explode in AoE cold damage.
audit.bob: Added cold base damage works. A kill trigger on a frozen enemy (targetHas freeze) explodes for 8% of its max life as cold in radius 2.5, drained through the explosion queue so chains work. Damage is life-based rather than flat, which is a number change.

audit.poe: A heavy cold-converted mace/staff hit with a freeze chance; frozen enemies on low life shatter, the third strike in a row freezes more easily, and it adds cold damage to chilled enemies. The freeze to shatter combo is the niche.
audit.bob: Heavy melee at 155-200% with 60% cold conversion, 25% freeze chance and increased chill effect (all read). The shatter, the third-hit combo and the damage vs chilled enemies are gone (the port note admits the shatter is dropped).
audit.repair: Add an execute on frozen enemies below a third of life (the engine has a culling check that could take a frozen condition) and a consecutive-hit counter for extra freeze.

lines: Melee attack with a mace, sceptre or staff (one- or two-handed). 155% (level 1) to 200% (level 20) of base attack damage; 60% of physical converted to cold. [wiki][pob]
25% chance to freeze, 35% increased chill duration, (10-29)% increased effect of chill. +2 to 4 melee range; mana 5. [wiki][pob]
Adds (2-75) to (3-113) cold damage against chilled enemies. [wiki][pob]
Every third successive strike freezes as though it dealt (200-390)% more damage (a much better freeze chance on the third hit). [wiki][pob]
A frozen enemy on less than one third life shatters when hit; unique enemies do not shatter. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit line holds. Details to carry: shatter excludes unique enemies, and the weapon list is mace/sceptre/staff only (Bob lists axe too).

audit.poe: Reserved buff that cuts physical and fire hit damage only while stationary, chills (30% slow) any attacker that hits you, and lays chilled ground when you move. A stand-and-tank defence that punishes melee attackers.
audit.bob: Reserves 25% mana for a flat all-type hitTaken reduction at all times. The engine has a stationary condition (sim combat.ts) and nothing to chill attackers on being hit; neither is used.
audit.repair: Gate the reduction on the stationary condition for physical and fire only, and add a hit-taken trigger that chills the attacker.

lines: Instant buff that reserves mana (25 in PoB data); no area, affects only the owner [wiki][pob]

While stationary, take 8% (L1) to 13% (L20) less Physical and 8% to 12% less Fire damage from Hits; it applies at the very end of the damage calculation and not to damage over time such as burning [wiki]
Enemies that hit you are chilled for 0.5 s, slowing their action speed by 30% (3.1.0) [wiki]
While moving you leave a trail of chilled ground that lasts 2.5 s (L1) to 4.4 s (L20); chilled ground chills what stands in it and does not stack with other chills [wiki]
Other damage types (cold, lightning, chaos) get no reduction [wiki]
spec.check: Holds: the wiki gem text and stat_text match the audit line (physical and fire only, while stationary, 30% slow chill on attackers, chilled ground while moving). Bob applies a smaller all-type reduction at all times.

audit.poe: (From poedb, current version; no PoB data.) A shield retaliation: usable for 2 s after a block, sweeps a cone of ice, 100% cold, and always freezes, with off-hand damage scaled by the shield's defences; 3.5 s cooldown.
audit.bob: A free-use shield swipe with only 50% cold conversion and a 20% freeze chance; the block-gated retaliation, guaranteed freeze and shield scaling are all gone.
audit.repair: Gate on a post-block window with a 3.5 s cooldown, convert 100% to cold with guaranteed freeze, and scale damage with shield defences.

spec.page: Glacial Shield Swipe (page then titled Riposte)
lines: The page title resolves to the gem that was called Riposte in 3.9 (renamed later; release 1.3.0 in the reference list). The cold, 2 s window, always-freeze shield swipe of the audit is the later gem. [wiki]
Riposte is a counter-attack that triggers automatically when you block and cannot be used directly. It needs no shield as such, only a block. [wiki][pob]
Cooldown 0.8 s. Melee single-target physical hit: 160% (level 1) to 230% (level 20) of base attack damage plus (2-56) to (3-85) added attack physical. [wiki][pob]
Uses both weapons while dual wielding. +0 to 2 melee range. [wiki][pob]
No conversion to cold and no freeze (a unique, Lycosidae, adds cold to counter-attacks). [wiki]
spec.check: The audit line does not hold for 3.9: it describes the post-3.9 Glacial Shield Swipe; the 3.9 gem is Riposte, a block-triggered physical counter-attack with a 0.8 s cooldown. Bob's free-use, shield-gated cold arc has none of the trigger loop, so it stays gutted, but the repair target changes (trigger on block, not a post-block window, no always-freeze or shield-defence scaling).
spec.decision: The 3.9 gem is Riposte (a physical counter-attack triggered whenever the character blocks), not the cold shield swipe Bob's gem is modelled on. Rebase Rime Rebuke on Riposte (block-triggered, 0.8 s cooldown, drop the cold/freeze/shield identity), or keep the later design as a Bob original outside the 3.9 repair plan?

audit.poe: Added cold damage to hits.
audit.bob: As Venom Seed, cold.

audit.poe: A series of icicle bursts erupting in a rolling line out from the caster, each damaging enemies in it, half converted to cold.
audit.bob: Ground zone as a strip (line 6, radius 1.6) pulsing 5 times at 0.2 s with 60% cold conversion. All five pulses hit the whole strip at once rather than travelling outward.
audit.repair: Optional: sequence the pulses along the line.

audit.poe: A melee-range strike (extended range) that releases icy blades from the first enemy hit towards other enemies; a melee skill with a projectile shower from the target.
audit.bob: A projectile fan of 5 cold blades (range 7, 60 degree spread) fired from the character; there is no melee hit and no origin at the enemy, and the player will stand off at range. Cold conversion 60% and added cold are read.
audit.repair: Make the use a melee hit on the target and on contact spawn the fan from the target's position at the other enemies.

lines: Melee strike with +18 to +21 melee weapon range, any melee weapon (dual wield alternates), 100-140% of base attack damage, 60% of physical converted to cold, plus added cold. [wiki][pob]

Only if the strike hits an enemy, it releases (4-7) additional projectiles (icy blades) from behind the first enemy hit, flying at other nearby enemies; if the strike misses no blades come out (unlike Lightning Strike). [wiki]

Blades carry the same damage multiplier and cold conversion as the strike but count as projectile damage, so they scale with projectile mods rather than melee mods; projectile speed +0-19% by level. [wiki][pob]
Melee Splash does not release blades from secondary targets; Faster Projectiles lengthens the blades' reach. [wiki]
No shotgun flag in pob, so each enemy is hit once per use by the blades. [pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds (melee strike, then blades from the struck enemy to others, none on a miss). Bob's cold conversion and added cold are right; the weapon list also drops staves, sceptres and two-handers, which the gem allows.

audit.poe: Blink dealing cold damage with chilled ground at the origin; cooldown recovers faster per nearby enemy (a pack-fighting blink).
audit.bob: Plain blink (distance 9, cd 3.5, longer than PoE's 3). No damage, chill ground, or cooldown recovery from nearby enemies.
audit.repair: Add blink damage/chill zone plus a cooldown reduction per nearby enemy to the blink utility.

lines: Instant movement spell (cast time 0); teleport to a location; mana 12 to 22; base crit 5%, effectiveness 140%. [wiki][pob]
In 3.9 the cold damage and chilled ground occur only around where you LEFT (the start point); 3.10 added the same at the end point. [wiki]
Chilled ground lasts 3 s; base travel distance 32 (3.10 raised it to 42). [wiki]
Cooldown 3 s (2.6 s at L20) that recovers (15-19)% faster per Normal/Magic enemy in the area and (80-99)% faster per Rare/Unique enemy in the area. [wiki][pob]
Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. [wiki]
spec.check: Audit PoE line holds against the wiki (origin-only damage and chill in 3.9, per-enemy cooldown recovery). I added the numbers: cooldown 3 s, rares count 5x normals. Bob's distance 9 / cd 3.5 / cast 0.4 are drifted from the instant, 3 s original.

audit.poe: Barrage Support: supported bow or wand attacks fire their extra projectiles sequentially, so they can all hit the same target, at a damage penalty and an attack-time cost per projectile. (Row corrected after checking the 3.9 wiki; see the erratum.)
audit.bob: Projectiles +4 at 20-30% less damage, fired together in a fan; a use hits each target once. It is Multiple Projectiles with bigger numbers.
audit.repair: Sequential firing with a hit list per volley, and the attack-time cost per extra projectile.

lines: Supports projectile attack skills used with bows or wands (not triggered, channelled or minion-creating skills); added in 3.9.0 [wiki]
Fires 3 additional projectiles (not 4), fired sequentially rather than all at once, much like the Barrage skill [wiki][pob]
Supported skills deal 68% (L1) to 62% (L20) less Damage [wiki]
Each projectile adds 5% more Attack Time (and 5% more Trap and Mine Throwing Time) per projectile fired [wiki]
Restricted to bows and wands [wiki]
spec.check: Holds (the audit row was already corrected for the shotgun point). One extra note for the repair: Bob's numbers are far from 3.9, with 4 extra projectiles at 20-30% less damage versus 3 extra at 68-62% less, plus the attack-time cost.

audit.poe: Grants Elusive (strong defence) and Phasing; enemies that come near are Withered; ends when you use a skill; blink cooldown.
audit.bob: Upkeep buff (4 s, cd 5): moveSpeed inc 20 and chaos penetration 10..24 as a Wither stand-in. No Elusive, no wither stacks on enemies, no phasing, no end-on-skill.
audit.repair: Add an Elusive-style evade/damage-reduction buff and a proximity wither (stacking chaos damage taken) aura.

lines: Instant movement spell (Blink tag), cooldown 3 s that does not recover while the buff is active; mana 8 to 23. [wiki][pob]
On use it removes any existing Elusive, then grants a fresh Elusive and a Phasing buff (0-38% increased Elusive effect with gem level). [wiki]
Elusive is [memory] +30% movement speed and a chance to avoid hits, both decaying over time (20% of effect lost per second, per poedb).

Enemies that enter the area around you are Withered, 4 (L1) to 6 (L20) stacks the first time each enters, lasting 3 s; radius +0 to +6. Withered is [memory] increased chaos damage taken per stack. [wiki][pob]
Using any skill, or losing Elusive, ends the buff and its effects. Shares a cooldown with other Blink skills. [wiki]
spec.check: Audit PoE line holds against the wiki; the wiki adds the stack counts (4-6 per enemy, 3 s) and that the buff dies as soon as you use any other skill, which is hard to square with an auto-casting character (it would end on the next attack). Bob's moveSpeed + chaos penetration upkeep is a loose stand-in.
spec.decision: Withering Step ends the instant you use another skill, but Bob's character fights continuously and would cancel it on the next attack. Should Bob exempt it (buff lasts a fixed time, or ends only when you use a non-attack skill), or keep the original rule so it works as a short opening bonus that the first skill use ends?

audit.poe: A channelled debuff cloud that deals no damage: slows enemies and stacks Withered (up to 15, each +chaos damage taken), amplifying your other chaos skills.
audit.bob: A damaging chaos spell burst around the caster (30% effectiveness) with +20 chaos penetration on its own hits only. No enemy debuff, no stacking, no benefit to any other skill; it is a primary chaos nova, the opposite of Wither's support role.
audit.repair: Make it a utility skill (policy upkeep) that applies a stacking 'withered' status on enemies in range (+chaos damage taken per stack, max 15) via the hex/status layer.

lines: Channelled chaos spell (0.28 s cast, mana 3 to 9, paid again every tick while channelling); on-use triggers fire only when the channel starts. It has no damage line. [wiki][pob]
Each tick casts in an area (+0 to 19% increased area of effect) and inflicts Hinder: (30-36)% reduced movement speed, 0.5 s base duration. [wiki][pob]
It also inflicts Withered: 6% increased chaos damage taken per stack, stacking up to 15 times (it was 20 before 3.1.0), each stack lasting 2 s, so a held channel builds up to +90%. [wiki][pob]
Withered amplifies all of your other chaos damage, which is the point of the gem (a support-style debuffer). [wiki]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB (6% per stack, 15 stacks, slow, no damage).

audit.poe: Hits can make enemies flee: they run away from you and stop attacking for a few seconds.
audit.bob: Global hexOnHit.leadenLimbs: hit enemies are slowed (reduced action and movement speed), always, using the one hex slot. Slowing cuts incoming damage, but fleeing (leave melee, break aggro) is gone, and it competes with curses for the hex slot.
audit.repair: Give monsters a flee state (fleeT already exists for thieves) triggered by a chance on hit from this support.

lines: Support for any skill that hits enemies; mana multiplier 100%. [wiki]
25% (L1) to 44% (L20) chance on hit to cause monsters to flee. [wiki][pob]
A fleeing monster runs to a random point away from the player until it reaches it, is interrupted, or cannot get there and gives up; a stun interrupts fleeing. [wiki]
Magic monsters have a 50% chance to avoid fleeing; rare monsters are immune. The wiki calls the gem obsolete for scary rares and bosses. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds (adds that rares are immune and magic monsters resist half the time). Bob's always-on slow is a proxy: it does not remove enemies from melee and uses the single hex slot.

audit.poe: A chaos damage-over-time debuff that also applies your linked curses to enemies in the area, growing stronger and longer for each curse applied (curse spreader/DoT).
audit.bob: rotBane hex: -12..-21% chaos res and increased damage taken. No DoT, no linking of other curses, no scaling per curse; it is a generic curse.
audit.repair: Give it an actual chaos DoT on enemies in radius and let it re-apply the character's other cast hexes (scaling DoT per hex applied).

lines: Spell (0.6 s cast), curse tag, cannot be totemed, trapped or mined: applies a chaos DoT debuff to enemies in an area, base duration 2 s, 45.6 base dps at L1 up to 895.6 at L20; it does not hit. [wiki]

It also applies the curses linked to it (only curses from skill gems requiring level 24-70 or lower by Bane's level) to those enemies. Bane itself does not count to the curse limit but the curses it applies do. [wiki]
Each curse applied adds 28-47% more damage (additive with each other) and 50% increased debuff duration. A level-20 Bane with two curses deals 94% more damage. [wiki]
Only linked curses count; curse on hit, Blasphemy or directly cast curses give no bonus, and Bane will not gain damage if the curse limit is reached. [wiki]
Mana 10 at L1, 20 at L20; spell damage modifiers apply to the DoT. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Added: the bonus is additive per linked curse, only linked curses count, and applying them respects the curse limit; the audit's repair of using the character's other cast hexes matches in spirit but PoE links specific curses.
spec.decision: PoE links curses to Bane by socket link. Bob has no links between active skills, so what should stand for the linked curses: the character's other equipped curse/hex skills (as the audit suggests), or a fixed set of hexes the player picks for Bane?

audit.poe: Mark: enemy is far easier to crit (and for more), and killing it grants life, mana and a chance for a power charge.
audit.bob: critMark hex: +40..85% inc crit chance and +15..40 crit multi for the character vs the target (character.ts selfMods under 'targetCursed', real), plus a small 6..15% damage-taken. Kill rewards (life, mana, Insight charge) dropped. Quirk: selfMods apply whenever the target holds any hex, not specifically this mark.
audit.repair: Add recover.kill.life/mana and chargeOn.kill.insight to the hex selfMods conditioned on the target having this mark.

lines: Curse (Spell, AoE, Duration), cast time 0.5 s, base duration 6 s (L1) to 9.8 s (L20), mana 16 to 33. [wiki][pob]
Cursed enemies take 20% increased extra damage from critical strikes (it multiplies only the part of the multiplier above 100%). [wiki][pob]
Hits against cursed enemies have +1.5% (L1) to +2.5% (L20) critical strike chance; since 3.6.0 this is added base chance and scales with increased crit chance. [wiki][pob]
Cursed enemies grant 16 life and 16 mana when killed at level 1, up to 25 each at level 20. [wiki][pob]
Cursed enemies have a 21% (L1) to 30% (L20) chance to grant a Power Charge when slain. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds; 'far easier to crit' overstates the base numbers (+1.5..2.5 flat chance, +20% extra crit damage), so Bob's 40..85% increased crit chance and the 6..15% damage taken are Bob's own scaling, not the gem's.

audit.poe: A trap that releases repeated waves of physical bursts in a line over a few seconds.
audit.bob: A line ground zone (6 long, radius 1.8) that erupts every 0.9 s for 4.5 s, about five waves.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: A slam sending a wave of broken ground forward; each enemy it hits releases a circular shockwave that damages enemies around it, so one hit spreads through a pack.
audit.bob: One burst of radius 2.2 centred on the target with a flat +15% more damage standing in for the secondary wave; no line wave and no per-enemy secondary shockwave.
audit.repair: Add a forward line hit followed by a smaller, reduced-damage burst around each enemy hit, once per enemy.

lines: Melee area attack with a mace, sceptre, axe or staff (one- or two-handed). 175% (level 1) to 220% (level 20) of base attack damage; mana 8; attack speed multiplier 75%. [wiki][pob]
The slam creates a wave of broken ground that travels forward in a straight line (about 60 units long; area increases widen it) and damages enemies it passes. [wiki]

Every enemy the wave hits (it needs to pass the evasion check) releases a circular shockwave (radius 15 base, +0 to 6) that damages other enemies around it for 60% less damage; the shockwave hits everything in range regardless of evasion. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB. The shockwave is 60% less damage (40% of base).

audit.poe: A projectile that applies a chaos damage-over-time debuff and heals you for a share of the debuff's damage; the debuff is spread by Contagion.
audit.bob: A chaos projectile that bursts (radius 1.2) with 100% poison chance and leech.life 0.5. The leech applies only to the hit damage (leech is computed in applyHit), not to the poison ticks, so the sap heal is close to nothing; the DoT is poison, which does not use spell-damage scaling.
audit.repair: Make the debuff a skill DoT with a life-leech share of its tick damage, instead of poison plus hit leech.

lines: Chaos spell projectile (0.7 s cast, 5% crit, 60% effectiveness) that deals a small hit (9-14 to 433-649 chaos by gem level). [wiki]
On impact it explodes in a small radius and applies a chaos DoT debuff to enemies there, 3.8 s base duration, 31.2 base dps at L1 up to 1503.2 at L20. The explosion itself deals no hit damage. [wiki]

The caster regenerates life from the debuff while it lasts, based on the tooltip DoT and not on damage actually dealt. The wiki is inconsistent on the rate: stat text says 0.5% of debuff damage (permyriad 50), prose says 0.05 x tooltip DoT per affected enemy. Either way it is a regeneration, not on-hit leech. [wiki]
The debuff is spread by Contagion on death. Essence Drain cannot be used with traps or mines (3.3.0). [wiki]
Spell damage modifiers apply to the DoT; it is a debuff, not poison. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Added: the heal is a regen scaled to tooltip DoT while the debuff lasts (the exact rate is ambiguous on the wiki), and the gem cannot be trapped or mined although Bob's def lists both; that is a data detail, not a loop change.

audit.poe: A wand shot that bursts into a cluster of small explosions around the impact point, giving a wand attack its area damage.
audit.bob: Wand projectile that explodes on impact in a 2.2-tile radius with area scaling; the four clusters are one burst (explosion hits everything in radius, verified in explode()).
audit.repair: None needed (optionally several offset explosions so one target can be hit by more than one).

audit.poe: A ballista totem fires a few arrows that can all hit the same enemy (shotgunning), turning close range into a burst with added physical damage. (Row corrected after checking the 3.9 wiki; see the erratum.)
audit.bob: Fires a 3-arrow fan with added physical damage, but all projectiles of one use share a single hit list (src/sim/actions.ts useHits), so an enemy is hit once per use and there is no shotgun.
audit.repair: A per-skill shotgun flag (3.9 flags only Shrapnel Ballista and Shattering Steel), giving each projectile its own hit list.

lines: Bow attack that summons a ballista totem (lasts 8 s; +2 to max ballistas; half attack speed). [wiki][pob]
33-38% of base attack damage plus added physical (2-56 to 3-85 at L1 to L20); fires 2 additional arrows (3) in a cone. [wiki][pob]
Arrows break into shrapnel and an enemy can be hit by multiple arrows of the same attack (flag projectiles_can_shotgun, one of only two 3.9 skills with it). [wiki][pob]
Added in 3.9.0. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Bob's 3-arrow fan, added physical and two extra totems are right; only the shotgun (a hit list per arrow) is missing.

audit.poe: Increased rarity of items dropped by enemies killed by the supported skill.
audit.bob: A global itemRarity inc, read at drop time in run/run.ts (db.mult('itemRarity')), active while the support is socketed on a usable skill. Fine.

audit.poe: A short flame surge in front of you that cannot ignite but does substantially more damage to burning enemies; pairs with ignite sources.
audit.bob: A beam in front (4.5 by 2) with 50-88% more damage when the target is ignited (targetIgnited is a real target condition in the profile mask) and cannotInflictEle so it never ignites. The condition is evaluated for the main target only.
audit.repair: None.

audit.poe: A channelled fire beam that deals damage over time, intensifying with each stage you hold it on a target (up to 8), applies fire exposure at max stages, and leaves a burn on enemies that leave the beam.
audit.bob: A short instant-line beam (length 4) fired repeatedly as spell hits with constant 25% fire penetration standing in for exposure; the stages, the damage-over-time nature and the lingering burn are not modelled (the port note claims averaged stacks, but no stack stat exists).
audit.repair: Give beam skills a per-target stage count that adds damage per tick and applies exposure at max, plus a burn that outlasts the beam.

lines: Channelled fire beam (0.5 s cast, one mana payment per tick) that applies a burning damage-over-time debuff to enemies it touches. It does not hit. [wiki]

Each cast interval a target stays in the beam adds a stage, up to 8; the first stage deals the base DoT (11.7 base fire dps at L1, 439.4 at L20) and each additional stage adds 60% of that (stage damage -40% final). [wiki]
At maximum stages it applies Fire Exposure (-25% fire resistance). [wiki]
An enemy that leaves the beam keeps burning for the debuff duration (1.5 s base). [wiki]
Spell, fire, elemental, burning and DoT modifiers apply; it is not a projectile or area skill. Cast speed (to +150%) also raises the beam's turn rate. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds against the wiki (8 stages, exposure at max, lingering burn). Added the numbers: stages add 60% of base damage each, linger 1.5 s, -25% fire resistance. Bob's constant 25% penetration is exposure without the ramp.

audit.poe: No-reservation toggle: you burn yourself for a large share of life per second (fire damage mitigated by your fire resistance, offset by regen) while enemies near you take fire damage that scales with your damage modifiers, and spells deal more damage. Defines a commit-to-regen-and-fire-res build.
audit.bob: auraBurn and selfBurn are real (sim/utility.ts tickAuraBurn): a fixed share of max life per second to enemies within 2.8 tiles (their resists apply) and a flat self drain that cannot kill. Self damage ignores fire resistance and ES; the enemy damage is not scaled by any damage modifier; the spell more mod works.
audit.repair: Run the self burn through the player's fire resistance and damage-taken mods, and scale the enemy burn with fire/DoT modifiers.

lines: Instant spell buff with no reservation (0.3 s cooldown): grants 20-39% more spell damage while active. [wiki]

Burns nearby enemies for 20% of your maximum life per second as base fire damage (and 20% of max energy shield), plus a level-scaled base fire DoT (35.8 at L1 up to 1541.8 at L20). Fire, burning, DoT, area and generic damage modifiers apply; spell damage does not. Enemy fire resistance applies. [wiki]
You burn for 90% of maximum life per second (and 70% of max ES) as fire damage, reduced by your fire resistance and damage-taken modifiers (about 22.5% of life per second at 75% fire res). [wiki]
The self-burn is non-lethal: the effect ends when you reach 1 life. It keeps ES from recharging; spell block and dodge do not stop it. [wiki]
Radius +0..5 by gem level. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds against the wiki. Added the numbers: the enemy burn is 20% of max life per second (modifier-scaled, not spell damage) and the self-burn is 90% of max life per second mitigated by fire resistance; the commit-to-regen-and-fire-res design is the point.

audit.poe: The skill is thrown as a trap that fires once when an enemy walks near it; trade is a trap-laying rhythm for burst at a distance.
audit.bob: adds trap: placeDeployable lays traps; each goes off once when an enemy is within 1.6 tiles (deploy.ts), lasting 8 s, up to three sets down. Throw speed and trap damage scale with level. Core loop intact.

audit.poe: Fire an arrow, teleport to where it lands and leave a clone at your old spot for a few seconds; mobility plus a decoy/damage clone on a 3 s cooldown.
audit.bob: Summons a stationary shadow archer clone for 3 s beside you; the player never teleports (no travel or blink in the definition), though the clone is kept.
audit.repair: Add the blink utility alongside the summon so the player moves to the target while the clone stays behind.

lines: Bow attack, cast time 1.0 s, cooldown 3 s, mana 14 to 20; fires an arrow at the target destination. [wiki]
When the arrow lands you are teleported to it (the frame after landing; you can still be hit while it flies), and a clone appears at your OLD location. [wiki]
The clone is a minion that uses your bow and quiver; base duration 3 s; minions deal 75% more damage, plus up to 114% increased damage and 57% increased life at L20. [wiki][pob]
If a movement-restricting ailment (freeze, stun-style) hits between aiming and firing, the skill stops and goes on cooldown. [wiki]
spec.check: Audit PoE line holds against the wiki. Bob has the clone (3 s) but no teleport, which is the half of the loop that gives the gem its name.

audit.poe: Swap places with a targeted enemy or corpse, damaging at both ends; if a corpse, it explodes (corpse-driven mobility/damage).
audit.bob: Same blink as Dash (distance 8, cd 3). No swap with the target, no corpse, no damage; the port note admits both are dropped.
audit.repair: Needs a corpse consumable: swap the player with a corpse or enemy and deal area damage at both points, exploding the corpse.

lines: Destroys your body and recreates it at the location of a targeted enemy or corpse. It deals spell damage in an area at both the origin and the destination. [wiki]
It is not a swap: the target does not move. With no specific target, it prefers corpses over enemies. [wiki]

Since 3.8.0 it no longer needs a corpse. If it does consume one, the area is 300% more and the corpse also explodes for fire damage equal to 6% of its maximum life. That explosion ignores spell-damage modifiers and cannot be reflected. [wiki]

The spell deals 3 to 5 base fire damage at level 1 and 154 to 231 at level 20, plus 3% of your maximum life. Effectiveness is 70%, base crit 6%, cast time 0.7 s. Mana 8 at level 1, 23 at level 20. [wiki][pob]
It has no cooldown (Bob has a 3 s cooldown) and cannot be repeated. [wiki][pob]
Base radius was halved in 3.8.0. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's 'swap places with' is wrong: the 3.9 gem teleports you to the target and leaves the target where it is. It also no longer requires a corpse, and the corpse is an optional bonus (300% more area plus an explosion). I replaced swap_positions with teleport_to_target and added percent_max_life_damage for the 3% max-life term. Bob's fixed-distance, cooldown-gated blink with no damage is still gutted.

audit.poe: Mace/staff hits trigger a shockwave: an area hit around the target, turning single-target strikes into area damage; weapon-restricted.
audit.bob: Only +25% increased area of effect and +25% more melee damage. radiusMult only affects arcs, bursts, beams and zones; on a thrust strike it does nothing, so it is plain more melee damage. No shockwave and no mace/staff restriction.
audit.repair: On hit, trigger a burst (castGranted) of the hit's damage around the target; restrict to maces and staves.

lines: Supports melee attack skills; not triggered attacks, totem skills or minion-creating skills; added in 3.7.0 [wiki]
Restricted to Maces, Sceptres and Staves (the audit mentions only maces and staves) [wiki]
A melee hit triggers a Shockwave, an attack dealing area damage to enemies around the enemy hit [wiki]
The shockwave deals 160% (L1) to 209.6% (L20) of your base attack damage, independent of the triggering hit's damage but affected by the other supports [wiki]
Internal cooldown 1 s; cooldown recovery rises up to +38% at L20 [wiki]
spec.check: Holds: the wiki confirms a triggered area hit around the target on melee hit with a weapon restriction. I added sceptres, the 1 s internal cooldown and the base-damage scale (160-210%, independent of the hit) to the spec; Bob's flat +25% area and +25% melee damage has none of it.

audit.poe: A trap with a large explosion followed by several smaller ones around it; used for repeated area bursts from one trigger.
audit.bob: A fire/physical blast that also carries a 'repeats' of 3-6. In the sim a repeat re-fires the placement, so one cast lays 1+repeats traps in the same spot that all go off together (src/sim/actions.ts echoes, deploy.ts placeDeployable); the burst count is kept but arrives simultaneously and with no smaller-radius ring.
audit.repair: Optionally make deployed shots honour repeats as delayed blasts instead of extra traps.

audit.poe: Attacks leech mana.
audit.bob: leech.mana is read.

audit.poe: Attacks impale: stored physical damage reflected on following hits; impale effect increased.
audit.bob: chance.impale is read; the impale model exists (impales on the target, hit counter) plus more physical. The impale-effect bonus is not in the mods list.

audit.poe: Launches unpredictable sparks that wander randomly for 2 s until they hit an enemy; cheap lightning clear with erratic coverage.
audit.bob: A five-projectile fan over 140 degrees (range 7) with projectile speed scaling; the erratic wandering and repeated hits are replaced by wide coverage and one hit per target per use.
audit.repair: Optional: randomise projectile headings and let them live longer.

audit.poe: Place a marker that is struck by lightning after a short delay for area damage; when it goes off, every other marker you have placed also goes off.
audit.bob: A ground zone at the target: 0.4 s delay then a pulse every 0.5 s for 1.5 s (three pulses, each a full hit), with shock effect. It is a short lingering storm instead of a single delayed strike, and markers neither coexist nor trigger one another.
audit.repair: Make it a single delayed strike that records markers and detonates all live markers together.

lines: Spell (lightning, area, duration), 0.5 s cast, effectiveness 100%, base crit 6%. Sets a marker at a location. [wiki][pob]
After 1.5 s the marker is struck once by lightning for area damage (radius 20 base, +0 to 6 by level). It is a single strike, not a lingering storm. [wiki][pob]
When it strikes, every other marker you have placed is also struck at that moment. [wiki]
(10-29)% increased effect of shock; damage 16-31 (level 1) to 408-758 (level 20); mana 6 to 16. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB (single delayed strike that sets off the other markers). The delay is 1.5 s, where Bob's zone fires after 0.4 s and then pulses.

audit.poe: Leap to the target and slam it; knocks enemies back and stuns full-life enemies; movement skill with weapon damage.
audit.bob: Attack with travel 7 (actions.ts moves the player toward the target) and a slam burst r2 140..170% damage, stun duration inc. 'Stuns full-life enemies' is not implemented and there is no knockback; both are minor.
audit.repair: Optionally add stun-on-full-life-target condition.

audit.poe: A melee strike (physical and fire) that launches molten balls from the struck enemy that explode on landing for area damage; a melee skill with its own AoE.
audit.bob: Pure projectile behaviour: four balls fanned 90 degrees from the caster, range 6, each exploding in radius 1 at -50%. There is no melee hit; the explosions do shotgun a close target (explode() ignores the hit list).
audit.repair: Same hybrid behaviour as Bolt Cleave: melee hit, then balls launched from the target that explode where they land.

lines: Melee strike, 120-139% of base attack damage, 60% of physical converted to fire, +2 to +6 melee range, plus added fire; any melee weapon. [wiki][pob]
Needs to hit an enemy (3.7.0) to produce balls: 3 additional projectiles (4 balls), split evenly among all enemies hit by the strike when it hits several. [wiki][pob]

Balls are ground-targeted: scattered at random over a 270 degree area, 5 to 20 units from the struck enemy, and explode where they land for area attack damage; area mods grow both the explosion and the scatter. [wiki]
Balls deal 50% less damage (and 50% less damage over time) and cannot chain, pierce or fork. [wiki][pob]
More than one ball can hit the same enemy, including the one that was struck. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds, and its observation that Bob's explosions can hit a close target several times matches the wiki, so that part is already right. Missing: the melee strike, and balls that start at the struck enemy and land scattered around it (270 degrees, 5-20 units), not a fan forward from the caster.

audit.poe: Guard that adds armour and absorbs damage, then explodes dealing fire damage to nearby enemies based on the damage it absorbed; the reflect is the point.
audit.bob: Same as Iron Hide: hitTaken more -25..-40 for 4 s, cd 6 (buff moltenGuard). No armour, no absorb pool, no reflected/exploding damage; the 'fire' flavour does nothing.
audit.repair: Track damage absorbed by the guard in a pool and, at expiry or depletion, deal a fire burst around the player scaled by it.

lines: Guard spell, instant (0 cast time), 4 s cooldown that does not recover while the buff is active, shared with the other Guard skills (Steelskin, Immortal Call). [wiki][pob]
Buff lasts 3 s base (it was 10 s before 3.7.0) and adds (50-858) armour. [wiki][pob]
75% of damage from hits is taken from the buff before life or energy shield; the buff can take damage equal to 20% of your armour, up to 10000. [wiki][pob]
When the buff expires or is depleted it reflects (100-3000)% of the damage taken from the buff as fire damage to enemies around you (radius 15); this cannot crit or use added damage. [wiki][pob]
Mana 8 to 12. The older prose says damage is lost on expiry; the 3.9 gem text says the reflect also fires on expiry. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds; add the numbers (3 s, 75% into the pool, pool capped at 20% of armour, reflect 100-3000%) and the shared Guard cooldown.

audit.poe: (From poedb, current version; no PoB data.) Lob a fiery orb that explodes in an area where it hits the ground, then bounces forward 2-3 times, exploding at each bounce; area damage along a line.
audit.bob: Chain behaviour (3 chains, range 4): the bolt jumps from enemy to enemy like a lightning arc and each link is a single-target hit; no explosion at each landing, and it needs enemies to chain.
audit.repair: Make each chain link an area burst (explodeRadius) and let the orb bounce forward regardless of enemies.

spec.page: Rolling Magma (page then titled Magma Orb)
lines: The page title resolves to the gem that was called Magma Orb in 3.9 (renamed later; release 2.0.0), and PoB 3.9 has it under that name (the input says "no POB data" only because of the rename). [wiki][pob]
Fire spell, 0.7 s cast, effectiveness 140%, crit 5%: lobs an orb in an arc to the targeted spot (up to a maximum range). It does not seek enemies. [wiki][pob]

The orb explodes where it lands (radius 14), then chains: a new orb bounces on in the same direction (spacing 16) and explodes again, whether or not an enemy is there. Chains +1 at level 1, +2 from level 10, so 2 or 3 explosions in all. [wiki][pob]
Chained orbs do not re-aim at enemies; fork and pierce do nothing (the orb only touches the ground). Simultaneous explosions never hit one enemy twice. [wiki]
Damage 9-12 (level 1) to 716-1073 (level 20) fire; mana 6 to 23. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds (explode on impact, then forward bounces that explode); the exact count is 2-3 explosions in all (1-2 chains), not 3-4. Bob's lightning-style enemy-to-enemy chain with single-target links and a -15% more penalty is the opposite of the ground-bounce design.

audit.poe: Linked spells are cast when the supported melee attack kills an enemy; a melee build gets automatic spells.
audit.bob: Declared as supports ['melee'] with a kill trigger. Character.buildTriggers links a spell only if supportApplies(support, spell) passes, i.e. the spell must itself have the melee type; no spell does, so skills is empty and castSocketed returns false: it never casts, and only taxes the melee skill's cost by 1.4. (Also the 'melee' tag filter is ignored for kill events.) Static reading, not run.
audit.repair: In buildTriggers, link the spells in the same item by their own applicability (spell + triggerable), not by the support's melee requirement; also check the killer's skill tags for kill events.

lines: Must support both a melee attack skill and a spell skill: the support is socketed in the link with both [wiki]
The attack triggers the linked spell when it kills an enemy with a melee hit; a kill from damage over time applied by the hit does not count [wiki]
100% chance to trigger at all levels, with a cooldown of 0.15 s (lowered from 0.25 in 3.5.0) [wiki][pob]
Cannot support totems, traps or mines; Vaal skills, channelling skills and skills that reserve mana cannot be triggered; it follows the usual trigger-gem rules [wiki]
spec.check: Holds: the wiki says the support must link both a melee attack and a spell, and triggers on a melee kill. Bob's cooldown is also the old 0.25 s instead of 0.15 s. The static code reading that buildTriggers never links a spell was not rechecked.

audit.poe: Move-speed and phasing buff; on using any skill it is replaced by a melee physical damage buff; Frenzy charges are consumed to extend duration.
audit.bob: Upkeep buff (2 s, cd 4): moveSpeed inc 30..39 and more melee physical damage 20..30, both at once. No phasing, no aggro reduction, no skill-use swap, no charge consumption.
audit.repair: Make the damage portion arm on first attack after the move buff and let Fervour charges extend duration.

lines: Instant movement spell, 4 s cooldown, mana 8 to 13. Gives a primary buff of 1.8 s base: (30-39)% increased movement speed, 50% reduced visibility to enemies, and Phasing (pass through enemies). [wiki][pob]
The (20-30)% more melee physical damage is present through the whole effect, in both buffs, despite what the tooltip implies; it does not apply to melee skills used by totems. [wiki][pob]

Using any skill replaces the primary buff with a short secondary buff (0.2 s base): the movement speed, phasing and stealth end on the first skill use while the melee damage bonus remains for that short window. [wiki][pob]
Each Frenzy charge removed adds 100% increased skill duration to both buffs. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds in outline, but its repair is backwards: the wiki says the melee damage buff is up during both buffs and it is the move speed (and phasing) that ends on the first skill use, so Bob's two-stat buff is closer than the audit thought, except that speed should not outlast the first attack and Frenzy (Fervour) charges should extend the duration.

audit.poe: Hit inflicts a flat chaos damage over time for 10 s regardless of hit damage or type; works for any hitting skill.
audit.bob: Modelled as 100% poison with +400% duration. Poison needs physical or chaos hit damage (elemental-only skills deal nothing) and scales with hit damage and poison stacks, unlike a flat DoT.
audit.repair: Add a flat, level-based chaos DoT that ignores hit damage.

lines: Support (130% mana multiplier) for any skill that hits: supported skills inflict Decay on hit, a chaos damage over time of 120 dps at gem L1 up to 843 at L20. [wiki]
Decay lasts 8 seconds; the wiki states 8 s although the PoB stat id name says 10 seconds. [wiki]
It is flat damage independent of the hit's damage or type, so it works with any hitting skill, and it is not an ailment (poison modifiers and ailment support do not apply). [wiki]
It benefits from chaos and damage over time modifiers and inherits some tags (totem, trap, mine, minion, duration). Duration modifiers only affect it if the skill has the duration tag. [wiki]
spec.check: Corrected: the audit says 10 s but the 3.9 wiki gives 8 s (the PoB stat id name says 10; the wiki text was trusted). The rest of the audit line (flat chaos DoT regardless of hit) holds. Bob's poison stand-in also deals nothing for elemental-only skills, which is the opposite of Decay's point.

audit.poe: A mine you detonate to teleport to it, leaving smoke that blinds enemies at both ends and granting a movement speed buff; an escape and mobility tool on a shared blink cooldown.
audit.bob: A rally-policy buff cast when a pack is near: 5 s of 10-29% move speed and +40% evasion. No mine, no teleport and no blind; the engine has no blind, and its blink utility only closes distance to a target.
audit.repair: Use the blink utility kind with an escape mode (teleport back toward a safe spot when hurt) plus the buff, and add a blind status on enemies near the departure point.

lines: Mine thrown and placed, lasts 8 s (3.8.0); detonation is instant, only one Smoke Mine detonates per sequence (the most recent is chosen), and the mine cannot be re-armed [wiki]
Detonating teleports the owner to the mine (fails without line of sight, though both clouds still appear); no damage is dealt [wiki]
Leaves a smoke cloud at both the departure and arrival points that blinds enemies in it; Blind = 50% less hit chance, also lowers effective crit chance, base 4 s [wiki]
Grants 10% (L1) to 29% (L20) increased movement speed for 4 to 5 s; area of effect grows 0 to +76% and cooldown recovery 0 to +57% by L20 [wiki]
Cooldown 2.5 s with up to 3 stored uses, shared with all other Blink skills (3.8.0) [wiki][pob]
A Detonate Mines linked to Cast when Damage Taken makes it an automatic escape teleport when hit [wiki]
Mana 6 at L1 to 13 at L20 [pob]
spec.check: Holds: the wiki confirms teleport to the mine, blinding clouds at both ends, a movement speed buff and the shared Blink cooldown; I added the cloud as a ground zone at both ends and the shared cooldown with stored uses to the missing list. Bob keeps only the speed buff plus an invented +40% evasion.
spec.decision: In PoE the player places the mine and presses detonate; Bob's character decides. When should it place and detonate: as an escape when hurt or surrounded (matches the Cast-when-Damage-Taken pairing), or as a reposition toward the next pack? And is it acceptable to add Blind (50% less hit chance for 4 s) as a new enemy status the whole game then has to honour?

audit.poe: Chain pulls you to a distant enemy or hits directly when close, with a cone behind; gains rage per hit, and the cone grows with rage.
audit.bob: Melee arc 90 range 3.4, rageOn.meleeHit 1 (rage is real in sim/buffs.ts). No pull, and no area growth per rage - the rage feeds only the generic rage bonuses.
audit.repair: Add area scaling per rage held and a short pull (travel) to a distant target.

lines: Melee area attack and movement skill (new in 3.7.0) with a one-handed mace, sceptre, sword or axe. 115% (level 1) to 135% (level 20) of base attack damage; attack speed about 20% faster; mana 8. [wiki][pob]
Used at range, it throws a chain that pulls you to the enemy it hits and deals area damage behind/around them; used up close, it just deals the area damage. [wiki]
Gain 1 Rage if the skill hits any enemy; +1 radius of the area per 5 Rage held. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB. Bob also allows staff, dagger and claw, which the gem does not.

audit.poe: Throws extra traps scattered around the target point, each weaker.
audit.bob: deployCount +2 with less damage. Every multi-trap throw lands in a ring of radius 1.2 around the target, so the cluster-vs-line geometry difference with Multiple Traps is not modelled, but the number-of-traps-for-damage trade works.

audit.poe: An arrow that tethers the enemy to the ground behind it: the enemy is slowed, takes increased projectile and attack damage, and must stay within the area or the snare breaks.
audit.bob: A plain bow projectile with +15% more damage only when the target is already chilled. The arrow is physical and nothing in the gem chills, so the condition is almost never true (the port note's 'slows by chilling' is not implemented).
audit.repair: Apply a movement slow and a damage-taken increase to the hit target for a few seconds (the chill slow mechanism can be set directly) and drop the chilled-target condition.

lines: Bow attack (new in 3.9.0). 140% (level 1) to 175% (level 20) of base attack damage; mana 8 to 10. [wiki][pob]
The arrow stays in the ground behind its final target (after chain, fork and pierce) and tethers that enemy to it. [wiki]
Ensnared enemies always count as moving, and each snare applies 40% less movement speed to normal and magic enemies, 30% to rares, 25% to uniques; up to 3 snares per enemy. [wiki][pob]
Ensnared enemies take (15-20)% increased projectile damage from attack hits. [wiki][pob]
The snare breaks if the enemy leaves its area of effect. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB; the damage-taken bonus is specifically increased projectile damage from attack hits, and the slow depends on enemy rarity and snare count (max 3). The slow lasts as long as the tether holds, not "a few seconds".

audit.poe: 25% reserved herald: 20% chance to poison and 10% more poison damage; poisoning builds Virulence (cap 40, decays faster the more you hold), which buffs an Agony Crawler minion (attack speed, physical damage, added physical) that dies when Virulence runs out.
audit.bob: Only the buff half: chance.poison 20 and a more poison damage mod (the engine reads both). No Virulence resource and no crawler minion, though the engine has summon utilities and minions.
audit.repair: Add a Virulence stack gained on poison and decaying, plus an owner-linked crawler minion whose damage scales with the stack.

lines: Herald: reserves mana (25 in PoB data), instant; the buff gives 20% chance to poison on hit and 10% more poison damage [wiki][pob]
Poisoning an enemy while buffed grants Virulence (capped at 40 stacks) and summons one Agony Crawler (max 1) that uses projectile and area attacks, and cannot taunt [wiki]
Virulence is lost over time, faster the more you hold; when it reaches 0 the Crawler dies. The Crawler is immune to damage and cannot otherwise die [wiki]

Per Virulence stack the Crawler gets 6% (L1) to 12% (L20) increased physical damage, 2% to 3% increased attack speed, and 1-3 to 45-84 added physical damage; it has an implicit 40% physical to chaos conversion [wiki][pob]
The Crawler's strength is therefore driven entirely by the Virulence stack count, so sustained poisoning converts into minion power [wiki]
spec.check: Audit PoE line holds (cap 40, accelerating decay, crawler dies at 0). I changed the verdict to gutted: Bob keeps only the static poison buff, while the Virulence stack and the Crawler are the loop and the main damage of the gem, and neither exists.

audit.poe: Added lightning damage to hits (wide spread).
audit.bob: As Venom Seed, lightning with a wide range.

audit.poe: Slam the ground to raise a sequence of six spikes (Blood Stance) that can each hit an enemy, or thrust them outward (Sand Stance); a multi-hit ground slam.
audit.bob: A single burst (radius 2.4) at 140-196% with a flat 25% bleed chance; the sequence of hits (and the per-hit scaling that offsets it) is collapsed into one hit, and stance is dropped.
audit.repair: Use the repeats primitive (or a multi-pulse burst) to land several reduced hits so on-hit effects like bleed and impale roll per spike.

lines: Melee area attack with a sword or axe (one- or two-handed): smash the ground to bring up spears. 140% (level 1) to 196% (level 20) of base attack damage. [wiki][pob]
Blood Stance (the default): 6 spikes burst from the ground in sequence in a small area ahead, each able to hit, at 65% less damage per spike (so about 35% each). [wiki][pob]

Sand Stance: the spikes are thrust outwards (wider, not repeated on one spot). Stance is set by the separate Blood and Sand gem (it alternates stances; Blood: more area damage, less area; Sand: the reverse). [wiki]
Attack speed multiplier 80% (20% slower); mana 6. [wiki][pob]
The 3.9 text and PoB list no bleed on this gem. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds (six spikes in sequence, stance-dependent). Two additions: the per-spike damage is 35% (65% less), and Bob's flat 25% bleed chance and its mace/staff weapon options are not in the 3.9 gem.

audit.poe: Dive through enemies dealing weapon damage in a line; weapon-restricted movement attack.
audit.bob: Melee attack with travel 7 and a 200-degree arc, weapon restricted. Hits once at the destination rather than along the path, a minor loss.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: A trap that keeps striking areas around it with lightning for a few seconds, with extra crit chance against shocked enemies.
audit.bob: A ground zone (radius 2.6, 3.5 s, pulse every 0.45 s) of lightning hits with +100-138% crit chance against shocked enemies via the targetShocked condition, which the sim does evaluate.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: A homing, piercing projectile that leeches energy shield and keeps applying a short strong chaos damage-over-time debuff to everything near it as it travels.
audit.bob: A slow piercing chaos projectile with 100% poison chance. It does not home, and nothing returns energy shield (the port note claims it does; the gem has no leech or ES stat).
audit.repair: Add ES leech from the hit (the leech machinery exists) and homing toward enemies in front.

lines: Chaos spell (added 3.6.0), 0.8 s cast. Fires one projectile that turns towards enemies in front of it and pierces all targets; it has a 10-unit radius and can be supported by Volley. [wiki][pob]
The hit deals (16-24) to (448-672) chaos damage and leeches 4% of the spell damage as energy shield. [wiki][pob]

While it travels it repeatedly applies a short but strong chaos damage-over-time debuff to each enemy in an area around it: base duration 0.6 s (up from 0.4 s in 3.9.0), about 137 (level 1) to 1944 (level 20) chaos damage per second. [wiki][pob]
Spell damage modifiers apply to the damage over time. Mana 14 to 26. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB. Bob substitutes a 100% poison chance for the area chaos debuff.

audit.poe: Consumes a corpse to give your minions energy shield, chaos damage and elemental resistances, scaling with corpses consumed.
audit.bob: A rally-policy buff on the character: gain physical as chaos and all-elemental resistance for 8 s; no energy shield, no corpse and no minion benefit.
audit.repair: Apply the resistances, chaos gain and an energy shield bonus to minions, scaling with corpses consumed.

lines: Consumes a corpse and up to 4 more around it. Cast time 1.0 s, mana 16 at level 1, 33 at level 20. [wiki][pob]
Base duration is 5 s, plus 1 s for each extra corpse, so 9 s at most. [wiki]
Your minions gain 4% of their maximum life as extra maximum energy shield for each corpse consumed (4% to 20%). The new energy shield is recovered as it is granted. 3.10 removed this. [wiki][pob]
They also gain 20 to 29% of their physical damage as extra chaos damage and +20 to 30% to all elemental resistances (Bob has 20 to 39 on resistances). [wiki][pob]
Only one offering can be active per player. Casting another cancels the older one. [wiki]
The effect is on minions only. The gem deals no damage and has no cooldown. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds against the wiki, including energy shield that scales with the number of corpses consumed. I added duration_per_corpse and single_active_offering, and noted that Bob's resistance range (20 to 39) overshoots the 3.9 range (20 to 30). I kept drifted because the timed minion-buff shape and the stat values still match; the missing parts are the recipient and the corpse-driven duration.

audit.poe: Throw projectiles that shatter into pieces that all hit in a cone, so the damage is huge point-blank and falls off with distance; the skill is a shotgun. (Row corrected after checking the 3.9 wiki; see the erratum.)
audit.bob: Three-projectile spread with +60% more damage when the target is within about 2 tiles (real condition), and a 40% impale chance. But all projectiles of one use share a hit list, so a close target is hit once instead of by every fragment; the shotgun stacking that is the skill's point is missing.
audit.repair: A per-skill shotgun flag (3.9 flags only Shrapnel Ballista and Shattering Steel), giving each projectile its own hit list.

lines: Attack with a sword or axe (one or two handed), 48-55% of base attack damage, 85% attack time (faster), added physical, 40% chance to impale. [wiki][pob]
Fires 2 additional projectiles (3) in a fixed 90 degree spread with 10 degrees of variance; they travel a fixed short distance that projectile speed does not change. [wiki][pob]
Each projectile shatters on hitting an enemy or reaching max distance, dealing area damage in front of the impact location; area mods only change the shatter. [wiki]
Projectiles gain damage as they travel farther: up to 100% more damage with hits at maximum distance. This is the opposite of a point-blank bonus. [wiki][pob]
Can shotgun: several projectiles of one attack may hit the same target (flag projectiles_can_shotgun), so extra projectiles add damage at close range. Point Blank still applies. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: Corrected: the audit and Bob both treat this as a close-range gem (damage 'huge point-blank, falling with distance', and Bob's +60% when the target is within about 2 tiles), but the 3.9 wiki stat text and the PoB stat say damage rises with distance travelled, up to 100% more. Bob's bonus is therefore inverted. The shotgun and the shatter area are real and still missing. SPIRIT.md names a distance-scaling field (scaleWithDistance, for Shield Charge) that may be reusable.

audit.poe: Projectiles fork into two on first hit if they do not pierce, covering enemies beside or behind.
audit.bob: Just +1 projectile in the starting fan with a small damage change; nothing happens on hit. The shared hit-list means it only adds coverage (DESIGN.md decision 2026-10-06; src/sim/actions.ts fire(): all projectiles of one use share one hit list).
audit.repair: On first hit, spawn two projectiles at an angle from the impact point.

lines: Support for projectile skills: the projectile forks into two the first time it hits an enemy and does not pierce it. [wiki][pob]
The original projectile disappears; the two new ones travel past the enemy away from each other at a 120 degree angle. [wiki]
A projectile forks once; the forked pair cannot fork. Piercing projectiles cannot fork, so skills like Freezing Pulse and Spectral Throw cannot be supported. [wiki]
Supported skills deal 10% less (L1) to 9% more (L20) projectile damage; mana multiplier 130%. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. The damage mod is right; Bob only adds one projectile at the start, and nothing forks on hit.

audit.poe: A bow attack that fires a fan of extra arrows, mostly a clear skill; at point blank the arrows also shotgun a single target.
audit.bob: Projectile fan of 3 arrows (+1 per 5 levels) over 30 degrees at 90-120% each, bow only. Because all arrows of one use share a hit list (DESIGN decision 2026-10-06), a single target is hit once per use, so the fan helps only against several targets.
audit.repair: None needed; the single-target shotgun is a deliberate engine-wide divergence (see quiverRush for where it matters).

staggerResolve.ref: Endurance Charge on Melee Stun Support
staggerResolve.name: Stagger Resolve

audit.poe: Melee stun grants an endurance charge, and supported skills deal more damage per endurance charge.
audit.bob: Stun grants a Grit charge (rolled on stun events); no more damage per charge.
audit.repair: Add a more-damage multiplier per Grit charge on the supported skill.

spec.page: Endurance Charge on Melee Stun Support
lines: Support for melee attack skills; mana multiplier 110%; added in 0.11.6. [wiki]
Gain an Endurance Charge when you stun an enemy with a melee hit from a supported skill. [wiki][pob]
Supported skills deal 4% more damage per Endurance Charge held (3% before 3.3.0). [wiki][pob]
Supported skills have 0% (L1) to 19% (L20) reduced enemy stun threshold. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. But the 'per_charge_damage' primitive it lists as missing already exists in Bob's data model: Discharge, Lightheart and Blinking Cut scale mods with 'per: charges.<kind>'. The repair is one data line (damage more 4 per charges.grit), so the missing list is emptied.

audit.poe: Makes stunning easier.
audit.bob: Reduces enemy stun threshold and lengthens stun; both read in the stun code.

audit.poe: Banner: allies impale with attacks, enemies' accuracy is lowered, fortify; grows by stages from impales; carried then placed.
audit.bob: Timed buff (8 s, cd 6): chance.impale 20, hitTaken more -12 (fortify stand-in), impaleEffect inc. Impale/fortify work in skill.ts; enemy accuracy debuff, stages, carry/place missing.
audit.repair: Same placed-banner primitive as War Banner, with stages fed by impales.

lines: Aura spell, 10 mana reserved, 1 s cooldown; cast to carry (reserves), cast again to place; one banner at a time. [wiki]

Aura effects, active whether carried or placed: you and nearby allies have 20% chance to impale on hit with attacks and (0-19)% increased impale effect; nearby enemies have 15-21% less accuracy. [wiki]
While carrying, 1 stage per impale you inflict (up to 5 per second). When placed, each stage adds 8% area, 1% aura effect, +1 s to the 10 s placed duration. [wiki]
Placing grants Fortify for 0.05 s per stage, with 2% increased Fortify effect per stage; Fortify is 20% less damage taken from hits. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Stages come from impaling (capped 5/s), not kills, and the Fortify is a brief placement buff rather than permanent damage reduction, so Bob's flat -12% hit taken is generous. Bob keeps the real 20% impale chance.

audit.poe: Banner: reserves mana while carried, is placed to become a stationary aura that grows by stages from kills; gives allies accuracy and makes enemies take increased physical damage, plus adrenaline.
audit.bob: Timed buff on the character (8 s, cd 6): inc accuracy and +10% attack, cast and move speed (invented numbers; real mods). No enemy phys-damage debuff, no stages/kill scaling, no carry/place or reservation.
audit.repair: Make the banner a placed aura (stationary object) with kill-fed stages and an enemy 'physical damage taken' debuff in radius.

lines: Aura spell, 10 mana reserved (percentage reservation), 1 s cooldown. Cast once to carry the banner (mana reserved); cast again to place it, ending the reservation. Only one banner at a time. [wiki]
Aura effects, active whether carried or placed: you and nearby allies gain 15-21% increased accuracy rating and nearby enemies take 8-11% increased physical damage. [wiki]
While carrying, each kill gives 1 stage. When placed, each stage adds 8% area, 1% aura effect and +1 s to the base 10 s placed duration. [wiki]
Placing the banner grants Adrenaline for 0.05 s per stage (Adrenaline: 100% increased damage, 25% increased attack, cast and move speed, 10% additional physical damage reduction). [wiki]
Players and monsters must be inside the placed banner's radius to receive the aura effects. [wiki]
spec.check: Corrected verdict from drifted to gutted: the physical-damage-taken debuff on enemies, the kill stages and the carry-then-place loop are all absent, and what Bob has beyond accuracy is a 10% attack/cast/move speed buff for 8 s that stands in for an Adrenaline lasting about a second at 25%.

audit.poe: Bow/wand attack fired by ballista totems; you can have extra ballistas; slower and weaker each.
audit.bob: adds totem, deployCount +2 (three standing), damage and attack speed less. Needs an attack the gem marks totemable, excludes melee; the totem fires with the character's profile. Same engine totem model as Spell Totem.

audit.poe: The spell is cast by a totem you plant, which keeps casting while you do something else, at a damage and cast speed cost.
audit.bob: adds the totem type: the spell is placed 1.5 tiles toward the target and shoots from there every use time for 10 s with the character's numbers (sim/deploy.ts); mana is paid once at placement. While the totem stands the AI uses another skill. Totems are invulnerable and not targeted by monsters (accepted engine simplification).

audit.poe: Curse becomes a reserved-mana aura that applies to all enemies in an area around you, with no casting.
audit.bob: Reserves 35% of mana and the curse is applied as a hex to every enemy the character hits (deriveHexes/applyPlayerHexes). It is an on-hit curse not an aura around the player: enemies not hit are never cursed, there is no radius, and it counts against the one-hex limit.
audit.repair: Apply the curse to all enemies within a radius of the player while the aura stands (like the existing burning-aura tick).

lines: Support (Aura) added in 2.1.0 for curse skills; the supported curse is cast as an aura around the player and applies to all enemies in its area, with +0% (L1) to +76% (L20) increased area for the curse. [wiki][pob]
Using the supported curse is instant (1.2 s cooldown). [wiki][pob]
Reserves 35% of maximum mana (mana reservation override) and behaves like an aura, so reduced reservation applies; aura effect modifiers do not apply to the curse. [wiki]
Blasphemy curses count toward the curse limit; if several Blasphemy sources exceed it, the closest source decides which curses affect an enemy. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Bob matches the 35% reservation and replaces the area aura with an on-hit curse on every enemy hit.

audit.poe: Area curse: -lightning resistance and extra chance to be shocked.
audit.bob: shockSap hex: -25..-44% lightning resistance in r3.5, working. Shock-chance-taken half absent.
audit.repair: Optionally add enemy-side 'extra shock chance' to the hex.

audit.poe: A lightning ring around you followed by a larger nova, with a good shock chance and shock effect.
audit.bob: Self-centred burst (radius 3.2) with 20% shock chance and shock effect increase, both read by the engine; the two rings are one burst.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Warcry that gives endurance charges scaling with nearby enemies, brief life regeneration, and taunts; shares a warcry cooldown.
audit.bob: Utility buff (policy rally, cd 4): cast triggers chargeOn.cast.grit 100 (real: utility cast calls rollCharges 'cast') and lifeRegen 8..60 for 8 s. Charges are one per cast, not scaled by enemy count; no taunt or shared warcry cooldown (utilityReady is per skill).
audit.repair: Optionally scale charge chance by enemies in radius and add taunt.

audit.poe: Strength's melee damage bonus also applies to spell damage.
audit.bob: Only some inc spell damage; no attribute bonus extension (and no flag in the engine for spells).
audit.repair: Add a strength-to-spell-damage flag in character.ts and have the support grant it.

lines: Supports spell skills; Strength's damage bonus also applies to the spell damage of the supported skill [wiki]
The bonus is +1% increased Spell Damage per 5 Strength and applies to all damage of the spell, not just the physical part [wiki]
Also gives 0% (L1) to 38% (L20) increased Spell Damage (2% per level since 2.0.0) [wiki][pob]
spec.check: Holds: the wiki confirms the Strength-to-spell-damage extension; Bob has the 0-38 increased spell damage half and none of the extension.

audit.poe: A single tanky golem that grants you life regeneration and can taunt with its slam.
audit.bob: One stone golem with big life and splash melee; the owner's life regen (33-105/s) is always on in the sheet whether or not the golem stands, and there is no taunt.
audit.repair: None needed (optionally make the owner buff require a live golem).

audit.poe: Stance toggled by recasting: Flesh Stance maims nearby enemies and makes them take more physical damage from hits (offence); Sand Stance blinds nearby enemies and cuts damage taken from attacks by non-blind enemies (defence). 25% reserved in 3.9.
audit.bob: Free always-on buff of less damage taken from hits (hitTaken more -9 to -11). No offensive stance, no maim or blind, no toggle, no reservation.
audit.repair: Two stances swapped by policy: Flesh applies a phys-vuln debuff and slow to nearby enemies, Sand gives the damage reduction.

lines: Instant stance aura, 2 s cooldown, reserves 25% mana, aura radius 28 units; reusing it alternates Blood and Sand (shared with Blood and Sand). [wiki]
Blood Stance: nearby enemies are Maimed, and enemies maimed by this skill take (13-16)% increased physical damage. [wiki]
Sand Stance: nearby enemies are Blinded, and you take (9-11)% less damage from attacks by enemies that are NOT nearby (3.8.0: attacks only, from non-blind enemies, not all damage). [wiki]
Gem now has 20 levels; up to 50% increased cooldown recovery. [wiki]
spec.check: Audit PoE line holds, but one correction: Sand Stance's 9-11% reduction applies only to attacks from enemies OUTSIDE the aura (nearby ones are blinded instead), not to all hits. Bob's always-on flat hitTaken -9..-11 is therefore too generous against melee mobs and misses both enemy debuffs. Added range_conditional_damage_reduction.

audit.poe: A half-lightning arrow that strikes the target with a bolt that also hits up to three nearby enemies, with a strong shock bonus.
audit.bob: Chain behaviour with 3 chains over 4 tiles, 50% lightning conversion and shock effect increase; all read by the engine (chain loop in fire(), convertSkill, effect.shock).
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: A mine that detonates for lightning area damage with shock, and an aura raising lightning damage taken near it.
audit.bob: A mine that bursts (radius 2.8, 110%) with 20% shock chance and scaled shock effect; the small lightning-taken aura is omitted.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: A golem that grants you attack and cast speed and shoots lightning.
audit.bob: One ranged lightning golem; the owner gets 6-9% increased attack and cast speed (always on); the golem's added-damage aura for minions is omitted.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Aura (50% reserved) that adds lightning damage to attacks and gives spells a more-lightning-damage multiplier (15-21%); the multiplier is why lightning casters take it.
audit.bob: Reserves 50% mana and adds flat lightning min/max as base damage (engine reads damage.min/max base in addedFlats; spells get it scaled by effectiveness). No spell-damage multiplier.
audit.repair: Add a damage more mod (lightning, spell tag) to the aura's mods alongside the added flat damage.

lines: Instant aura (3.4.0) that reserves mana (50 in PoB data) and affects you and nearby allies; radius +0 to +19 by L20; effects do not stack across several Wraths, the highest level wins [wiki][pob]
Adds lightning damage to ATTACKS only: 2-37 at L1 to 16-248 at L20 [wiki]
Spells get no flat damage from it: instead they deal 15% (L1) to 21% (L20) more Spell Lightning Damage [wiki]
The aura is a buff, so buff-effect modifiers scale it [wiki]
spec.check: Corrected: the 3.9 wiki says the added lightning is with Attacks only and spells receive only the more-lightning multiplier. Bob adds the flat damage to spells too (scaled by effectiveness), so the audit repair of adding a more mod 'alongside the flat damage' would double-dip spells; the flat must be restricted to attacks (data fix: tag the flat damage mods attack-only) and the more-lightning multiplier restricted to spells.

audit.poe: 25% reserved herald: added lightning damage; killing a shocked enemy makes lightning bolts strike enemies around you for 6 s. The reward is a lasting barrage after each shocked kill.
audit.bob: Added lightning damage works. Killing a shocked enemy fires one lightning explosion (7% of its max life, radius 3) at its corpse and nothing more; no lasting bolts around the player.
audit.repair: On shocked kill, start a 6 s timer that strikes random nearby enemies every fraction of a second.

lines: Herald (Spell, Buff, Lightning) that reserves 25% of mana; instant cast with a 1 s cooldown. [wiki][pob]
Adds lightning damage to both attacks and spells (2-7 at level 1 up to 19-76 at level 20); this added damage can shock, but the herald's own effects never inflict shock. [wiki][pob]

On killing a shocked enemy (by attack or spell; not by minions, traps, mines or totems) lightning bolts strike enemies around you for 6 s: one strike every 250 ms, never the same enemy twice within 400 ms. [wiki]

Bolt damage is secondary lightning damage, 1-34 at level 1 up to 27-1303 at level 20 (effectiveness 120%), unaffected by spell damage modifiers; the area stays centred on the character as they move. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Bob's single 7%-of-max-life explosion at the corpse replaces the 6 s barrage of bolts around the player.

audit.poe: Arrows plus a lightning burst that damages every enemy in a cone, with the arrows degrading in flight; a close-range cone shotgun. (Row corrected after checking the 3.9 wiki; see the erratum.)
audit.bob: A fan of 3 bow arrows (range 7) with half lightning conversion and added lightning. There is no cone area damage (no explodeRadius or beam on the behaviour).
audit.repair: Give the projectile an explode shape of a cone from the impact (or a beam hit at fire time) so the lightning burst exists.

lines: Bow attack, 80-99% of base attack damage, fires 2 additional arrows (3 in total, since 3.9.0), 50% of physical converted to lightning, plus added lightning (up to 9-179 at L20). [wiki][pob]

Each bow shot also releases one lightning burst in a cone in front of you that damages every enemy in it. This is separate area damage: an enemy in the line of fire takes both the cone and the arrow. [wiki]
The cone is per shot, not per arrow (with Barrage Support, once per sequentially fired projectile). Area mods affect the cone but not the arrows. [wiki]
Arrows degrade in flight and vanish after a short distance, so base range is short; projectile speed lengthens both arrow range and cone reach. [wiki][pob]
Arrows no longer pierce by default (3.9.0); no shotgun flag, so each enemy is hit once by the arrows. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds, with one clarification: the 'cone shotgun' is one cone per shot plus once-per-target arrows, not several cones. Bob's 3 arrows, 50% conversion and added lightning are right; the cone and the short arrow range are missing.

audit.poe: Channel an illusion you steer, waves of lightning damage pulse along its path, then you teleport to it for a final wave.
audit.bob: Attack with travel 8, half lightning conversion and a burst r2.2 with a flat +120% more damage standing in for stages. A dash plus lightning burst; no channel, no waves along the path.
audit.repair: Fire several lightning pulses along the travel line and one at arrival, scaling with distance.

lines: Channelled melee lightning attack (needs a weapon); 160% attack speed multiplier, 95-110% base attack damage, 50% of physical converted to lightning; mana 4 per use, drain scales with attack speed and travel time. [wiki][pob]
Channelling projects an illusion at 130% of your movement speed that you steer; you gain stages while it moves, capped by attack speed vs movement speed, until it stops at max distance. [wiki]
Waves of area damage pulse along its path while channelling (one pulse per two stages); channelling damage is 150% more if the illusion has finished moving. [wiki]
Releasing the channel teleports you to the illusion and deals a final wave at 75% of damage per stage; pulses do not overlap. [wiki]
If you run out of mana you teleport to where the illusion got to and deal the same final damage. [wiki]
spec.check: Audit PoE line holds (steered illusion, pulses, teleport and final wave); the wiki adds the 75%-per-stage final wave and a 150% more damage bonus for channelling once the illusion stops. Marked corrected because the audit repair 'scale with distance' should be stages scaled by attack speed over movement speed; Bob's flat +120% more is a stand-in for the 150%/75% numbers.

audit.poe: Aura giving lightning resistance and raising maximum lightning resistance.
audit.bob: Reserves 35% mana for resist.lightning and maxResist.lightning, both read by defence.ts.

audit.poe: Hits penetrate lightning resistance.
audit.bob: Penetration lightning.

audit.poe: A cold burst plus chilling ground with a 3 s cooldown that you skip by spending a Frenzy Charge, and enemies dying in the ground may grant Frenzy Charges. The charge loop (kill, gain, spend to recast) is the niche.
audit.bob: A plain cold burst at the target (radius 2.2, 140% effectiveness) with more chill. No cooldown (the gem def has no cooldown field; SkillDef.cooldown is never set from gems, only the generic secondary rule applies), no charge spending, no charge gain on kills in the area, and no cold ground DoT. Bob does have a Fervour charge kind and chargeOn.kill hooks that could carry this.
audit.repair: Add a data cooldown to gems plus a spend-a-charge bypass in the cooldown check, and a kill-in-zone charge gain tied to the zone the skill leaves.

lines: Spell, 0.85 s cast, 6% base crit, 140% effectiveness: cold burst in a target area dealing 32-47 to 666-999 cold damage (gem L1 to L20). [wiki]

The burst leaves chilled ground that expands up to twice its original size over a 5 s duration and deals cold damage over time (26.3 base dps at L1, 1193.2 at L20; spell damage modifiers apply to it). The ground DoT does not stack with itself. [wiki]
Cooldown 3 s with 1 stored use. The cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge. [wiki]
Enemies that die while in the area have a 25% chance to grant a Frenzy Charge. [wiki]
0-19% increased chill effect by gem level; mana 11 at L1, 28 at L20. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds (3 s cooldown, Frenzy Charge bypass, 25% charge on kill in the area). The wiki adds that the ground is a cold DoT rather than just chilling, which the audit already lists as missing.

audit.poe: A small frontal sweep whose area grows by 50% more per stage; each hit adds a stage, stages fade if you stop hitting. You pick it for the ramping area on repeated attacks.
audit.bob: A fixed self-centred 360-degree burst (radius 2.4) with a constant +50% area; the stage ramp, its decay and the frontal shape are replaced by a flat bonus from the first swing (the engine's accepted averaging of ramping skills).
audit.repair: Track a per-skill stage count that rises on hit and decays after a pause, scaling the burst radius.

lines: Melee attack, Dagger, Claw or one-handed Sword only; 135-155% of base attack damage in a small frontal area (a 135 degree arc, base radius 20 units, +0 to +2 radius by level). [wiki][pob]
Each use that hits an enemy adds a stage: 50% more area of effect per stage, up to 4 stages (200% more, radius about 41 at L20). Damage does not ramp. [wiki]
