If nothing is hit for about 3 seconds you begin losing stages, one at a time (since 3.7.0; before that all at once). [wiki]
Stacks are shared between copies of the gem and are kept when other actions are used. [wiki]
Added in 0.11.4; mana cost 6, cast time 1 s. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds; adds the cap (4 stages), the ~3 s decay and that the shape is a frontal arc, not a ring. Bob keeps the area melee and the weapon list but has a flat +50% and a 360 degree burst.

audit.poe: Intensity stacks build while you stand and cast, adding area damage; moving loses stacks. A commitment/ramp trade.
audit.bob: Flat increased area of effect and more area damage. The stand-still ramp-up and loss on movement are averaged away although a stationary condition exists in the engine.
audit.repair: Make the area damage bonus conditional on the stationary condition or build stacks while not moving.

lines: Supports spell skills you cast yourself; not triggered, Vaal, instant, channelling or mana-reserving skills, nor totems, traps or mines, and not minions [wiki]
Each cast gains one Intensity, up to a maximum of 4 stacks (it builds on casting, not on standing still) [wiki]
Each stack gives 10% (L1) to 16% (L20) more Area Damage but 12% less Area of Effect [wiki]
A flat 35% (L1) to 54% (L20) increased Area of Effect applies regardless of stacks [wiki]
Loses one stack every 0.25 s while moving, and all of them at once on a teleport; a movement skill removes only 1 stack [wiki]
Added in 3.6.0 [wiki]
spec.check: Partly corrected: stacks build with each cast and are lost while moving (not 'while standing'), and every stack carries a 12% less area penalty, which the audit line leaves out; Bob has the flat area and area damage averaged away and none of the stack trade.

audit.poe: Pure increased attack speed.
audit.bob: Increased attack speed, read by the engine.

audit.poe: Faster projectiles and more projectile damage.
audit.bob: projectileSpeed inc read; projectile damage inc.

audit.poe: Three-in-one trap support: faster throwing, faster trap cooldown recovery, and longer trap/effect duration.
audit.bob: Only the throw speed (as cast/attack speed inc). The duration component is dropped even though deployable lifetime does scale with skillDuration (deploy.ts), and Bob has no trap cooldown at all.
audit.repair: Add skillDuration to the mods so traps last longer; a trap cooldown system would be needed for the third stat.

lines: Supports trap skills [wiki]
15% (L1) to 34% (L20) increased Trap Throwing Speed [wiki]

50% (L1) to 107% (L20) increased Cooldown Recovery Speed for throwing Traps: this only matters for traps with a stored-use cooldown (such as Siphoning Trap), and it speeds the refill of a stock [wiki][pob]

10% to 29% increased Skill Effect Duration: this lengthens the effects the trap's skill creates (for example Siphoning Trap's beams), NOT the trap's own armed lifetime, which skill-duration modifiers no longer affect since 3.3.0 [wiki]
Mana multiplier 120% [wiki]
spec.check: Corrected: the audit repair says to add skillDuration so traps last longer, but the 3.9 Trap page says trap duration is not affected by skill effect duration and that modifiers to trap duration do not affect the skill effect it creates. The duration part must extend the trap skill's effect (beams, zone), and Bob's deployable-lifetime scaling in deploy.ts is itself off-spec for traps.
spec.decision: Bob's deployable lifetime scales with skillDuration (deploy.ts), but in 3.9 that never applies to a trap's, mine's or totem's own lifetime, only to the effect it casts. Fix the engine to match 3.9 (so More Duration and this support extend the zone or beams but not the trap), or leave the engine as it is?

audit.poe: A stationary orb that fires splitting lightning bolts at nearby enemies for 6 s; using a lightning skill inside its cloud makes it fire extra bolts, and recasting replaces it.
audit.bob: A 6 s ground zone (radius 2) that pulses full spell hits every 1.2 s on whatever stands in it; no target-seeking bolts, no splitting, no interaction with casting other lightning skills, no replace-on-recast.
audit.repair: Give ground zones an optional 'bolt' mode that strikes the nearest enemy within a larger radius each interval, and an extra-bolt trigger when the owner casts a lightning skill while inside.

lines: Spell (lightning, duration, chaining), 0.5 s cast and 0.5 s cooldown. Creates a stationary orb next to the caster for 6 s; casting again replaces the previous orb. [wiki][pob]

The orb strikes a target inside its radius with a lightning bolt that splits to 2-4 additional targets (the split bolts can reach well beyond the radius); it strikes every 1.5 s at level 1 down to 1.02 s at level 20, and cast speed shortens the interval. [wiki][pob]
Each bolt is its own spell hit (own crit and on-hit rolls), effectiveness 70%, (2-7) to (185-555) lightning. [wiki][pob]
Casting a lightning skill while inside the orb's radius makes it unleash an additional bolt from the caster's position (no internal cooldown except for channelled skills). [wiki]
Area-damage bonuses do not apply; area bonuses only widen the targeting radius. Mana 4 to 16. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB. Add the real timing: first strike interval 1.5 s improving to 1.02 s with level, and 2-4 split targets.

audit.poe: A brand that attaches to an enemy and periodically fires chaining lightning beams, the attached target taking extra damage.
audit.bob: A brand that every 0.6 s chains lightning (3 chains) from the nearest enemy in reach with a flat more-damage bonus; attachment is not modelled and the bonus applies to all targets rather than the attached one.
audit.repair: None needed.

audit.poe: Melee strike plus a lightning strike at a nearby location, and on hit a buff aura giving you and allies added lightning damage; picked for the buff.
audit.bob: Melee arc 90 strike with half lightning, shock chance and -25% more damage. The follow-up lightning area and the aura buff are dropped.
audit.repair: On hit, grant a timed buff giving added lightning damage, and add a second area hit.

lines: Melee attack (sword, axe, mace, sceptre, staff or unarmed). 196% (level 1) to 218% (level 20) of base attack damage, 50% physical converted to lightning; attack speed multiplier 85%; mana 6. [wiki][pob]

The strike also causes lightning to strike the targeted location or a nearby enemy for area damage (radius +0 to 6; 30% to 20% less area damage). An enemy hit by the melee strike is not also hit by the area. The area does not count as a melee hit. [wiki][pob]
If the skill hits an enemy you gain an aura for 4 s that gives you and allies added lightning damage ((1-12) to (4-220)) and (0-19)% chance to shock. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the 3.9 wiki and PoB. The buff is a 4 s aura (added lightning plus shock chance), not a flat shock chance on the hit.

audit.poe: Spending mana on the spell builds toward a buff: more spell damage, cast speed and mana regen.
audit.bob: Casting the spell grants the Arcane Tide buff (10% more spell damage, 10% cast speed, regen). No mana-spent threshold and no level scaling, but the buff loop works.

audit.poe: Cone wave of phys/fire/lightning damage whose defining effect is applying Exposure (-resist) matching the element the target took most damage from; only one wave at a time.
audit.bob: A 'beam' spell (length 5, width 3) dealing fire + physical with 50% phys to lightning. No exposure/resist-shift debuff exists anywhere in src (grep 'exposure' finds nothing); the port note's 'shifts which element is weakest' is not implemented.
audit.repair: Add an enemy 'exposure' status (timed -X% resist to the element of the highest damage dealt in the hit) applied by hit, and give the gem a mod that triggers it.

lines: Spell (AoE, Duration) added in 3.6.0: cast time 0.7 s, crit 6%, damage effectiveness 160%, base duration 0.5 s; an advancing cone/arc of damage that hits each enemy once as it passes and is stopped by terrain. [wiki][pob]
Base damage is physical only, 25% of it converted to fire and 25% to lightning, so roughly half physical and a quarter each fire and lightning. [wiki][pob]

Each enemy hit is inflicted with Exposure for 4 s (secondary duration) matching the element it took the most damage from: -25% to that elemental resistance. Exposure of the same element does not stack, only the largest applies. [wiki][pob]
Conversion is applied before damage is rolled, so in practice only one element is ever highest and only one exposure is applied. [wiki]

Only one wave can be active at a time: casting again makes the first one disappear shortly after; range is set by area and duration modifiers (up to 38% increased skill effect duration at level 20). [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Precision only: the exposure is a flat -25% resistance for 4 s on the top damage element, and the damage is physical with 25%/25% conversion (Bob uses fire + physical with 50% of physical to lightning, close enough). The defining Exposure effect is the part Bob lacks.

audit.poe: Area curse: -fire resistance and extra chance for the target to be ignited by fire.
audit.bob: Utility curse cast by policy: fireSap hex -25..-44% fire res on target and enemies within r3.5 (hexes.ts, real in damage code). The 'chance to be ignited' half is absent; minor.
audit.repair: Optionally add an enemy-side 'chance to be ignited' hex effect.

audit.poe: Chance to ignite, more fire damage, and ignited enemies have reduced fire resistance (the resistance shred).
audit.bob: Chance to ignite and more fire damage; the fire resistance reduction on ignited enemies is missing. Target resistance shifts exist (curses) but are not applied.
audit.repair: Apply a fire-resistance shift to enemies the skill has ignited.

lines: Supports any skill that hits enemies [wiki]
30% (L1) to 49% (L20) chance to ignite; the chance is checked per hit and adds to other ignite chance [wiki]
10% to 29% more Fire Damage [wiki]
Enemies ignited by the supported skill have -10% to -19% to Fire Resistance [wiki]
Renamed and given the resistance reduction in 3.3.0 [wiki]
spec.check: Holds: the wiki and PoB list ignite chance, more fire damage and -10 to -19 fire resistance on enemies ignited by the supported skill; Bob has the first two ranges exactly and lacks the resistance shift.

audit.poe: A fire arrow with a high ignite chance and ignite damage bonus; ignited enemies also get an extra stacking burning debuff (up to five) based on the ignite, and burning ground, so the ignite becomes the damage.
audit.bob: A bow attack, 100% physical to fire, 50% ignite chance and 50-88% more ignite damage (the tagged mod does reach ignite damage). No stacking burning debuff and no burning ground, so the extra ignite scaling is absent.
audit.repair: On ignite, apply a separate stacking burn (up to 5, a share of the ignite's damage) and optionally a short burning patch.

lines: Bow attack at 150-184.2% of base attack damage, 100% of physical converted to fire (raised from 50% in 3.9.0). [wiki]
50% base chance to ignite at every gem level, and 50-88% more damage with ignite by gem level. [wiki]

3.9.0 addition: if the arrow ignites, it also inflicts a Burning Debuff for a 4 s base duration dealing fire damage per second equal to 30-39% of the ignite's dps; this damage is not affected by your damage modifiers, and up to 5 such debuffs can be on an enemy at once. [wiki]
Burning ground is NOT part of the 3.9 gem: it only appears if the character has the Pitch Darkness threshold jewel, so the ground rider is not needed. [wiki]
Bob already matches the base multiplier, conversion, ignite chance and the more-ignite-damage mod. [pob]
spec.check: Corrected: the audit says the gem also makes burning ground, but the 3.9 wiki ties burning ground to the Pitch Darkness jewel, not the gem, so ground_effect leaves the missing list. The extra stacking burning debuff (up to 5, 30-39% of ignite dps, unaffected by modifiers) holds.

audit.poe: Summon extra totems at once for less damage each; more simultaneous sources of the totem's skill.
audit.bob: deployCount +2 (three totems stand and each shoots every use time) with less damage. Placement is one per cast rather than three at once, minor.

audit.poe: A returning chaos projectile that can be caught; caught projectiles are released into a spiral when you use Whirling Blades, so it is a poison skill combined with a movement skill.
audit.bob: A returning poison blade with 50% chaos and 100% poison chance (the engine reads both); no catching and no release by a movement skill, so it is a spinning poison boomerang.
audit.repair: Store projectiles that come back to the owner and release them as a spiral when the character uses a blink or movement skill.

lines: Dagger or Claw attack, 90-115% of base attack damage: throws a projectile that pierces all targets and returns to you. 50% of physical converted to chaos, 40% chance to poison, plus added chaos. [wiki][pob]
Returning projectiles deal 75% less damage. [wiki][pob]
The returning projectile can be caught: up to 30 caught, base duration 12 s (apparently how long they are kept). [wiki]
Using Whirling Blades releases the caught projectiles outward in a spiral; released projectiles do not return. [wiki]
Added in 3.8.0. [wiki]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. The numbers differ from Bob's: poison chance is 40% (Bob 100%), the return leg deals 75% less (Bob hits both legs in full), and the weapon is dagger or claw only (Bob also allows sword). The partner movement gem exists in Bob as Spinning Dash.

audit.poe: 40% poison chance on hit plus added chaos damage (poedb; no PoB data, relied on current page and memory).
audit.bob: 40% poison chance and more poison damage; no added chaos. Poison is a working ailment in the engine.

audit.poe: Multistrike repeats twice with a random enemy each time, 35-44% more attack speed, -20..-10% damage on every strike, +22% on the first repeat and +44% on the second (3.9 data).
audit.bob: Sets repeats 2 with speed and damage boosts; the second echo now lands before the action ends (S1). No ramp, no penalty, same target.
audit.repair: S13c: the penalty and ramp as 3.9 has them, and a random nearby target for each repeat.

lines: Supports melee attack skills; the attack repeats 2 additional times (3 strikes per use), each repeat on a random valid enemy in range, falling back to the player's location if none [wiki]
Cannot support Vaal, totem, channelling or triggered skills [wiki]
35% (L1) to 44% (L20) more Melee Attack Speed [wiki]

Damage ramps by repeat: first repeat 22% more, second repeat 44% more; and the whole skill deals 20% (L1) to 10% (L20) LESS attack damage, so a full use is about 2.9x (L1) to 3.3x (L20) one hit [wiki][pob]
Crit is rolled once for all three strikes, and on-crit effects trigger once per use [wiki]
spec.check: Holds, and the wiki confirms the audit's sign finding: PoE has a damage penalty (20 to 10% less), while Bob has +12 to +25% more; that makes Bob's total about 3.4x to 3.75x per use, above PoE. The wiki's 3.7.0 note quotes a 40/80 ramp, but the stat_text and PoB give 22/44, so I used those. The echo-timing bug is the audit's reading of code, which I did not check.

audit.poe: Two extra projectiles in a fan, a little faster, each hitting less; a pack-clear and close-range shotgun support (from memory, no PoB data).
audit.bob: projectiles +2, attack/cast speed +10% more, damage -18% more. The extra arrows fan out and each use hits a given enemy at most once (shared useHits list in sim/actions.ts), so it widens coverage but does not stack on one target; the calc sheet ignores projectile count entirely.

audit.poe: Throws extra traps in a line, each weaker.
audit.bob: deployCount +2 and less damage; identical in effect to Snare Cluster. Line placement is not modelled (ring placement for every cluster), which only matters spatially.

audit.poe: Dual-wield only: strikes with both weapons in one hit, extra crit chance, and big crit and damage bonuses against full-life enemies as an opener.
audit.bob: Marked bothWeapons and needsDualWield with +50-107% crit chance. In the sim only the arc melee branch hits with all hands: a single-target melee use goes through hit(..., act.hand) once, so each use strikes with one alternating weapon while the calc sheet counts both hands. No full-life bonuses.
audit.repair: In fire() make the non-arc melee branch hit with every hand when p.bothHands, and add a target-full-life condition for the bonuses.

lines: Melee attack usable only while dual wielding (claws, daggers, one-hand swords/axes/maces, sceptres); not with wands. [wiki]

One strike attacks with both weapons and deals both weapons' damage; each weapon rolls its own hit and crit, but on-hit effects apply once per use. 125% (level 1) to 170% (level 20) of base attack damage. [wiki][pob]
50% (level 1) to 107% (level 20) increased crit chance. [wiki][pob]
Against enemies on full life: 100% more crit chance and 30% more damage with hits and ailments. [wiki][pob]
Attack speed multiplier 70% (30% slower); +0 to 2 melee range; mana 5. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line holds against the wiki and PoB. Keep in mind that on-hit effects (ailment chances, rage and so on) should roll once per use even though both hands hit.

audit.poe: Two fast strikes in one use with a bleed chance, plus added physical damage against bleeding enemies.
audit.bob: Melee strike with repeats 1 (the second blow lands a moment later without wind-up, per updateAction echoes) and 25% bleed chance (bleed is read for attacks). The extra damage against bleeding enemies is absent.
audit.repair: Optional: conditional added physical damage vs targetBleeding.

audit.poe: Two extra projectiles fired in parallel lanes (a wider frontage than a fan), minor penalty. They cannot hit the same target. (Row corrected after checking the 3.9 wiki; see the erratum.)
audit.bob: +2 projectiles in a fan at less damage; the once-per-target rule is right, the parallel lanes are not modelled.
audit.repair: A parallel placement option for projectile supports.

lines: Support for skills that fire projectiles from the user: also fires projectiles from up to 2 points on each side of you, parallel to the main projectile, and fires 2 additional projectiles. [wiki][pob]
Supported skills deal 12% (L1) to 3% (L20) less projectile damage (3.9.0); mana multiplier 140%. [wiki][pob]
Extra projectiles from other supports are divided among the points; with more projectiles the inner points fire several in a V. [wiki]
Does not affect projectiles fired from other locations as secondary effects. [wiki]
No shotgun flag in pob, so each enemy is hit once per use. [pob]
spec.check: The audit's PoE line holds. Same gap as Wide Salvo: a parallel placement rather than a fan.

audit.poe: Bow attack summons a mirage archer for a few seconds that fires the same skill at 60% less attack speed and reduced damage; bow-only, an independent extra attacker.
audit.bob: repeats +1 at -40 to -31% damage: one echo shot per use from the same spot a moment after the first (a separate fire(), so it can hit the same target again). The mirage's slow independent rate (-60% attack speed), its persistence, its position and the bow-only restriction are lost, making it stronger than PoE's.
audit.repair: Spawn a timed clone that fires at a fraction of the character's rate from its own position, restricted to bows.

lines: Supports bow attack skills; the skill can only be used with bows; not Vaal, minion, movement, totem, trap or mine skills [wiki]
When you hit an enemy with an arrow from the supported skill, a Mirage Archer is summoned above you and uses that same skill for 4 s; maximum 1 at a time [wiki]
The Mirage Archer deals 40% (L1) to 31% (L20) less Damage and attacks with 60% less Attack Speed, so it adds only about 27.6% of the player's own damage [wiki]
It is a separate entity: no leech from its damage, no on-hit or on-kill effects trigger for the player; targets within 70 units (lowered in 3.9.0) [wiki]
A skill it started persists until finished even after the mirage ends (3.7.0) [wiki]
spec.check: Holds: Bob's one echo at 31-40% less damage is stronger than the wiki's (an extra attack at the player's rate versus about 0.4 of that for 4 s); I added summon-on-hit (it needs an arrow hit) to the missing list.

audit.poe: Two sweeping slashes in an arc; Blood Stance (default) adds bleed chance and bleed damage, Sand Stance trades that for a wider angle.
audit.bob: Melee arc (150 degrees) that echoes once via repeats:1 (verified in updateAction), with 25% bleed chance and bleed-tagged more damage (verified: ailment chunks take bleed-tagged mods). Always the default Blood Stance.
audit.repair: None needed; a stance toggle would only matter if stances become a general system.

audit.poe: Channel to spin and move, constantly hitting enemies around you, building stages that raise range; extra first-hit damage; cannot be stunned.
audit.bob: Self-centred burst r2.4 (90..110%) with +1 repeat and a little travel. Retains the sweep-around-self shape, but there are no stages/range ramp and no stun immunity (channelling is only a tag).
audit.repair: Add channel_ramp: stages from consecutive uses raising radius and hit rate, decaying after a gap.

lines: Channelled melee area attack and movement skill: you move towards the targeted spot while spinning (30% less movement speed), and cannot be stunned or knocked back while channelling. [wiki][pob]

Spins at attack speed (attack speed multiplier 300%) and hits all enemies in a circle once per spin: base radius 11 plus 1 per stage; 8% increased area of effect per 1 additional melee range. [wiki][pob]
Gains 1 stage every 0.33 s (level 1) down to 0.17 s (level 20) while channelling, up to 3 stages (level 1) to 6 (level 20); loses 1 stage per 0.33 s when not channelling. [wiki][pob]
Damage: 44% (level 1) to 54% (level 20) of base attack damage plus (5-28) to (8-42) added physical per hit. The FIRST hit deals 50% LESS damage. [wiki][pob]
Mana 2 per channel tick; cannot be supported by Multistrike; frozen or bear-trapped characters stop moving. [wiki][pob]
spec.check: The audit line is wrong on one point: it says "extra first-hit damage", but the first hit deals 50% LESS damage (PoB: -50). Stages, +1 radius per stage and stun/knockback immunity hold.

audit.poe: Critical strikes grant Elusive (evasion/avoidance and speed); while elusive the skill has extra crit chance and multiplier; dagger and claw only. A crit-defence loop.
audit.bob: Unconditional crit chance inc and crit multiplier bonus. No Elusive buff (no BuffId for it), no crit-to-elusive-to-crit loop, no dagger/claw restriction. Port note acknowledges Elusive is only 'modelled' as the bonus.
audit.repair: Add an elusive buff (evasion and move speed) granted by buffOn.crit and make the crit bonuses conditional on it; restrict to dagger/claw.

lines: Supports attack skills that do not create minions; the supported skill can only be used with Claws and Daggers [wiki]
The supported skill grants Elusive on critical strike (100% chance per PoB data) [wiki][pob]
